name: Rock
info: I don't feel like I should have to explain what a rock is to you.

name: Door
info: These magical doors connect all the worlds in Growtopia. Place one and then use your Wrench on it to set the destination.

name: Cave Background
info: Technically, this is also Dirt, it's just dirt that's farther away.

name: Grass
info: I love the smell of freshly punched Grass in the morning!

name: Fist
info: Nothing can stand against the power of the FIST.

name: Sign
info: Write stuff on it to tell your friends! Use your Wrench on it to change the message.

name: Daisy
info: Bellis Perennis, the common European daisy.

name: Pointy Sign
info: This sign includes a bit of added information - an arrow!  The arrow points whichever direction you are facing when you place the sign.

name: Crappy Sign
info: This is not the greatest sign, but it'll do in a pinch.

name: Danger Sign
info: Use this sign to warn your friends of terrible space monkeys.

name: Dungeon Door
info: This works like a regular door, but it looks much more medieval.

name: Wrench
info: The amazing tool that can modify Doors, Signs, Time-Space Ruptures, and more. You can't lose it!

name: Shades
info: The future's so bright, you need these.

name: Brown Shoes
info: Standard loafers. They're actually the wrong size, but what're you gonna do?

name: Boots
info: For when you have serious work to do.

name: Baseball Cap
info: Support your favorite team! As long as your favorite team is team B!

name: Jeans
info: Denim is the strongest fiber known to man.

name: Wooden Background
info: Tons of planks. A plank ton.

name: Window
info: A piece of glass with a frame.

name: Glass Pane
info: Just your basic piece of glass.

name: Wooden Window
info: You can see out of it, except for the wooden parts.

name: Portcullis
info: Lock out the ruffians with this medieval gateway.

name: Boombox
info: If you had a piece of cardboard, you could breakdance in front of it. Cardboard and bendable limbs.

name: Olde Timey Radio
info: When this song is over, we can listen to the latest serial adventures!

name: Brown Hair
info: Brown hair comes in many styles, and this is one of them.

name: Green Skirt
info: Exactly long enough to be appropriate for all occasions.

name: Green Blouse
info: An ordinary blouse in kelly green.

name: Blonde Bombshell
info: Gorgeous blonde locks tumbling over your sensual shoulders and around your square head.

name: Briefcase
info: Contains nuclear launch codes, but you don't know the combination to open it.

name: Sword
info: Razor-sharp, and yet you kindly choose not to cut anything with it.

name: Just One Boxing Glove
info: You only get one, but it still lets you punch people harder!

name: Wood Block
info: A solid chunk of Bolivian Manzanita, polished to a mirror sheen.

name: Wooden Platform
info: The great thing about these is that you can jump up through them!

name: Painting: Dink Duck
info: An oil painting commissioned to commemorate the 15th anniversary of Dink Smallwood!

name: Brick Background
info: These bricks are slightly farther away than the other Bricks.

name: Mystery Block
info: What could possibly be inside this block!?!? Gems, that's what.

name: Red Riding Hood
info: The perfect hood for when you're riding something red.

name: Red Coat
info: Protects you from the rain. Less effective against disguised wolves.

name: Devil Horns
info: Use this on somebody who's been evil!

name: Golden Halo
info: Use this on somebody who's been good!

name: Brainwave Capacitor
info: Any medical benefits of the Brainwave Capacitor have not been verified by the FDA.

name: TV Head
info: Wait, is that TV still on?

name: Fairy Crown
info: You're the Queen of the Fairies!

name: Cyclopean Visor
info: With this visor on, you can zap things instead of punching. It does slightly less damage, but has longer range.

name: Shallot Mustache
info: Just the mustache you need to review movies with!

name: X-Ray Specs
info: These allow your character to see through the other characters' clothes. It does NOT allow you, the player, to do so.

name: Big Glasses
info: Make sure you get the right prescription.

name: Fairy Wings
info: With a pair of wings, you can double-jump!

name: Fairy Wand
info: Unfortunately, all the magic in this wand is used up.

name: Jetpack
info: It doesn't have enough thrust to actually fly, but it does let you jump really high!

name: Death Spikes
info: The deadliest kind of spikes available. Do not touch!

name: Grey Block
info: Blocks are available in a stunning array of colors!

info: Blocks are available in a stunning array of colors!

info: Blocks are available in a stunning array of colors!

info: Blocks are available in a stunning array of colors!

info: Blocks are available in a stunning array of colors!

info: Blocks are available in a stunning array of colors!

name: Brown Block
info: Blocks are available in a stunning array of colors!

name: Rose
info: Every one of these has its thorn.

name: Mushroom
info: These are surprisingly bouncy. Hold Jump as you land for maximum bounce.

name: Blueberry
info: Careful with these, they'll stain! Throw it at a player to turn him blue for an hour.

name: Flowery Wallpaper
info: If you don't like it, you can always steam it off later.

name: Burglar Mask
info: Nobody will recognize you if you cover an inch of skin around your eyes!

name: Referee Shirt
info: Referees and burglars have similar fashion sense.

name: Froghat
info: It's like a frog ate your head.

name: Flashlight
info: It takes D batteries, and nobody ever has any D batteries! (Note: no actual batteries required.)

name: Wooden Chair
info: Legs getting tired? Have a seat!

name: Wooden Table
info: Stack a bunch of these in a row to make a table as long as you want!

name: House Entrance
info: It's like a wall, except your friends can come in!

name: Signal Jammer
info: When activated (punch to activate), this prevents your world from being listed on the World Select screen.

name: Grow Spray Fertilizer
info: Spray a tree to grow it an hour faster.

name: Bathtub
info: Punch it to take a very quick shower!

name: White Beard
info: Does this make me look old?

name: Santa Pants
info: Does anybody else wear red pants with white cuffs?

name: Sack O' Joy
info: Share your joy! Wearing this makes you scatter your gems around as you move.

name: World Lock
info: Locks an entire world. If you have 100 World Locks, you can tap them in your inventory to combine them into a Diamond Lock. It does the same thing, but it's shinier.

name: Music Box
info: Guaranteed to put you to sleep.

name: Evil Bricks
info: Do not look directly at Evil Bricks.

name: Asbestos Boots
info: Protects you from lava, reducing the damage by 50%.

name: Robot Wants Dubstep
info: Robot sure is greedy. Punch him to provide the Dubstep he seeks.

name: Saturday Night Vest
info: Chest hair, gold chains, white vest. Disco lives.

name: Golden Block
info: Just think how valuable this would be in real life.

name: Picket Fence
info: Put it around your house, and live out the American Dream!

name: Messy Brown Hair
info: If there was a Comb item, you wouldn't be stuck with this.

name: Freeze Wand
info: Use this on someone to freeze them solid for 10 seconds.

name: Fire Wand
info: Use this on someone to MURDER THEM.

name: Curse Wand
info: You're on the HIGHWAY TO HELL!! (For 10 minutes)

name: Bed
info: Is this even big enough to hold a Growtopian? Doesn't matter since you can't lay down!

name: Checker Wallpaper
info: It's black, it's white, yeah yeah yeah.

name: Fireplace
info: Stay warm on those cold Growtopia nights. You can punch this to turn it on or off.

name: Snorkel
info: The trick is putting liquid soap inside the snorkel!

name: Ninja Mask
info: The essence of the shadows lurks within this mask. Put it on to cloak your entire body.

name: Ninja Tights
info: Before these were invented, Ninjas wore corduroy pants, but their prey could always hear them coming.

name: Ninja Vest
info: Shadows cloak your form as you slip behind the walls.

name: Ninja Slippers
info: Ninjas know how to stay comfortable while assassinating people.

name: The Darkness
info: I'm attacking the darkness with my Magic Missile!

name: Rubber Ducky
info: Makes bathtime lots of fun! Punch it to make it quack.

name: Checkered Pajamas
info: Don't be embarrassed to play Growtopia in your pajamas. Other players are wearing Fairy Wings.

name: Rainbow Wig
info: Be the life of the party!

name: Rainbow Block
info: For when you can't choose just one color block!

name: Monocle
info: The very pinnacle of class is having good vision in only one eye.

name: Eyepatch
info: It's reversible! Swap it from eye to eye by pressing left or right.

name: Peg Leg
info: Nothing is quite as piratey as amputated limbs!

name: Diamond Ring
info: The perfect gift to ask that special someone if they'll marry you.

name: Cannon
info: Punch this to fire it. Don't worry, it's loaded with blanks.

name: High Tech Block
info: This block can hold 4.6 petabytes of data, but has no ports of any kind to access it.

name: Magic Bacon Wallpaper
info: We had some leftover Magic Bacon, so we made it into wallpaper!

name: Bubble Wrap
info: Everybody loves to pop Bubble Wrap! Just walk in front of it to pop it. Unlike the real thing, this will un-pop in 10 seconds.

name: Cactus
info: A dangerously sharp plant! Do not touch.

name: Art Wall
info: It doesn't look like much alone, but it changes color when you punch it. Draw stuff!

name: Stone Wall
info: Classic fieldstone wall, stylish and sturdy.

name: Das Red Balloon
info: Everyone's a Captain Kirk.  Use this to make somebody float up in the air briefly!

name: Chandelier
info: The classiest way to light a room!

name: Fishnet Stockings
info: Do you really have the legs for these?

name: Monster Feet
info: Not made from the feet of actual monsters, these are just rubber.

name: Hoop Earrings
info: They're like rings, but for your ears!

name: Lollipop
info: You found this on the ground, so best just to not lick it.

name: Viking Helmet
info: There is no evidence that Vikings ever wore helmets with horns. They would have if they had thought of it, though!

name: Cloudstone Block
info: Cloudstone is very rare, because it tends to fall out of the sky and just become Stonestone.

name: Dreamstone Block
info: Forged from the dreams of children on Christmas Eve. And marble. Like 90% marble.

name: Angel Wings
info: Better than a Halo, these will actually let you double jump!

name: Diaper
info: If you find yourself lost in a world without any Toilet Seeds, you'll be glad you have this.

name: Heartbow
info: Once used by Cupid himself, this bow shoots hearts! You can yank other players toward you with it.

name: Mud Glob
info: Splat somebody with this to slow them down!

name: Cargo Shorts
info: The pockets even have pockets in them!

name: Super Crate Box
info: What's in the box!?  WHAT'S IN THE BOX?!

name: Amber Glass
info: Tinted glass for when the plain stuff just won't do.

name: Lava Rock
info: Not quite hot enough to hurt anybody, but it sure looks cool.

name: Time-Space Rupture
info: Nobody knows where you will emerge when you fall into one of these! Except whoever set the destination using the Wrench.

name: Valentine
info: Use this on somebody to make them your Valentine for an hour! They'll appreciate it greatly.

name: Candy Heart
info: Chalky goodness emblazoned with an incomprehensible slogan you can't help but shout.

name: Perfume
info: Spray this on someone to make them smell... distinctive.

name: Heartstone Block
info: This isn't actually solid Heartstone, it's just Heartstone-plated.  Kind of a letdown, really.

name: Heartstone
info: Smash it for Valentine's goodies! Every year the Golden Heart Crystal is locked in time and remains constant, appearing at the same frequency throughout the ages, while new items change and fade with the passage of time.

name: Ultra Trophy 3000
info: The best of all possible trophies.

name: Ultra Trophy 3001
info: One better than the Ultra Trophy 3000.

name: Stove
info: Is that turkey ever going to be finished cooking?

name: Spatula
info: Spatula city, spatula city, SPATULA CITY!

name: Chef Hat
info: It's been signed by Gordon Ramsay!

name: Blueberry Pie
info: The most delicious incarnation of the humble blueberry.

name: Checkpoint
info: If you die, you'll respawn at the last Checkpoint you touched!

name: Sheet Music: Blank
info: This doesn't really do much by itself!

name: Sheet Music: Bass Note
info: If you aren't in range of a Boombox, this will play a bass note for you. Put it in different places for different pitches.

name: Sheet Music: Sharp Bass
info: This plays a half-step higher note than Sheet Music: Bass Note.

name: Sheet Music: Flat Bass
info: This plays a half-step lower note than Sheet Music: Bass Note.

name: Sheet Music: Piano Note
info: If you aren't in range of a Boombox, this will play a piano note for you. Put it in different places for different pitches.

name: Sheet Music: Sharp Piano
info: This plays a half-step higher note than Sheet Music: Piano Note.

name: Sheet Music: Flat Piano
info: This plays a half-step lower note than Sheet Music: Piano Note.

name: Sheet Music: Drums
info: There are 7 different drums, place this at different positions vertically to hear different ones!

name: Race Start Flag
info: Starts a race timer. Get to a Race End Flag to record your time!

name: Race End Flag
info: A player touching this will finish a race started at a Race Start Flag, and their time will be announced.

name: Blue Star Wallpaper
info: Vaguely inspired by Vincent Van Gogh!

name: Wall Like An Egyptian
info: Unfortunately, nobody knows the correct translation of these ancient symbols.

name: Plumbing
info: Standard steel pipes, slightly too small for you to climb into.

name: Sand
info: Is it a desert or a beach? You decide!

name: Fishbowl
info: If there's a fish in there, he's hiding in the castle.

name: Poodle Skirt
info: Just the thing to wear to the sock hop!

name: Backpack
info: No, it doesn't increase your carrying capacity.

name: Space Helmet
info: Did you just stick a fishbowl on your head?

name: Plate Mail
info: Get all dressed up for the Renaissance Faire!

name: Venus Guytrap
info: This is what happens when you give a flower a taste for magic bacon!

name: Dice Block
info: Punch it to roll a random number!

name: Dresser
info: This would be a great place to store your clothes! Too bad the drawers are stuck.

name: Table Lamp
info: You don't actually need light in this game, but you can get it anyway!

name: Fedora
info: You look sharp, kid! Sponsored by i20HH.

name: Dame's Fedora
info: You're a real firecracker, I tells ya! You're one feisty dame!

name: Pinstripe Suit
info: There's a hanky in the pocket in case you /cry on the auspicious occasion of your daughter's wedding.

name: Pinstripe Pants
info: Beautifully tailored with a sleek, slim leg, this pinstripe pant is utterly flattering and entirely appropriate for workday, weekend or wherever the evening takes you.

name: Cigar
info: Surgeon General's Warning: Secondhand smoke can make you go :P.

name: Tommygun
info: Fully automatic firepower to give them coppers what-for!

name: Flapper Headband
info: You'll be the star of the speakeasy in this getup.

name: Flapper Dress
info: Dance the night away in this short dress that is clearly the bee's knees.

name: Art Deco Block
info: I don't know what this looks like actually, but it kind of looks nice, doesn't it? You'll find a place to use it!

name: Victrola
info: When Olde Timey Radio is too modern, try a classic Victrola for some jazzy tunes!

name: Big Old Sideways Arrow
info: It points the way to whatever you want it to!

name: Big Old Up Arrow
info: It points the way to stuff above you!

name: Big Old Down Arrow
info: It points the way to stuff below you!

name: Blue Wristband
info: This serves some sort of exercise purpose.

name: Blue Headband
info: Keep the sweat out of your eyes!

name: Red Sportsball Jersey
info: Now you are ready to play for the home team! Or the away team! Go team!

name: Red Sweatpants
info: Good for both joggers and mobsters.

name: Air Robinsons
info: Special air pockets and coils in the soles of these shoes make them... cost more. But they do make you run faster!

name: Pastel Pants
info: It's like springtime all up in your business!

name: Bunny Mask
info: You're not much of a bunny without big ears, but it's a start.

name: Bunny Ears
info: Any hearing improvements imparted by this hat are negated by the fact that it covers your actual ears.

name: Wicker Basket
info: This basket is filled with plastic grass for some reason.

name: Bunny Tail
info: I'm concerned about how you're holding this in place.

name: Lucky Clover
info: Stick this in your ear to become super lucky and partially deaf!

name: Orange Beard
info: Like Santa Claus, but with more Vitamin C!

name: Leprechaun Hat
info: There's a four-leaf clover jammed in the band! But all the luck in it has been used up already.

name: Green Pants
info: I used to wear green jeans myself, until somebody made fun of them. Never again!

name: Leprechaun Suit
info: You don't have to be a leprechaun to wear a green suit with gold trim - don't believe the hype!

name: Leprechaun Shoes
info: These are very hard on your toes.

name: Green Beer
info: The green dye used in this beer was outlawed in 43 states. Take a drink and find out why!

name: Pot O' Gold
info: An entire pot filled with gold!!

name: Blue Portal
info: Step through it. There is cake on the other side.

name: Glass Block
info: People inside this should not throw stones.

name: Bookcase
info: Someone glued all these books down!

name: Secret Passage
info: Looks like a Wood Block, but your friends can come in!

name: Ladder
info: This is a specially designed one-way ladder - you can only climb up, not down.

info: It's a Grey Block squashed flat!

info: It's an Aqua Block squashed flat!

info: It's a Blue Block squashed flat!

name: Purple Wallpaper
info: It's a Purple Block squashed flat!

name: Turtle Hat
info: Turtle Hat would definitely never sue anybody, because he's totally original.

name: Baneful Mask
info: Express your wrath with this evil mask. Sponsored by i20HH.

name: Rollback Plaque
info: You were there, man. You were THERE when time rolled backwards and all the fruits of your labors turned to dust in your dry, bitter fist. Feb 2013

name: Happy Joy Plaque
info: It's much happier, but much less rare, than a Rollback Plaque.

name: Wizard Hat
info: Wizard Hats come in 5 classic styles, collect them all!

name: Witch Hat
info: Wizard Hats come in 5 classic styles, collect them all!

name: Merlin Hat
info: Wizard Hats come in 5 classic styles, collect them all! This one is an officially licensed copy of the one Merlin himself wore (it's not signed or anything, though).

name: Funk Wizard Hat
info: Wizard Hats come in 5 classic styles, collect them all!

name: Cursed Wizard Hat
info: Wizard Hats come in 5 classic styles, collect them all! Too bad this style is CURSED!!

name: Tiny Horsie
info: It's possible this is actually a dachshund, but you can still ride it! It's faster than walking.

name: Elvish Longbow
info: This is the very weapon once used by Aeldrinn Zindeltwarp to defeat the Slaarn Hordes in the battle of Fizzletree Gulch!

name: Treasure Chest
info: Store your treasures inside by dropping them! When it's closed, the items are hidden. Punch to open it.

name: Dragon Gate
info: Punch it to open or shut it. Anyone unlucky enough to be caught inside when it closes becomes dragon chow.

name: Wizard's Robe
info: These are usually only worn by the highest rank of wizards. For you, we'll make an exception.

name: GrowBeats Headphones
info: There's some seriously kickin' beats going on in there, but you can't hear it, because they're headphones. Sponsored by JakeShore, ADMex1, and RovSpy.

name: Golden Sword
info: This ancient blade is forged of purest gold. Which means it's really really dull, and quite easy to bend.

name: Barrel
info: An excellent place to shoot fish.

name: Tavern Sign
info: It's a sign that sticks to walls or ceilings! Use your Wrench on it to change the message.

name: Bunny Egg
info: Think of it as a seed, only magic. If you plant it, you can use more Magic Eggs on it to grow it bigger and bigger. Break it anytime for a surprise! You can also splice it... but with what?

name: Rotten Egg
info: Throw it at somebody to make them stink!

name: Cuddly Bunny
info: Toss one to someone you love. Who wouldn't like a cuddly rabbit?

name: Psychotic Bunny
info: It's got a vicious streak a mile wide! Share it with your... friends?

name: Copper Plumbing
info: This copper piping is both smaller and farther away than the green Plumbing.

name: Steel Girder
info: This is the best place to superglue a hardhat.

info: Draw black and white pictures with the wondrous power of the tangram!

info: Draw black and white pictures with the wondrous power of the tangram!

name: Chalkboard
info: You could take roll on this, except that somebody glued the chalk to the tray.

name: School Desk
info: So uncomfortable you refuse to even sit in it!

name: Mailbox
info: You've got mail! People can write you private messages with this.

name: Bulletin Board
info: Lets people communicate by leaving messages to each other.

name: Letter
info: Who needs email? The old ways are best!

name: Granite Block
info: The classy way to decorate with rock!

name: Marble Block
info: The MOST classy way to decorate with rock!

name: Pencil
info: It's too big to write with!

name: Growtopia Lunchbox
info: Hey, it's the guy from the game icon! Carry your lunch inside.

name: Grey Hair Bun
info: Makes you look like a librarian.

name: Apple
info: This keeps doctors away for up to 24 hours!

name: Crimson Eagle Wings
info: Soar on the wings of a crimson eagle! Sponsored by Morphieus.

name: Blackrock Wall
info: This dark stone is the latest in dungeon couture.

name: Jail Door
info: You don't need a spoon to dig out, just open this.

name: Iron Mask
info: When duct tape just won't cut it, we lock you in a tower with this on your face.

name: Worthless Rags
info: You look like a sad little muppet.

name: Torch
info: Keeps the dank out in your dungeons! Well, it reduces it slightly. You can punch this to turn it on or off.

name: Meow Ears
info: Super-special kitty ears, now yours to wear! Once only for a select few, meow yours to wear with pride!

name: Sombrero
info: Aqui esta el sombrero.  El sombrero es muy bien.

name: Poncho
info: It's like you threw a blanket in the washing machine along with a bag of Skittles.

name: Desperado Mustache
info: Good for twirling when you are tying somebody to a railroad.

name: Hibiscus Hair
info: Someone told me there's a girl out there with love in her eyes and flowers in her hair.

name: Fiesta Sombrero
info: Take the fiesta with you everywhere you go!

name: Habanero Pepper
info: Caution: This is one seriously hot pepper!

name: Olmec Head
info: The Olmec people were known for two things: giant stone heads... and PARTYING DOWN!

name: Adobe Block
info: Adobe is a fantastic material for building both sturdy housing and Flash games.

name: Ultra Pinata
info: This is summoned by the Pinata Bash event, it's not an item a player can use.

name: Pinata
info: Put this on top of a bunch of items you want to give away.  Once placed, anybody can break it and get the items!

name: Pinata Whistle
info: Call your friends, then blow the whistle for a PiÃ±ata Bash! It's impossible to bash a pinata by yourself, so seriously CALL YOUR FRIENDS first, or you'll waste your whistle!

name: Stinky Bucket
info: I don't know why you would stick a bucket that smells on your head, but it has eyeholes in it, so it's not useful as a bucket! Sponsored by Stinkbuckets.

name: Clouds
info: Believe it or not, you're walking on air!

name: Hammer Pants
info: Alternatively, harem girl pants.  Think of them however you like.

name: Ban Wand
info: Use this on someone to ban them for 10 minutes.

name: Cybernetic Arm
info: KILL ALL HUMANS.  Or just kill rocks - the Cybernetic Arm is superior to a human arm at all digging functions. Sponsored by i20HH.

name: Play Wings
info: Super special wings that are only for Play!

name: Lokster Hair
info: Slick n' greasy, and nobody but Lokster can wear it.

name: Neon Lights
info: Get your name up in lights!

name: Card Block - Spade
info: Let's call a spade a spade.

name: Rabbit's Foot
info: If you rub this, it will vanish and you will become lucky for half an hour!

name: Flipping Coin
info: Flip the coin and see what you get!  What you won't get is your coin back.

name: Gambler's Visor
info: Ever wondered where these come from? Early incandescent lights were very harsh, so this dims things for you a bit without impeding your vision.

name: Slot Machine
info: Big money, big money, no whammies.... (`5odds of pretend winning are 1 in 10``)

name: Roulette Wheel
info: Spin the wheel and take your chances! Where she ends up, nobody knows!

name: Pleiadian Star Ship
info: Without a source of antimatter, all this ship can do is hover along the ground. Sponsored by Pleiadian.

name: Password Door
info: These doors only open if you know the magic word... which you do, because you set it.

name: g-Virus
info: It would be dangerous to throw this on someone, not to mention downright rude!

name: Combover
info: Don't worry, you've combed it so well that nobody can even tell you're bald!

name: Lab Coat
info: The perfect outfit for those occasions when you are zapping lightning through a corpse.

name: Traffic Barricade
info: Zombies usually respect all traffic laws, so these are handy to have around.

name: Toxic Waste Barrel
info: This barrel is filled with a highly unstable compound. Well, not filled exactly - some of it's dripping onto the floor. Approach with caution!

name: Toxic Waste
info: Usually safely stored in barrels, but currently stored ON YOUR FACE.

name: Biohazard Sign
info: Do not lick under any circumstances.

name: Antidote
info: This is THE antidote. To everything. Drink up, and you shall be cured!

name: Tombstone
info: Looks like somebody got too close to some Death Spikes.

name: Military Radio
info: This radio is your last link to the human race... so why is it just playing spooky music?

name: Zombie-Stompin' Boots
info: These military surplus boots are steel-toed and spike-soled. Hey hey, do the zombie stomp!

name: Jens Beard
info: Nobody but Jens is so wise and ancient.

name: Showgirl Headdress
info: You're almost the Statue of Liberty.

name: Zeta Reticulant Mask
info: No one is ever going to trust you with a probe again. Sponsored by Pleiadian.

name: Red Growsaber
info: You really don't want to drop this on your toe. Sponsored by JakeShore.

name: Black Growsaber
info: You really don't want to drop this on your toe. Sponsored by PirateHunter.

name: Green Growsaber
info: You really don't want to drop this on your toe.

name: Blue Growsaber
info: You really don't want to drop this on your toe.

name: Flamesaber
info: The energies contained in this blade are struggling to burst free.

name: Double Growsaber
info: Twice the sabery goodness, with half the calories!

name: Solorien On Fire
info: She's the symbol of a revolution in moderating!

name: Flaming Skull Mask
info: If you had skin on your face, this would really be painful. Sponsored by Ticklehead.

name: Ripper Wings
info: Rippling bands of dark energy carry you aloft. Sponsored by Ripply.

name: Seil's Magic Orbs
info: Dark orbs for a dark heart, these floating spheres still radiate evil from their long-lost master...

name: Water Bucket
info: Splash it around to make things wet. It can also scoop up water, though there's a good chance you'll just spill it. Butterfingers.

name: Refrigerator
info: Keep your best items cold so they don't spoil! When it's closed, the items are hidden. Punch to open it.

name: Emerald Block
info: Wow, you get 5 emeralds for the price of 1!

name: Ruby Block
info: Considering the size, this is the most valuable ruby in existence. But it's only a video game.

name: Beach Blast
info: This magical object requires 100 Fireworks to detonate. It will create a brand new pristine beach world!

name: Coral
info: This is a very special breed of coral that survives just as well in and out of water.

name: Fireworks
info: Use this for a splendid celebration!  Or save it for more important things.

name: Summer Surprise
info: It's a box filled with summer excitement! Smash it with your friends.

name: Women's Swimsuit
info: Hop in the pool, it's warm!

name: Men's Swimsuit
info: Hop in the pool, it's warm!

name: Swim Fins
info: These aren't the best way to move on land, but they'll zoom you through water like a dolphin!

name: Beach Umbrella
info: If they had just let this palm tree live, you could've sat under that instead of a bunch of dead fronds.

name: Ocean Rock
info: It's the back side of the ocean! Or a lake, whatever.

name: Barky's Mask
info: A bit sweaty to wear during the dog days of summer. Sponsored by Barkbits.

name: Palm Tree
info: These seeds of course grow on a Palm Tree Tree. Which looks nothing like a Palm Tree.

name: Garbage
info: Yuck, man. I hope somebody cleans this up.

name: Wrought-Iron Fence
info: Whether you're making a classy manor or a haunted mansion, you can't go wrong with wrought-iron!

name: Velvet Rope
info: Show people where they need to go in style!

name: Sproingy Eyes
info: Don't worry, those aren't your real eyes, they're just plastic.

name: Cow
info: Moooooo. You can milk a cow once a day or so!

name: Milk
info: It does a body okay, though there are lower-fat ways to get calcium.

name: Calf Leash
info: Moo. This little baby cow will follow you everywhere you go!  Mainly because it's tied to your wrist.

name: Chicken
info: BAWK BAWK BAWK. Chickens will lay eggs for you about once a day!

name: Egg
info: Toss these all over, if you want to be a horrible vandal.

name: Chick Leash
info: Peep peep! This little baby chick will follow you everywhere you go! Mainly because it's tied to your wrist.

name: Piglet Leash
info: Oink oink! This little piglet will follow you everywhere you go! Mainly because it's tied to your wrist.

name: Wheat
info: You're not in Kansas anymore... but if you were, it'd pretty much look like this.

name: Butterfly Leash
info: Flap flap! This little butterfly will follow you everywhere you go! Mainly because it's tied to your wrist.

name: Barn Block
info: 'Tis a fine barn, but sure 'tis no pool, English.

name: Barn Door
info: Shut it! Were you raised in a barn?

name: Red Wood Wall
info: This wood is red, but it's not redwood, it's oak. It's just painted red.

name: Straw Hat
info: Keeps the sun off of you as you farm all the live-long day.

name: Overalls
info: You feel like you could whitewash fences all day in this getup, yes sir!

name: Pitchfork
info: Whether you're turning over hay, poking evildoers in the tukhus, or just eating incredibly large noodles, this is the tool for you.

name: Farmgirl Hair
info: I reckon ya'll oughtta whitewash that thar fence!

name: Dear John Tractor
info: Too lazy to push buttons to farm? The tractor will do it for you!

name: Dragon Hand
info: Call forth the `4Dragons of Legend``! Please be aware the legends may have been a bit exaggerated.

name: Shockinator
info: High voltage can lead to severe trauma and even, in extreme cases, frizzy hair.

name: Ze Goggles
info: Not recommended to protect your eyes from acid - Ze Goggles, they do nothing!

name: Shocking Hair
info: In the mad science business, electrocution is a constant hazard. The mad scientist Don King knows this well.

name: Enhanced Intellect
info: You're a serious show-off, you know that? Nobody needs to see this.

name: Laboratory
info: Drop three stacks of items on this, then punch it to attempt to process them into a fabulous new item! It can only mix exactly 3 stacks. Most combinations will do nothing, so experiment!

name: Chemical G
info: This is a highly toxic chemical. Do not ingest! Place carefully in a Laboratory to combine with other chemicals and create amazing new things.

name: Chemical R
info: This is a highly toxic chemical. Do not ingest! Place carefully in a Laboratory to combine with other chemicals and create amazing new things.

name: Chemical P
info: This is a highly toxic chemical. Do not ingest! Place carefully in a Laboratory to combine with other chemicals and create amazing new things.

name: Chemical B
info: This is a highly toxic chemical. Do not ingest! Place carefully in a Laboratory to combine with other chemicals and create amazing new things.

name: Mysterious Chemical
info: This recently-discovered formulation is incredibly dangerous! Do not even LOOK AT IT. Place carefully in a Laboratory to combine with other chemicals and create amazing new things.

name: Chemical Y
info: This is a highly toxic chemical. Do not ingest! Place carefully in a Laboratory to combine with other chemicals and create amazing new things.

name: Steel Table
info: Stack a bunch of these in a row to make a table as long as you want!

name: Science Station
info: The ideal station for performing SCIENCE! You can collect experimental results about twice a day.

name: Death Ray
info: For safety reasons, we've had to disable the "Death" portion of this device. It is pretty hard on blocks, though.

name: Weather Machine - Sunny
info: Punch this to enjoy the wonderful Growtopian weather. Not much use most of the time. This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: Weather Machine - Night
info: Night is arguably the most common form of weather. Seems like every evening, a dark front just rolls right in. This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: Red Bones
info: Oddly, Redbone's skull is bigger than his head.

name: Desert Blast
info: Use this astounding device to create an entirely new desert world. One free pyramid included.

name: Boulder
info: It's like a rock, but dirtier.

name: Weather Machine - Arid
info: It's amazing how a little change in the weather can completely reshape the mountains! This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: Scoreboard
info: Punch it to see the top worlds of the day! This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: E-Z Cook Oven
info: If science isn't pink enough for you, then mix your chemicals in here! For SCIENCE!

name: Sugar Cane
info: The sweetest stalk of grass you'll ever chew!

name: Dough
info: D'oh! This is raw!  What can we do with it?

name: Habanero Cheese Bread
info: It's a spicy gooey treat! Watch out though, it's really hot.

name: Tomato
info: Express your displeasure with a performance in vegetable form!

name: Pizza
info: I'll have the Supreme With Cheese!

name: Apple Pie
info: The most delicious incarnation of the humble apple.

name: Cheeseburger
info: You're really not using all the parts of the animal, are you?

name: Silver Idol
info: Some speak of an ancient curse placed on this idol. Others speak of a free frogurt. Who knows what to believe anymore?

name: Ancient Stone Gate
info: What could lurk behind such a barrier? Ancient secrets? Cursed mummies? Perhaps a stash of purple blocks.

name: Obelisk
info: Punching this mystical stone makes it pulse with dark energy...

name: Sungate
info: This alien artifact can teleport you to distant worlds, but only if it's charged with the power of 7 Obelisks first.

name: Slime
info: Yuck, this stuff is slippery and gross!

name: Profile
info: Tap this to check out your own personal info!

name: Achievement Block
info: Only usable in a world-locked world. Use your wrench to etch any achievement you've earned into it! Only the owner of the World Lock can etch it.

name: Weather Machine - Rainy City
info: It's just another rainy night... without you, jet city woman. This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: Street Sign
info: The classic method of identifying streets. Use your Wrench on it to change the message.

name: Gargoyle
info: Gargoyles just love hanging out, man.

name: Gothic Building
info: The perfect perch for a gargoyle.

name: Sidewalk
info: Most of this is actually bricks, but there's a little bit of sidewalk at the top!

name: Tenement Building
info: It's not the nicest place to live, especially since you can't even enter it anyway.

name: Fire Escape
info: This meets all safety standards. I mean, you know, pretty much. Well, it looks safe to me at least. Maybe not safe exactly... more like non-lethal. Well, not always lethal. Lethal on occasion?

name: Fire Hydrant
info: These are surprisingly bouncy. Hold Jump as you land for maximum bounce.

name: Hedge
info: Neatly trimmed, to keep the neighborhood tidy.

name: Blue Mailbox
info: You've got mail! People can write you private messages with this.

name: ATM Machine
info: Your very own Automated teller machine...machine. This device is not FDIC insured. It does, however, spit out a random number of gems about once a day!

name: Destructo Ray
info: Dr. Destructo's unstoppable beam of annihilation.

name: Stick Horse
info: Clop clop clop.  Coconuts not included.

name: Tumbleweed Attractor
info: Static electricity in this bracelet draws tumbleweeds towards you. One, at least.

name: Six Shooter
info: Did I shoot five bullets or six? Doesn't much matter, since in Growtopia you can just keep shooting forever!

name: Tiny Appaloosa
info: It's possible this is actually a dalmation, but you can still ride it! It's faster than walking.

name: Parasol
info: The dainty way to slow your fall! Hold the jump button while falling to keep the parasol open.

name: Cowboy Hat
info: Yeehaw! Git along little horsies which may be doggies!

name: War Paint
info: Strike fear into the hearts of your enemies, until they realize you just put your lipstick on really badly.

name: Face Bandana
info: When you don't want anyone to recognize your chin, this is the perfect disguise.

name: Sheriff's Vest
info: Round up the badguys with this enduring symbol of authority. Comes with adorable kerchief.

name: Cowboy Boots
info: We've attached specialized Safety Spurs to these boots, so you don't hurt anybody. Please respect other peoples' ankles.

name: Kansas Curls
info: These lovely golden locks make you look like a right purty damsel.

name: Corset
info: Feeling fat? You could exercise... or you could just cram your gut into one of these! Oh sure, you may end up with spinal deformities, but beauty demands pain!

name: Layer Cake Dress
info: Your girl. She's not very good. She made you a dress that looks like you bought it in a store.

name: Western Building
info: This isn't a real building, it's just a painted piece of plywood.

name: Saloon Doors
info: When you really need to make an entrance, you can slam these open. Just don't get shot doing it.

name: Western Banner
info: I don't know what language this is, but they spoke it in the old west.

name: Buffalo
info: You really don't want a home where these guys roam. You can milk a buffalo once a day or so!

name: Rustic Fence
info: This is an ideal place to lean while chewing on straw and saying "Yep." It also keeps animals in place.

name: Campfire
info: Gather round and sing songs of days of yore...

name: Secret Of Growtopia
info: On this paper is scrawled a deep secret of Growtopia. But to read the mystic scrawls, you must throw the paper to the winds! I don't know, that's just how it works. One of those secrets of Growtopia, I guess.

name: Transmog Crystal
info: This mysterious crystal has the power to transform one object into another, but only in the fiery furnace of a Laboratory or E-Z Cook Oven.

name: Chinese Lantern
info: A soothing dim light for evening festivities. You can punch this to turn it on or off.

name: Songpyeon
info: This sweet steamed rice cake is said to lead to a bright future for whoever eats it. Eat up! You can also mix it with Mooncakes in a Laboratory or E-Z Cook Oven to create special Harvest Festival items.

name: Harmony Mooncake
info: This pastry is filled with a sweet bean paste. "Harmony" is imprinted on the top in ancient Growtopian script. Mix this with other Mooncakes in a Laboratory or E-Z Cook Oven to create special Harvest Festival items.

name: Harvest Moon Blast
info: This amazing lunar device will create a new world with a unique harvest moon background, filled with random trees ready to harvest!

name: Ultra Grow Spray
info: Spray a tree to instantly grow it to full size! Can only grow 30 day's growth at the most, but that's longer than almost any item takes.

name: Scarecrow
info: Notice how there are NO crows around? This thing is working!

name: Sky Lantern
info: Release this lantern into the wind to celebrate the harvest!

name: Hand Scythe
info: This creepy blade can chop down trees with great precision - you'll get twice as much fruit! The only downside is that it's highly likely to break when used. It has no effect (but won't break either!) on trees of rarity 100 or more.

name: Yellow Hanbok Top
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Purple Hanbok Top
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Green Hanbok Top
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Pink Hanbok Skirt
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Blue Hanbok Skirt
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Orange Hanbok Skirt
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Yellow Hanbok Pants
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Purple Hanbok Pants
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Green Hanbok Pants
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Festival Hair Bun
info: Classy and festive at the same time.

name: Gat
info: This style of hat is cleverly strapped to your head so it won't blow away.

name: Peace Mooncake
info: This pastry is filled with a sweet bean paste. "Peace" is imprinted on the top in ancient Growtopian script. Mix this with other Mooncakes in a Laboratory or E-Z Cook Oven to create special Harvest Festival items.

name: Longevity Mooncake
info: This pastry is filled with a sweet bean paste. "Longevity" is imprinted on the top in ancient Growtopian script. Mix this with other Mooncakes in a Laboratory or E-Z Cook Oven to create special Harvest Festival items.

name: Prosperity Mooncake
info: This pastry is filled with a sweet bean paste. "Prosperity" is imprinted on the top in ancient Growtopian script. Mix this with other Mooncakes in a Laboratory or E-Z Cook Oven to create special Harvest Festival items.

name: Pillar
info: Add a touch of class to your architecture! Also, keep it from falling down.

name: Sequoia Tree
info: These massive trees live for thousands of years. Please don't punch them.

name: Foliage
info: You can't see the forest for this stuff.

name: Amphora
info: This ancient greek vase could be filled with just about anything! But my bet is on gems and possibly a seed.

name: Potted Daisy
info: This daisy is in a pot. Pretty simple, really.

name: Dragon Tail
info: We warned you to stay away from the toxic waste barrels.

name: Clown Shoes
info: You want respect, you gotta EARN it. Or wear these shoes. BAM, instant respect.

name: Clown Pants
info: They come complete with suspenders! Which is a good thing, since they're a BIT big.

name: Foam Finger
info: If you wear this, then YOU'RE #1! YOU'RE #1! YOU'RE #1!

name: Mars Rock
info: This is a rock from Mars.

name: Mars Blast
info: This amazing device will create a new world... Mars, to be exact!

name: Martian Tree
info: I planted a tree, and it grew up so big, it grew two sizes up from an extra-large Squig! The tree had blue puffs at the end of each branch, so under the puffs we did the Zorbity Dance!

name: Astronaut Pack
info: This contains all the essentials you need for a successful extravehicular activity trip, including a book of sudoku. It also makes you jump like you're on the moon.

name: Space Suit
info: Multiple layers offer protection against cold, vacuum, radiation, and parasitic alien infestation. Of course it's also sleeveless, so....?

name: Space Pants
info: A space suit isn't going to protect you very well if you don't put on the pants too.

name: Moon Boots
info: It's just one small step for a Growtopian, one giant leap for Growtopia.

name: Astronaut Helmet
info: Now you can be one of those creepy astronauts with a chrome-plated face, where nobody knows who you are and what you're up to.

name: Zorbnik Leash
info: ZYERBLRB! This little zorbnik will follow you everywhere you go! Mainly because it's tied to your wrist.

name: Zorbnik DNA
info: You can't do much with just some Zorbnik DNA... unless you collect 10 Zorbnik DNA and use them all together, that is.

name: Space Connector
info: Got things in space you want to stick together? Nothing works better than a space connector.

name: White Wallpaper
info: It's a White Block squished flat!

name: Black Wallpaper
info: It's a Black Block squished flat!

name: Porthole
info: Wow, the view from up here is simply amazing!

name: Forcefield
info: This directed energy field has the power to function as solid matter for people who aren't invited, while being completely permeable to anyone else.  I guess that makes it a door.

name: Compu Panel
info: This technology is incredibly advanced - you could run an entire starship on this Compu Panel! If you had any idea what any of the buttons did.

name: Vampire Cape
info: This cape imparts mystical powers upon its wearer.

name: Slick Black Hair
info: You must have a really greasy pillow.

name: Vampire Fangs
info: Wearing these impedes lip movement just enough to induce a Transylvanian accent.

name: Vamp Vest
info: Looks like you won the gold medal in bloodsucking!

name: Rollback Plaque II
info: You were there, man. You were THERE when time rolled backwards again and all the fruits of your labors turned to dust in your dry, bitter fist. Oct 2013

name: Skeletal Horsie
info: Did you forget to feed your horse again?

name: Spiritual Resonator
info: This miraculous device allows you to commune with spirits from the Other Side.

name: Hockey Mask
info: Surely you're just a big sports fan... right?  Right?

name: Mummy Mask
info: It's hard to speak through these bandages!

name: Wolfman Mask
info: The fun bonus is that you can take this off, and then you're wearing your "daytime wolfman mask".  It's almost 2 masks in one!

name: Black Cat Leash
info: Mrow! The bad thing about wearing this leash is that you end up with a black cat constantly crossing your path.

name: Creepy Hair
info: Your hair's such a mess, you look like you just stepped out of a TV.

name: Haunted House
info: Is it just your imagination... or are the walls actually stretching?

name: Jack O' Lantern
info: I think this pumpkin is haunted... when you punch it, spooky music comes out!

name: Pumpkin Block
info: This pumpkin was grown inside a square box.

name: Jack O' Block
info: This pumpkin was grown inside a square box, and then carved up.

name: Lit Jack O' Block
info: This pumpkin was grown inside a square box, and then carved up, and then had a lit candle put inside.

name: Focused Eyes
info: These eyes are a bit shocking.

name: Devil Wings
info: You don't jump higher than with normal wings, but man, you do look pretty cool.

name: Candy Corn
info: Every year, they collect all the uneaten Candy Corn and store it again, to be given out the next year.

name: Weather Machine - Spooky
info: Darkness falls across the land... The midnight hour is close at hand...

name: Lock of Black Fur
info: Not much by itself, but if you had 25 of these, I bet you could mush them together into something pretty good! Or a gross hairball.

name: Familiar Leash
info: Mrow HISS! This black cat contains the very essence of dark magic. Unfortunately, it's a cat, so you can't get it to use the magic for you.

name: Cultist Hood
info: You look a little shady in this thing...

name: Cultist Robe
info: Just the thing to worship Growganoth in!

name: Sigil Of K'Tesh
info: Unlike the Sigil of John Tesh, which is smooth and jazzy, this arcane emblem grants you favor with Growganoth. Sadly, that means it will teleport you directly into his gaping maw.

name: Creepstone Platform
info: These stones were mined in an alternate dimension where rocks float in the air.

name: Disabled Platform
info: A Creepstone Platform turned off. Not for players.

name: Evil Eye
info: Don't let it look at you! Luckily, it is very near-sighted, so you'd have to actually touch it for it to see you. Which would kill you, by the way.

name: Frankenhair
info: Did you stick your finger in a light socket?

name: Sonar Bracelet
info: Meep meep! This bracelet attracts bats. Well, A bat.

name: Devil Wing Fragment
info: This is about half of a Devil Wing. So if you had four of these, you could make a pair of Devil Wings!

name: Boney Block
info: They're not fat, they're just big-boned!

name: Heart Monitor
info: Place this device and anybody can watch it to see if you are online! Or alive. Note: it can't actually tell if you're alive. But it will beep if you are online!

name: Scrub Cap
info: Keep your hair out of your eyes while performing surgery with this sterile cap.

name: Scrub Top
info: Special sterilized clothes, for chopping folks up!

name: Scrub Pants
info: Even your knees need to be kept sterile when you are operating.

name: Magnifying Glass
info: This has over 10,000,000x magnification, allowing you to clearly see the virus that is ... wait, is that virus following you around? RUN!

name: Retro Magnifying Glass
info: This has over 10,000,000x magnification, allowing you to clearly see the retrovirus that is totally grooving on your vibes.

name: Hospital Bed
info: Lay in this bed and one of our doctors will see to you as soon as possible.

name: Surgical Sponge
info: Used only in surgery. If you make a mess, a sponge can suck it up easily!

name: Surgical Scalpel
info: Used only in surgery. Use this to cut people open!

name: Surgical Anesthetic
info: Used only in surgery. You probably don't want to operate on somebody unless they are unconscious. Use this to knock them out!

name: Surgical Antiseptic
info: Used only in surgery. Don't mix this up with Anesthetic!  This is used for cleaning an area before you cut it open.

name: Surgical Antibiotics
info: Used only in surgery. If someone gets an infection, antibiotics should clear it up.

name: Surgical Splint
info: Used only in surgery. If somebody has a broken bone, you better splint it up or it'll heal all crooked.

name: Surgical Stitches
info: Used only in surgery. Bandages are included too, for lesser injuries. Use these to close up after performing surgery, or repair existing cuts and bleeding.

name: Ambulance
info: For the sake of your fellow Growtopians, we limited the siren. But you can still enjoy the flashing lights!

name: Edison Zoomster
info: Only the chief of surgery can afford a speedy electric car like this!

name: Punch Jammer
info: When activated (punch to activate), this prevents people from punching each other in your world.

name: Zombie Jammer
info: When activated (punch to activate), this prevents zombies from infecting anyone in your world.

name: Birth Certificate
info: A little white-out, a little scribbling, and voila, you'll have a new name! Use this item to change your GrowID permanently. Can only be used once every 60 days. Requires a GrowID. Is consumed when used.

name: Candy Striper Cap
info: Red wig included. And stapled on.

name: Candy Striper Uniform
info: I wonder where on earth this nurse's uniform gets its name from...

name: Candy Striper Skirt
info: This is also nice if you want to work at the kind of burger restaurant that requires Pieces of Flair from its wait staff.

name: Hospital Curtain
info: This helps maintain your privacy when you are undergoing delicate medical procedures.

name: Hospital Wall
info: The soothing pale yellow tone and complete lack of anything interesting helps speed healing and make people want to get out of there.

name: Hospital Window
info: Looking out at nature is supposed to help you recover.

name: Hospital Door
info: This door is designed to be easy to push open when you're rolling a body around on a cart. Place one and then use your Wrench on it to set the destination.

name: Surgical Gloves
info: This item doesn't really exist, just using its icon for surgery menu.

name: Cutaway Building
info: If you want to make an interior view of a building, you can use these blocks to show the walls and floors!

name: Roshambo Block
info: Punch it to roll Rock, Paper, or Scissors.  What you do with the resulting information is entirely up to you!

name: Cow Cube
info: This cow is squarer than most.

name: Staircase
info: Sometimes it's nice to climb a staircase instead of hopping up platforms. Unfortunately, you'll also have to hop up the staircase - Growtopians can't climb.

name: Terracotta Pot
info: You should plant your trees in these.  It's just classier.

name: Climbing Vine
info: These vines can grow to extraordinary heights.  Provided you place Climbing Vine blocks up to extraordinary heights.

name: Thingamajig
info: I have no idea what this thing does. It's something electronic? Maybe?

name: Bushy Beard
info: You look like you should be in charge of magical animals with this beard.

name: Ponytail
info: Unlike an actual pony, your tail grows out of the back of your head.

name: Happy Sun Shirt
info: Take joy in the great glowing orb that provides energy for all those toilet trees to grow!

name: Blue Sun Shirt
info: "Well, what you plan and what takes place ain't ever exactly been similar."

name: Riding Raptor
info: I know, they're supposed to have feathers and stuff nowadays... Well, this is an old-school raptor!

name: Cliffside
info: If your friends all jumped off of this, would you?

name: Rock Platform
info: It's like a Wooden Platform that's been sitting outside since prehistoric times.

name: Cave Entrance
info: Who knows what lurks inside? I guess whoever placed it and used a wrench on it to set the destination.

name: Prehistoric Palm
info: Much like people, palm trees started out short and squat before evolving to be tall and skinny. Unlike palm trees, people then ate Twinkies and watched TV until they were tubby again.

name: Caveman Club
info: We've come a long way in methods of settling disputes, but this technique still works.

name: Sabertooth-Skin Toga
info: Clothing so stylish it'll make you shout "Rabble Dabble Goo!" - you know, to make sure you don't get sued.

name: Caveman Hair
info: The chicken grease helps the bone stay in, and it adds luster.

name: Cavewoman Hair
info: The chicken grease helps the bone stay in, and it adds luster.

name: Fuzzy Bikini Top
info: Is it for cold weather or warm weather? Who knows! It's the world's smallest parka.

name: Ice Cube
info: This is very ancient ice, chipped from a glacier. Don't just use it to cool your drink!

name: Frozen DNA Fragment A
info: Hey, there's some prehistoric DNA stuck in this ice! Most likely you'd ruin it by punching it. But maybe there's a chance...

name: Frozen DNA Fragment B
info: Hey, there's some prehistoric DNA stuck in this ice! Most likely you'd ruin it by punching it. But maybe there's a chance...

name: Mini Mammoth Leash
info: The word "mammoth" has really lost all meaning at this point.

info: I have no idea what this thing does. It's something electronic? Maybe?

name: Winter Gift

name: Candy Cane Fence
info: This fence is terrible for keeping kids off of your lawn.

name: Weather Machine - Snowy
info: Man, the weather outside is frightful!

name: Dumb Friend

name: Snowball

name: Festivus Pole
info: Tinsel is so distracting. Celebrate with an unadorned aluminum pole.

name: Giant Candle

name: Tangyuan
