name: Yeonnalligi
info: Fly this colorful kite to ring in the new year!

name: Ice Dragon Hand
info: Another of the `4Dragons of Legend``! Please be aware the legends may have been a bit exaggerated.

name: Antler Hat
info: The red checkers alert other hunters not to shoot you, but the antlers make you a prime target. We've scientifically designed this hat to ensure that your odds of being shot remain precisely the same as if you weren't wearing it. Note: `4Wearing this also makes guns and bows kill you!``

name: Glowing Nose
info: Warning: wearing this could result in exclusion from reindeer games.

name: Buckskin Hood
info: So warm and toasty! It's like you sliced open a deer and crawled inside.

name: Buckskin Jacket
info: So warm and toasty! It's like you sliced open a deer and crawled inside.

name: Holiday Gift Box
info: People can drop gifts into this box for you to pickup later!

name: Buckskin Pants
info: So warm and toasty! It's like you sliced open a deer and crawled inside.

name: Polar Bear Leash
info: If you look out your window and see this guy, you are looking south. Or at a zoo. Or at somebody playing Growtopia.

name: Doohickey
info: I have no idea what this thing does. It's something electronic? Maybe?

name: Inviso-Block
info: These blocks cannot be seen. Thus they cannot be used by players, because that would be a nightmare.

name: Mini Growtopian
info: Ah, he just wants to tag along!

name: Thermonuclear Blast
info: Use this fabulous device to create a brand new world that is completely empty, except for bedrock and a white door.

name: Door Mover
info: Use this fabulous device anywhere in a world you have world-locked to move the White Door to a new location.  There must be an empty space where you tap and another empty space below it for this to work.

name: Skyrocket
info: Celebrate the holidays by firing off colorful rockets!

name: Mannequin
info: Dress up your mannequin with clothes! Use your Wrench to change the sign on it.

name: Display Box
info: Drop items for sale in these handy boxes!  `3Only players with access to the lock can pick them up!``

name: World Key
info: If you trade this to another player while in a world that you own, they will become the owner of your World Lock!  Use it to trade worlds safely.

name: For Sale Sign
info: Tell people what you're selling! Use your Wrench on it to change the message.

name: Gem Sign
info: Say something about Gems on this sign.  I guess? Use your Wrench on it to change the message.

name: Shop Sign
info: Let everyone know you're running a shop! Use your Wrench on it to change the message.

name: Exclamation Sign
info: Excited about something?  Let people know! Use your Wrench on it to change the message.

name: Cash Register
info: Punch it to ring up a sale!

name: Security Camera
info: This camera will watch your world and keep a record of everybody who enters! You may have up to 8 of these in a world.

name: Golden Pickaxe
info: This tool, made to honor Diichaan's service as a moderator, is worth more than the stuff you mine with it!

name: Evil Space Helmet
info: Found in a teeny-tiny spaceship, this helmet is surprisingly normal-sized. What brave star traveler could have worn this?

name: Frosty Hair
info: Brr! This shivering style is only for the coldest of the cold. Whoever created it must have been a chilly soul indeed - where could they be now?

name: Open Sign
info: You can punch this to switch it between Open and Closed! Let people know if you're around.

name: Television
info: Yes kids, TVs really used to look like this! And they didn't have color screens! And they showed westerns! GET OFF OF MY LAWN!

name: Couch
info: Just the thing to watch your TV on. Except your TV can only face the opposite direction.

name: Donation Box
info: People can drop gifts into this box for you to pickup later!

name: Gold Chain
info: I pity the fool who doesn't wear a set of these.

name: Golden Heart Crystal
info: This crystal can be combined with 200 Candy Hearts and any Valentine's Clothing in a Laboratory or E-Z Cook Oven to infuse the clothing with golden magic!

name: Golden Angel Wings
info: Better than a Halo, these will actually let you double jump! Plus they're shiny!

name: Golden Diaper
info: If you find yourself lost in a world without any Toilet Seeds, you'll be glad you have this. Plus it's shiny!

name: Golden Heartbow
info: Once used by Cupid himself, this bow shoots golden hearts! You can yank other players toward you with it. Plus it's shiny!

name: Golden Diamond Necklace
info: Sparkles with the undying light of eternal love. Plus it's shiny!

name: Emerald Necklace
info: Emeralds are May's birthstone. This particular one is lab-created, which you'd think is less classy, but they're much prettier.

name: Ruby Necklace
info: It's a red rock on a metal string. But I guess people like that!

name: Microwave
info: This is a quick and handy way to cook food. Or do SCIENCE!

name: Eggs Benedict
info: Eating these makes you smarter, so you can get more eggs-perience! `2Food Buff:`` 25% chance of double XP from all actions.

name: Window Curtains
info: It's curtains for these windows! Lacy, gently wafting curtains.

name: Wall Clock
info: Tell time in Growtopia! This clock displays the current Growtopia Time for you.

name: Atomic Shadow Scythe
info: So sharp it can slice atoms, this scythe is part shadow and all malice. The first person to wield it must have been very, very evil.

name: Growtoken
info: You can earn these from Crazy Jim and Sales-Man - try dialing 12345 or 53785 on your Telephone for details! Spend them in the store on special items! If you have 100 Growtokens, you can tap them in your inventory to combine them into a Mega Growtoken!

name: Experience Potion
info: Drink this fizzy potion to gain 10,000 XP instantly! Only works on yourself, no pouring it down other peoples' throats.

name: Weather Machine - Nothingness
info: Punch this to eradicate all light from the universe. This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: Doodad
info: I have no idea what this thing does. It's something electronic? Maybe?

name: ERROR!
info: Please contact support to fix this item!

name: Rushboard
info: Just like they predicted, we finally have hoverboards in 2014! Well, virtual ones.

name: Purple Stuff
info: Yuck, purple stuff?! I'd rather drink imitation orange beverage.

name: Orange Stuff
info: On second thought, orange stuff seems kinda gross too. But you can freeze it into a lovely block.

name: Winter Scarf
info: This scarf is made of fuzzy aquamarine yarn with little sparklies in it. It's tres chic.

name: Old-Timey Hat
info: If you're a grizzled old prospector, this is surely the hat for you. Also useful for hard-boiled reporters who always get their story.

name: Medical Scarf
info: These elaborate scarves may only be worn by medical professionals (or anyone else with the title "Doctor").

name: Blarney Stone
info: Players that touch this get a Blarney Pebble.

name: Blarney Pebble
info: The legend goes that if you gather up ten of these pebbles, you can charm a leprechaun to be your friend!

name: Pet Leprechaun
info: He's hidden a pot of gold somewhere... but you'll never find it!

name: Black-Rimmed Glasses
info: These stylish glasses can be custom matched to any prescription.

name: Diving Bell
info: Protect yourself from the crushing pressures of the great deep in this steel helmet. Of course, if you wear a normal wetsuit, you could end up sucked up into the helmet and crushed to death. So, you know, watch for that.

name: Great White Shark
info: They say a shark can never stop swimming, but this particular shark can never stop swimming in place.

name: Jellyfish
info: Beware of the painful sting of this sea creature! Also beware of the folk remedies for fixing it...

name: Wetsuit Pants
info: Lay off the donuts, because these things are skin-tight!

name: Wetsuit Top
info: Lay off the donuts, because this thing is skin-tight!

name: Sunken Anchor
info: I guess a ship somewhere is flying free, never to settle down in one place again.

name: Giant Clam
info: Store your treasures inside by dropping them! When it's closed, the items are hidden. Punch to open it.

name: Undersea Blast
info: Use this astounding device to create an entirely new undersea world. Water included!

name: Cuddly Piranha
info: He just won't stay in his bowl because he LIKES YOU. This is one fish you'll never forget to feed!

name: Deep Sand
info: This sand is all mucked up with gross deep ocean stuff.

name: Deep Rock
info: It's like a rock, but deeper.

name: Mid-Pacific Owl
info: This friendly pet owl will fall asleep on your head if you don't keep him entertained! Dedicated to the students of the Mid-Pacific Institute.

name: Battle Trout
info: Why, it's a dead fish. And you're holding it. Oooookayyyy.

name: Green Pageboy
info: This is NOT a helmet, don't call it a helmet! But if you want to use it as a helmet, go ahead. It's hair though.

name: Easter Bonnet
info: This fashionable accessory matches ANY outfit with style.

name: Bubble Wings
info: With a pair of wings, you can double-jump! With these wings, you can also bubble.

name: Pet Bunny
info: bunny bunny bunny bunny bunny bunny

name: Lucky Pinata Hat
info: Not only is this hat festive and suitable for formal occasions, but wearing it when you break an Ultra Pinata will reward you with a personal gift from The Great Burro!

name: Mariachi Guitar
info: When you /dance with this, you can perform for your friends!

name: Churro Block
info: The sweetest of blocks - crispy, chewy, cinnamony, delicious.

name: Fiesta Dragon
info: This ferocious beast spews deadly PARTY at your enemies.

name: Party Cactus
info: A dangerously happenin' plant! Do not touch.

name: Burrito
info: Mmmm, rolled up food. Who cares what's inside? There's a TORTILLA!

name: Pink Cadillac
info: There's nothing quite like cruising the Vegas strip in a pink Cadillac!

name: Mystery Pinata
info: Put this on top of a bunch of items you want to give away. Once placed, anybody can break it and get the items! The mystery is that certain items will transform into something more festive when it explodes...

name: Pet Burrito
info: So fuzzy! This is not to be eaten.

name: Clapboard
info: The loud clacking sound this can produce is useful for syncing up audio with video. We've silenced this particular one for the sake of the other players.

name: 3D Glasses
info: It's like Growtopia is COMING RIGHT AT YOU!

name: Theater Curtain
info: Raise it up and start the show! Note: You can't raise it up.

name: GHX Speaker
info: The audience is listening. And possibly being deafened.

name: Marquee Block
info: Put your name up on the lights! Letters not included, but hey, there's lights.

name: Director's Chair
info: Sit down and tell everybody what to do.

name: Mint Julep
info: Mmm, minty! With a hint of julep. Go horsey go!!

name: Movie Screen
info: Today's movie is entitled "The Polar Bear In A Snowstorm What Found A Piece Of Paper". It's an art film.

name: Movie Camera
info: Film your own youtube videos! By using some sort of screen capture program, that is. This completely fake camera isn't going to help at all.

name: Red Glass Block
info: People inside this should not throw stones, and they will be tinted red.

name: Blue Glass Block
info: People inside this should not throw stones, and they will be tinted blue.

name: Growie Award
info: Congratulations! Your film has been selected as the best picture of the week! Or you just bought this trophy from someone else like a common peasant.

name: Staging Platform
info: If a player stands on this, they have first priority on joining a Game. Use your wrench to set which team this platform will assign them to!

name: Game Block
info: Use your wrench to set which team this block belongs to! During a Game, the block can be smashed according to the Game rules, and it will rebuild after the game ends.

name: Busted Game Block
info: This Game Block has been smashed.  It will rebuild when the Game is over.

name: Game Flag
info: Use your wrench to set which team this flag belongs to! During a Game, players can steal enemy flags and deliver them to their own Game Goals.

name: Missing Game Flag
info: This flag has been taken. It will return when the Game is over.

name: Carried Game Flag
info: A flag being carried by a player.

name: Coffee Maker
info: These special slow-roasted beans are roasted so slowly that you can only get a cup of coffee once a day!

name: Coffee
info: This'll put some pep in your step! And some verve in your nerve! But not that much pizzazz in your jazz.

name: Awkward Friendly Unicorn
info: This unicorn is going through an awkward stage right now, but it's happy to be your friend. It'll even give you a present about once a week!

name: Unicorn Horn
info: This pretty much rules out the possibility of hats, but it's so glowy!

name: Very Bad Unicorn
info: This is the kind of unicorn your parents warned you about.

name: Horse Mask
info: These things are just creepy. I don't get the appeal.

name: Unicorn Jumper
info: A gift from your friendly neighborhood unicorn!

name: Happy Unicorn Block
info: This block is happy, and prominently features a unicorn.

name: Unicorn Garland
info: This magical garland from the mystic land of Unicornopianialandburg joins your soul with that of a unicorn. Great for you, but for the unicorn it's pretty much slavery. Not cool, dude.

name: Pink Hair
info: Oh, is that your natural color?

name: Aqua Hair
info: It takes a liberal dose of Aqua Net to make it look like this.

name: Evil Brick Background
info: Thankfully, these Evil Bricks are further away than the usual kind.

name: Game Grave
info: Use your wrench to set which team this block belongs to! During a Game, players of that team will respawn here.

name: Game Goal
info: Use your wrench to set which team this block belongs to! During a Game, you may want to bring Flags here, or just reach here yourself, depending on the rules.

name: Game Generator
info: This machine generates games for people to play! Use your wrench on it to set up the game rules and start the game.

name: Spike Juice
info: By carefully drinking small amounts of Death Spikes, you can build up a tolerance! Well, what you can actually do is be immune to Lava and Death Spikes for 5 seconds.

name: Barbecue Grill
info: It's summertime, why do your cooking indoors? Also, you can mix chemicals in here. I'm sure that's perfectly safe.

name: Sea Monster Floatie
info: Blow it up and take a swim!

name: Water Wings
info: Not a strong swimmer? Strap these on so at least your arms will stay above water as you drown.

name: Summer Kite
info: Fly this colorful kite to celebrate summertime!

name: Rainbow Wings
info: Somewhere over the rainbow is a Growtopian, flapping away. These let you double jump. Sponsored by Oricho and Oriche.

name: Phoenix Wings
info: Is it hot in here, or is it just you? These wings let you double jump, and there are only 500 of them in existence! Don't throw them away!

name: Squirt Gun
info: Squirt your friends with this usually harmless weapon! Or load it with hydrochloric acid and use it to dissolve metal, it works equally well. Longer range than normal punches, but less damage.

name: Sandcastle
info: Enjoy it while you can, before the tide comes in.

name: Super Fireworks
info: This Omega-class firework is actually illegal in all countries. All of them. LAUNCH IT ANYWAY!!! Like cereal, it comes with a special prize inside. Note: it will use up 200 Fireworks from your inventory to ignite the Saturn V thruster it uses.

name: Gateway To Adventure
info: You can set this door up like a Choose Your Own Adventure story! Type up to 5 lines of story, and then add up to 5 buttons for players to choose from, with Door IDs that they lead to.

name: Path Marker
info: Use these sort of like Doors - They have IDs, so Doors can lead to them, though you can't travel from them. Use your wrench to set their ID.

name: Safari Jacket
info: The comfortable fit you need to run away from giant rolling boulders.

name: Jodhpurs
info: Does these pants make my butt look fat?

name: Adventuring Mustache
info: Wot wot too right tally ho jolly good ermf ermf

name: Adventure Item - Rope
info: Place this in your world to be used in your Gateways To Adventure! Players can pick it up by punching it. They lose it if they leave your world.

name: Adventure Item - Key
info: Place this in your world to be used in your Gateways To Adventure! Players can pick it up by punching it. They lose it if they leave your world.

name: Adventure Item - Golden Idol
info: Place this in your world to be used in your Gateways To Adventure! Players can pick it up by punching it. They lose it if they leave your world.

name: Adventure Item - Banana
info: Place this in your world to be used in your Gateways To Adventure! Players can pick it up by punching it. They lose it if they leave your world.

name: Adventure Item - Torch
info: Place this in your world to be used in your Gateways To Adventure! Players can pick it up by punching it. They lose it if they leave your world.

name: Explorer's Ponytail
info: This sensible hairstyle minimizes the number of cobwebs that stick to you when exploring ancient tombs. The glasses also help you avoid them in the first place.

name: Lazy Cobra
info: This species features the deadliest venom of any snake in the world, capable of instantly killing a Growtopian. This is counterbalanced by the fact that it is too lazy to pursue prey at all, simply waiting for people to walk up and touch it.

name: Explorer's Shovel
info: This is not a whole lot different from a garden shovel, but holding it makes you feel adventurous. It also lets you dig faster than you can by punching dirt. I still don't get why punching dirt works at all.

name: Keytar
info: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play music. If you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Piano Note plays.

name: Bass Guitar
info: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play music. If you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Bass Note plays.

name: Tambourine
info: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play drums. If you punch to your left or right, you can play different drums. Punch in your own column to play the same drums that Sheet Music: Drums plays.

name: Starchild Makeup
info: You came down from a distant planet, to conquer the Earth with the power of ROCK.

name: Shredded T-Shirt
info: This shirt isn't ruined, it's COOL.

name: Leopard Leggings
info: These are the easiest pants to do leaping splits in, if that happens to be important to you. I mean, you might as well jump. Go ahead and jump.

name: Drumkit
info: You're a rock star. Smack this to pound out some sick beats.

name: Rock N' Roll Wallpaper
info: It's like your wallpaper is on fire, in the dark. WHOOOOOOOOOoooooo!

name: Stage Support
info: Use these to build your stage for the ultimate rock show.

name: Mega Rock Speaker
info: Your world doesn't have enough voltage to actually power speakers of this size, but they sure LOOK loud!

name: Rockin' Headband
info: When you rock, you sweat. Soak it up!

name: Knight Helmet
info: This helmet was forged by the awesome art god Hamumu. Sponsored by Knightmare.

name: Crystal Cape
info: Though less flexible than your average cape, this is a whole lot sparklier. Allows you to double jump off of an imaginary Crystal Block. Sponsored by Edvoid20, HemeTems, and Aboge.

name: StarBoard
info: Just like they predicted, we finally have hoverboards in 2014! Well, virtual ones. Sponsored by Miwsky, Chudy, and Dawid.

name: Puppy Leash
info: Berf! This little puppy is modeled after Hamumu's dog Mia, and can also be found in the fabulous smash hit Flash game Mia's Happy Day! Go play it!

name: Brown Wallpaper
info: It's a Brown Block squashed flat at last!

name: Fuel Pack
info: This backpack contains volatile fuels you can use to power a flamethrower!

name: Flamethrower
info: The deadliest weapon in Growtopia! The downside is that you need to wear a Fuel Pack to use it, and it uses up 1 Fuel Pack for every single punch. KILL IT WITH FIRE!

name: Weather Machine - Warp Speed
info: This machine will send your entire world hurtling through space at warp speed. This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: Guestbook
info: Lets people communicate by leaving messages to each other.

name: Flatscreen TV
info: This tasteful TV hangs on your wall like a picture. A picture that moves and sings!

name: Tiger Block
info: Be sure to point out to any protestors that this is faux tigerskin. You don't want to end up with Red Blocks instead!

name: Growboard
info: Just like they predicted, we finally have hoverboards in 2014! Well, virtual ones. This one spits fire. Sponsored by Coinman, iOliver, and Legomanz.

name: Spiritfire Mask
info: For the less technologically-inclined, this mask relies on black magic to raise an evil spirit.

name: Soda Jetpack
info: Use the power of carbonation to leap tall buildings in a single bound, and then drift gently to Earth. Comes with a lifetime supply of soda, connected via wormhole for continuous refueling.

name: Dominatus Moderateus
info: Could there be more than one cult in Growtopia? Sponsored by Moderate.

name: Seagull
info: These extra-strong seagulls can carry the full weight of a Growtopian!  Hop on!

name: Flower Checkpoint
info: If you die, you'll respawn at the last Checkpoint you touched!

name: Bubble Gum
info: This isn't even wrapped, it probably has all kinds of germs on it. Are you really gonna chew it?

name: Diving Board
info: These are surprisingly bouncy. Hold Jump as you land for maximum bounce.

name: Diving Board Support
info: This part of the diving board is not bouncy at all. Go jump off the unsupported end!

name: Deluxe Grow Spray
info: Spray a tree to grow it 24 hours' worth!

name: Legendbot-009
info: This legendary battle armor was the turning point in the war of Growtopia Valley.

name: Dragon of Legend
info: This blade calls forth the Ancient Dragon of Unexaggerated Legends and binds it to your command. It's a biggun'.

name: Legendary Wings
info: Turns out you had to do a lot more than ring a bell to get these suckers.

name: Legendary Wizard
info: This wizard is legendary! Punch or wrench him to obtain Legendary Quests.

name: Great Legendary Orb
info: Players that touch this get a Legendary Orb.

name: Legendary Orb
info: This orb is legendary and filled with a great power. However, you don't have an adapter for it, so the power isn't any use to you. Perhaps a wizard could use it?

name: Diamond Lock
info: Locks an entire world. And looks good doing it. Tap on it in your inventory to break it down into 100 World Locks, if you have room in your inventory.

name: Puzzle Brick
info: This brick is just made out of puzzlingly shaped pieces, it's not much of a puzzle itself. Just a brick.

name: Zeus' Lightning Bolt
info: It's 1.21 gigawatts in the palm of your hand!  Sponsored by Dodoman11, Hercule, and the RTSoft Forumers.

name: Chinese Dragon Head
info: You're lucky, you get to be the head!

name: Chinese Dragon Body
info: This really adds a lot of body to your hair.

name: Chinese Dragon Tail
info: Looks like you got stuck with the tail end. Again.

name: Ssireum Shorts - Red
info: Wear these shorts when you are wrestling! If you play in a Game Pack game, your shorts will change color to match your team.

name: Ssireum Shorts - Blue
info: Wear these shorts when you are wrestling! If you play in a Game Pack game, your shorts will change color to match your team.

info: Wear these shorts when you are wrestling! If you play in a Game Pack game, your shorts will change color to match your team.

name: Ssireum Shorts - Grey
info: Wear these shorts when you are wrestling! If you play in a Game Pack game, your shorts will change color to match your team.

name: Golden Air Robinsons
info: These sporty shoes are coated with a layer of pure sparkling gold. Sponsored by Kubeti and Rooted.

name: Autumn Wings
info: A leaf falls on a still pond. These wings let you double jump, and contain an endless supply of dried leaves for some reason!

name: Autumn Bomb
info: I am become death, the destroyer of foliage. Toss this in the air to celebrate the fall!

name: Balance Mooncake
info: This pastry is filled with a sweet bean paste, in 4 flavors combined with a perfect balance. A random jumble of four symbols is imprinted on the top in ancient Growtopian script. Mix this with other Mooncakes in a Laboratory or E-Z Cook Oven to create special Harvest Festival items.

name: Harvester
info: This advanced harvesting machine will chop down trees as it runs them over. If you wear a Fuel Pack, it has a 10 chance of harvesting double fruit from each tree below rarity 100! This burns up one Fuel Pack.

name: Sunflower Checkpoint
info: If you die, you'll respawn at the last Checkpoint you touched!

name: Moon Block
info: With this block, you too can yell at the moon like Buzz Aldrin.

name: Diamond Flashaxe
info: I'm not sure why you're bothering to mine stuff when you already have an entire pickaxe made of diamonds, but at least you know this is harder than whatever you want to mine! Sponsored by Kloe, PartyFrog, and xShaDo.

name: Long Black Bangs
info: This is the hair for people with flawed foreheads.

name: Pink Pageboy
info: This is NOT a helmet, don't call it a helmet! But if you want to use it as a helmet, go ahead. It's hair though.

name: Long Blonde Bangs
info: Cover your forehead and shoulders in one fell swoop!

name: Messy Auburn Tresses
info: It's messy and it's red, what more could you want from hair?

name: Growbans
info: These are some fierce designer sunglasses!

name: Pink Hair Bow
info: You're like Ms. Pac-Man without the eating disorder!

name: Butterfly Hair Pin
info: It looks like a real butterfly! A real robot butterfly.

name: Bee Hair Pin
info: Psst, I think there's a bee in your hair...

name: Red Sun Dress
info: It looks like a whole galaxy of suns.

name: Blue Skirt
info: This skirt is long, and thus classy.

name: Checkered Dress
info: You are now the referee of fashion.

name: Cardboard Box
info: The ultimate in stealth technology. Sponsored by JakeShore, ADMex1, and bankai.

name: Block Glue

name: Violet Protodrake Leash
info: Congratulations on completing all the holiday achievements!  Have a dragon!

name: Hanging Guytrap
info: This is also what happens when you give a flower a taste for magic bacon!

name: Funhouse Mirror
info: These mirrors make you look entirely wacky!

name: Ring Of Force
info: This ring replaces your punch with a devastating blast of energy that can shatter nearby blocks!

name: Ring Of Winds
info: This ring floats you on a cloud. Hold the jump button while falling to glide safely down to earth.

name: Carnival Wallpaper
info: Throw up some of these and you'll feel like you've run away to the circus!

name: Carnival Awning
info: Step right up and see the amazing square-headed person!

name: Carnival Block
info: Doot doot doo doo doodle doot doot doo doo...

name: Red Pennant
info: It's just flappin' in the breeze.

name: Blue Pennant
info: It's just flappin' in the breeze.

name: Green Pennant

name: Phoenix Pacifier
info: Aww, so cute you just wanna snuggle him all day! But you should really pace yourself on that, with a trip to the burn ward in between each snuggle. No more than 500 of these little guys exist in all of Growtopia.

name: Sun Block
info: Don't rub this on your face.

name: Tiki Torch
info: How you feelin'? Hot hot hot? Well, you can punch this to turn it on or off.

name: Cow Skull
info: This bovine has mooooved on to greener pastures.

name: Flamingo
info: This bird's got legs that go allll the way up.

name: Summer Breeze
info: These gentle breezes smell like freshly mown grass. They also blow with great ferocity!

name: Wizard's Staff
info: Congratulations on solving the Wizard's Riddle (or just googling what somebody else figured out). Since you're not legendary enough to obtain an actual Legendary Item, here's a replica of the great Wizard's staff. (Be careful, the winds might hurt you.) Sponsored by Devinn and PonyGarYelow.

name: White Fury
info: This thoroughbred steed is burning with furious power. Sponsored by Hercule, HERMIUS, and PRONGS.

name: Seafoam Beard
info: You're looking a little green around the gills.

name: Seafoam Hair
info: You've got that windblown chlorinated surfer look. It either makes you cool or a filthy beach bum. It's a fine line.

name: Oceanic Crown
info: You are the KING OF THE SEAS!... Is what's written on the tag of this cheap plastic knock-off.

name: BLYoshi's Free Dirt
info: It's an unlimited supply of free dirt blocks! Unfortunately, it spews them at high velocity so they splatter on impact. Sponsored by BLYoshi.

name: FC Cleats
info: Every pair of cleats comes with a new high-tech soccer ball capable of returning to you automatically! These cleats come from Funtimes College, the #1 party school on Earth. Sponsored by The Admins of FC.

name: Man U Cleats
info: Every pair of cleats comes with a new high-tech soccer ball capable of returning to you automatically! These cleats come from Man University, the school for manly men of masculinity.

name: FC Jersey
info: Represent Funtimes College in this stylish jersey! PARTY ON!

name: Man U Jersey
info: Represent Man University in this stylish jersey! Hallelujah, it's rainin' men! Notice of non-discrimination: Man University does not discriminate on the basis of gender identity, unless you're not a man. HOO HOO HOO MAN U!

name: Baseball Glove
info: Hidden inside this glove is a wormhole to a dimension filled with nothing but baseballs. Baseballs and popcorn shrimp. But the wormhole's at the baseball end of the dimension.

name: Pigskin
info: Don't worry, this isn't actually the skin of a pig. It's plastic. It's an American football! Also known as a hand-egg.  Throw it to somebody!

name: Stadium
info: Nobody showed up for the big game!

name: Crowded Stadium
info: Everybody showed up for the big game!

name: Basketball Hoop
info: Dunk it!! The more of these you stack up, the better the challenge.

name: Monkey On Your Back
info: This is not a metaphor. Sponsored by SweGamerHD's subscribers, Kizashi, and Inforced.

name: Football Helmet
info: Keep in mind that while headgear is necessary for dangerous sports, it doesn't eliminate brain damage. Keep your brain safe - play Growtopia instead.

name: Growies Cap
info: Show your pride in the Growtopia Growies with their cap! Root for the home team!

name: Tennis Racquet
info: Serve up an ace! Lifetime subscription to Rapidly Biodegradable Tennis Ball Supply is included.

name: Carrot Sword
info: This carrot is rather sharp. I wouldn't recommend eating, especially if it's a sword or if you're a bunny. Sponsored by MrMehMeh.

name: Emerald Staff
info: The Orb Of Ajanti is mounted atop this staff, held by a silver hand - just make sure you never touch it with your human hand, or you will be incinerated. Sponsored by SilentRebel, COMBUSTION, and jason747.

name: Fishing Rod
info: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast.

name: Wiggly Worm
info: This is bait for fishing. Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait on water that you are standing next to in order to start fishing. Wiggly Worms can only catch the smallest fish.

name: Cryptic Scroll
info: Incomprehensible words scrawl across this parchment: `9SNWISS CAGITE TET PLDOL``

name: Really Cryptic Scroll
info: Incomprehensible words scrawl across this parchment: `9EG TAC DESLI UREN HAI IB``

name: Exceedingly Cryptic Scroll
info: Incomprehensible words scrawl across this parchment: `9VROMO AOI ELN WREAR NSA``

name: Needlessly Cryptic Scroll
info: Incomprehensible words scrawl across this parchment: `9EO PAT NNN TED A BASK GCL``

name: Smarty Pants
info: These pants are colorful and tasty! But they do not enhance intelligence in any way.

name: Camo Pants
info: Put these pants on and people will think you're just a floating torso!  With some shoes underneath.

name: Carrot Pants
info: It's the latest fashion! I guess...

name: Golf Pants
info: It's a mystery as to why golfers have to wear ugly pants, but they really do. Have some!

name: Acid-Washed Skinny Jeans
info: You need skinny legs to put in the skinny jeans, or perhaps just let the acid slim you down a bit.

name: Tiny Red Skirt
info: YOUNG LADY. You are NOT going out in that skirt. In my day, people couldn't even see our ankles.

name: Flower Sarong
info: This delicate flower print works both as a swimsuit cover-up, or an elegant skirt for a night on the town.

name: Purple Crystal Skirt
info: As long as you don't mind clinking as you walk around, this is a beautifully sparkly style.

name: Golden Crystal Skirt
info: As long as you don't mind clinking as you walk around, this is a beautifully sparkly style.

name: Aqua Crystal Skirt
info: As long as you don't mind clinking as you walk around, this is a beautifully sparkly style.

name: Display Block
info: "Use" nearly any item on this block to store it inside on display. Destroying the block will spit out the item, or you can wrench the block to remove it.

name: Ruined Sign
info: Write stuff on it to tell your friends! Use your Wrench on it to change the message.

name: Robotic Lock
info: This robotic guardian keeps your world safe by not allowing anybody without access to break or place blocks. Just like a world lock, only scarier!

name: Digger's Spade
info: This shovel is very specifically designed for one purpose: to shovel dirt. It is pretty useless at digging anywhere else, but dang if it doesn't rip dirt apart (and Cave Background).

name: Disguise Glasses
info: Wait a second... WHO ARE YOU!?!? How did you get in here?!

name: Growch Cultist Robe
info: Just the thing to worship The Growch in!

name: Wedding Dress
info: You look radiant on this special day!

name: Bridal Veil
info: Today's modern bride doesn't want to conceal her face, so we've swept the veil aside for you.

name: Dark Red Wallpaper
info: This is kinda creepy, like the walls are bleeding.

name: Fountain
info: Relax by the soothing tinkle of water. You can punch this to turn it on or off.

name: Enchanted Spatula
info: This mythical artifact, possibly from the future, has an unparalleled magical power: you can slap objects with it to turn them around. Use it on chairs, beds, whatever you find facing the wrong way! Note: Because the spatula is crystal, it shatters when used.

name: Sink
info: Punch to wash your hands! Be clean, please. As of this item, Growtopia now includes everything but the kitchen sink (this is the bathroom sink, unfortunately).

name: Ring Of Water
info: This mystical ring encases you in a bubble, allowing you to swim at high velocity. The cool bubble also protects you from dangerous burns like lava.

name: Spikey Anime Hair
info: The great thing about this hairstyle is you just wake up with it every morning! Sure, some people use a comb to fix that, but you just call it anime!

name: Red Bicycle
info: It's easy to remember how to ride this - it's just like riding a bike!

name: Cybernetic Eye
info: We've rebuilt you - better, faster, stronger than before.

name: Vending Machine
info: Shopping without the hassle of human beings! Use your wrench on this item to stock it with an item and set a price in World Locks. Other players will be able to buy from it! Only works in World-Locked worlds.

name: Jester's Cap
info: Bring joy to Growtopia in this classically designed headwear!

name: Blanket Cape
info: If you can't afford a real cape, just fake it with a blanket!

name: Riding War Wolf
info: It's just like a horse... except you MAY want to avoid kicking it with your heels.

name: Wolf Tamer's Glove
info: When you stare into a wolf's eyes, you're staring into the untameable heart of nature itself. But you can tame it anyway if you've got the right fashion accessories!

name: Wolf Whistle
info: Beware! Blowing this whistle will send you off to the Wolfworld! When you are there, you will have only 10 minutes before the power of the wolf wears off and you return to the real world. Can you conquer the Wolfworld in time?

name: Great Wolf Totem
info: Players that touch this get a wolf prize, and kicked out of the wolfworld.

name: Wolf Totem
info: Now you can play Wolfworld: The Home Game with your own handy wooden totem!

name: Dire Wolf Mask
info: This mask is usually kept in a glass case, with a tiny hammer and a sign that says "Break glass only in case of dire emergency!"

name: Goldfish
info: These are named for their orange coloration, they're not actually made of any precious metals.

name: Fish Tank Port
info: This is a handy hole in a fish tank, through which you can insert or remove fish! Use your wrench to manage the fish, just like real fish. You can only place this on a fish tank.

name: Fish Tank
info: Fish can swim around in here! However, you need to put them in through a Fish Tank Port, sold separately.

name: Rollback Plaque III
info: You were there, man. You were THERE when time rolled backwards yet again, the server burned to bits, and all the fruits of your labors turned to dust in your dry, bitter fist. August 2015

name: E-Z Rod
info: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. This is a beginner's fishing rod - it keeps fish on the line twice as long as other rods, so it's easy as pie.

name: Licorice Rod
info: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. This delicious fishing rod gets bites twice as often as other rods.

name: Shiny Flashy Thing
info: This is bait for fishing. Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait on water that you are standing next to in order to start fishing. The shiny stuff appeals to larger fish than Wiggly Worms do.

name: Salmon Eggs
info: This is bait for fishing. Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait on water that you are standing next to in order to start fishing. These eggs catch mid-sized fish.

name: Fishing Fly
info: This is bait for fishing. Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait on water that you are standing next to in order to start fishing. The dancing action of these lures can even attract large fish.

name: Shrimp Lure
info: This is bait for fishing. Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait on water that you are standing next to in order to start fishing. There is no fish too big to enjoy a shrimp lure.

name: Whizmo Gizmo
info: This is bait for fishing with three high-tech features: it appeals to all sizes and types of fish, it homes in on the largest fish around, and special filtering fins keep it from hooking on anything other than a fish!

name: Electric Eel
info: It's always a shock to find you've caught one of these on your line. Place it in your world to share the feeling with others.

name: Whale
info: Don't be fooled just because you caught this while fishing - this giant of the ocean is a mammal. And shame on you for catching it! They're endangered!

name: Catfish
info: I really don't know why they call these fish catfish. Weird.

name: Perch
info: These fish are named for the strange way that they tend to hang in mid-air, like solid objects you can stand on. Try it, you can't knock one down no matter how hard you jump on it!

name: Dogfish
info: Dogfish are a type of shark, and they are so named because they hunt in packs, like dogs do. It has nothing to do with their appearance, which is entirely fishlike and not canine at all.

name: Gar
info: That doesn't even sound like a real word.

name: Mahi Mahi
info: The fish so nice they named it twice.

name: Sunfish
info: If there's one fish that can brighten your day, this is it.

name: Bass
info: Don't drop the bass. You'd hurt it.

name: Goldenrod
info: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. This enchanted rod will catch 25% bigger fish than normal.

name: Fishing Hat
info: Congratulations on winning the Fishing Frenzy Daily Challenge! With this hat on, there's a 5% chance to not use up your bait when you fish (I mean, there's a bunch of extra bait right there on the hat!).

name: Tackle Box
info: You keep all your bait for fishing in here. Unfortunately, it's on a timed lock, so it can only be opened once every two days.

name: Firefighter Helmet - Red
info: Protect your head from falling embers, or occasionally falling buildings!

name: Firefighter Helmet - Yellow
info: Protect your head from falling embers, or occasionally falling buildings!

name: Oxygen Mask
info: Strap this on when people start tossing rotten eggs. You'll be much happier.

name: Firefighter Boots
info: Finally, the technology exists to protect your feet from fire without exposing them to dangerous asbestos! Wear these for fire safety.

name: Firefighter Pants - Red
info: These pants are made of stylish rubber to ensure you are as overheated as possible while standing in a burning building.

name: Firefighter Pants - Yellow
info: These pants are made of stylish rubber to ensure you are as overheated as possible while standing in a burning building.

name: Firefighter Jacket - Red
info: Is it hot in here? Throw on a jacket!

name: Firefighter Jacket - Yellow
info: Is it hot in here? Throw on a jacket!

name: Pocket Lighter
info: You just want to watch the world burn. Use this on any tile, whether you own it or not, to set it on fire.

name: Water Balloon
info: Throw this to splash water over a wide area, putting out fires.

name: Fire Hose
info: Where is the other end of this hose plugged in? I don't know, but it has an infinite supply of water! This does no damage to blocks at all, but it puts out fires with great ease!

name: Fire Truck
info: For the sake of your fellow Growtopians, we limited the siren. But you can still enjoy the flashing lights!

name: Fire Ax
info: Chop your way into burning buildings to rescue puppies! This device is not licensed for any other use.

name: Firehouse
info: This building provides protection against all fires! It can put out any fire in your world in seconds.

name: Floating Leaf
info: This magic leaf can float you around. Just cuz.

name: Solar Collector
info: This biomechanical device accumulates solar energy all day long. Then, when you plant a tree in your world, the stored energy is pumped into the tree, growing it to 25% of full growth instantly!

name: Autumn Viney Block
info: It may seem obvious, but I'll say it anyway: this block is viney, but turning red and gold.

name: Autumn Viney Wallpaper
info: It's like you're lost in the jungle! In the middle of October!

name: Autumn Leaf Block
info: If you don't like it, you can make like this block and leaf. In the fall.

name: Dried Leaf Crown
info: Handle with care or you're gonna end up with potpourri instead of the Heralded Crown Of Autumn.

name: Musical Gong
info: If somebody bangs this while you are performing, it means your act is bad and you should feel bad. On the other hand, it plays a nifty tune!

name: Highly Combustible Box
info: This box is made of gasoline-soaked balsa wood. It's a really bad design. If it gets lit on fire, it will burn up instantly. A few select items can be tempered by fire though. Perhaps you could store them inside and see what happens when it burns?

name: Skeletal Shark
info: This is what happens when you don't feed your fish.

name: Ghost Fish
info: There's nothing spooky about this fish, it's just the kind where you can see through it a bit. Kinda weird, though.

name: Demon Angler
info: This is a demonic fish, not a fish that angles for demons. I figured the teeth and eyes made that obvious.

name: Otherworldly Bait
info: This is bait for fishing. Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait on water that you are standing next to in order to start fishing. This bait actually travels through a wormhole into a dark dimension and catches things there, instead of in the water. `4Bad`` things.

name: Cursed Fishing Rod
info: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. You will suffer mysterious effects when catching fish with this rod. Beware the curse!

name: Eldritch Flame
info: The seething fires of the underworld are at your command! Throw this in somebody's world to start a bunch of fires and really annoy them.

name: Flaming Cape
info: This cape burns eternally with eldritch fire. It's also lined with asbestos, so you're all good. Probably.

name: Ghost Costume
info: Nothing spookier than a bedsheet with two holes cut in it!

name: Chainsaw Hand
info: If you ever get a possessed hand and have to lop it off at the wrist, here's a handy replacement for it! Also good for ice sculpture.

name: Cape Tatters
info: This bit of cloth is black on one side and blood-red on the other. If you had 25 of these, you might be able to make a really spooky cape!

name: Inside-Out Vampire Cape
info: You accidentally made your cape inside-out!

name: Black Aura
info: I'm pretty sure it's a bad sign when your aura is this color.

name: Hellgate
info: It seems like the destination of this portal is obvious, but actually you can choose any place you like with your Wrench.

name: Riding Demon Dog
info: It's just like a horse... except PURE EVIL.

name: Teeny Devil Wings
info: Even as tiny as they are, these wings allow you to jump in mid-air!

name: Teeny Wing Fragment
info: This is about an eighth of a Teeny Devil Wing. So if you had 16 of these, you could make a pair of Teeny Devil Wings!

name: Soul Orb
info: This orb devours the souls of anything it touches - Growtopians, blocks, trees, whatever!

name: Dark Magic Barrier
info: This demonic energy field only lets the right people through.  Wrench it to adjust settings like any other doorway.

name: Stethoscope
info: Congratulations on winning the Doctor's Duel Daily Challenge! With this Stethoscope on, you are half as likely to make mistakes in surgery!

name: Super Logo - Crown
info: Emblazon this logo on your super costume since you won the Card Clash Daily Challenge! With this logo on, you get +2 health during card battles!

name: Wolf Spirit
info: Congratulations on winning the War of Wolves Daily Challenge! With this spirit equipped (it is a back item, by the way), you can double jump, and the guidance of the Wolf Spirit will improve your Wolfworld rewards (usually).

name: Wolfy Block
info: This is the wolfiest block available with current technology.

name: Challenge Crown
info: Congratulations! You were #1 in a Daily Challenge! Show off with a shiny crown.

name: Ring Of Savings
info: Congratulations on winning the Carnie Contest Daily Challenge! With this ring equipped, you save 10% on Golden Ticket prices (pay 90 rarity per ticket, or get 33 per World Lock).

name: Challenge Board
info: Wrench this board to see the situation with the Daily Challenge!

name: Cosmic Cape
info: This cape sparkles and very very rarely finds leftover Comet Dust in blocks you break when it's not The Night Of The Comet!

name: Rainbow Crystal Block
info: Congratulations on winning the Crystal Crusher Daily Challenge! Enjoy this rainbowlicious block. Don't you just wanna lick it? Also, if you smash a Harmonic Crystal that is sitting on this block, there's a 20% chance of getting back one of the crystals you put into it.

name: Cosmic Power - Comet Strike
info: This is a `5Cosmic`` Superpower card for use in fighting crime. You can also place it as a block! Cosmic Cards aren't used, they just have an effect as long as they are in your hand. Card effect: `w25% chance of doing 1 extra damage whenever your card counters the opponent's.``

name: Cosmic Power - Star Burst
info: This is a `5Cosmic`` Superpower card for use in fighting crime. You can also place it as a block! Cosmic Cards aren't used, they just have an effect as long as they are in your hand. Card effect: `wWhen you are hit for more than 1 damage at once, the opponent is blasted for 1 damage.``

name: Cosmic Power - Lunar Barrier
info: This is a `5Cosmic`` Superpower card for use in fighting crime. You can also place it as a block! Cosmic Cards aren't used, they just have an effect as long as they are in your hand. Card effect: `wWhen you are at or below 25% life, there's a 25% chance to deflect damage done to you.``

name: Cosmic Power - Nebula Gas
info: This is a `5Cosmic`` Superpower card for use in fighting crime. You can also place it as a block! Cosmic Cards aren't used, they just have an effect as long as they are in your hand. Card effect: `wWhen your cards are countered, there's a 25% chance that your card works anyway.``

name: Transdimensional Vaporizer Ray
info: This is a highly advanced alien device with one purpose: it can fire right through solid matter to vaporize background blocks without doing any harm to the foreground blocks. It uses alien batteries which we can't replace, so each Vaporizer can only be used once.

name: Carnival Pinwheel
info: Enjoy the beauty of this spinny pinwheel.

name: Sword And Shield
info: This is a classic warrior's combo - a nice cutlass for your main hand, and a shield in the other. The shield makes you harder to knock back!

name: Twin Swords
info: Why waste time with a shield? Just get two swords!

name: Preppy Blonde Hair
info: I think you've got just enough gel in there to go to the sock hop with Buffy!

name: Pet Slime
info: Nothing cuter than a sentient ball of slime that follows you around!

name: Strawberry Slime
info: So much tastier than the mucus flavor!

name: Angry Unicorn Block
info: This block is angry, and prominently features a unicorn.

name: Legal Briefs
info: Not only are these comfortable undergarments for everyday use, they also have a legal use: put them on when you are in trouble for Malpractice, and you'll be freed from your punishment! This uses up the briefs.

name: Ring Of Smithing
info: To be honest, this ring doesn't really do anything. Well, that is unless you want to smith something. Then you're definitely gonna need to wear this!

name: Anvil
info: You can forge astounding weapons on this, if it's next to a Forge that's been heated to 1,000 degrees, and you have Smithing Tools, and wear a Ring of Smithing and a Blacksmith's Apron. Oh, and have some item you want to smith. If you've got all that, go ahead and use the item on the anvil!

name: Blacksmith's Apron
info: This apron is made of heavy leather, making it very effective for protecting you from stray sparks when forging things.

name: Crystal Smithing Tools
info: These are the perfect tools for doing blacksmithing work... provided you don't mind the fact that crystal tools shatter when used.

name: Blade Fragment
info: This is a broken piece of a sword blade. It's of a low-quality steel and could stand to be tempered.

name: Shield Fragment
info: This is a broken piece of a shield. If you had enough of these, you could probably forge them into a new shield!

name: Tempered Steel Fragment
info: This is a beautiful tempered steel fragment of a sword blade. If you had enough of these, you could probably forge them into a new sword blade!

name: Sword Pommel
info: This is a lovingly crafted sword pommel. If only there were a blade to attach it to!

name: Sword Blade
info: This is a lovingly crafted sword blade. If only there were a pommel to attach it to!

name: Warrior's Shield
info: This is a lovingly crafted shield. But you can't punch blocks with a shield. Maybe you can combine this with a weapon to make a complete set?

name: Forge
info: You can use this to forge astounding weapons, if you have an Anvil next to it. You'll also need to fuel it with something really hot.

name: Nuclear Fuel
info: You can feel your cells mutating just being near this lump of radioactive garbage. About the only thing this is good for is firing up a forge to ridiculous levels of heat.

name: Gift of the Unicorn
info: The unicorn has gifted you great wisdom! The wisdom is thus: If you stick this wisdom, 2 Sword Pommels, and 2 Sword Blades, into a Laboratory and SCIENCE them... well, let's just say it'll be super cool.

name: Giving Tree
info: "Borrowed" from the Growch's private reserve, this magnificent tree will give you a gift every 4 hours for the duration of Winterfest!

name: Giving Tree Stump
info: This will regrow into a Giving Tree in a while.

name: Tree Decorations
info: All sorts of baubles and gewgaws to adorn your Giving Tree in true Winterfest style! One decoration won't do much, but you can toss up to 100 decorations on each tree! More decorations will logically result in better gifts, but taking the gift will remove all the decorations with it!

name: Lumber Axe
info: This axe is precisely balanced to chop down trees in just a single hit! Now, you might not be impressed since you can do that with your bare hands already. But wait - this axe can chop down the `2GROWCH'S`` trees! Of course, doing that will shatter it. They're very special trees.

name: Axe Fragment
info: This is a broken piece of an axe blade. It's not very high quality, perhaps it could be tempered.

name: Icy Heart Of Winter
info: You've found the Growch's icy heart! No wonder he's so mean - it's not even in his body! That's a major medical problem that would upset anyone.

name: Icy Heart Pickup
info: Players pick up an Icy Heart of Winter by touching this.

name: Axe Of Winter
info: Mittens are recommended when wielding this icy monstrosity, which does extra damage to blocks.

name: Moose Cap
info: This beautifully styled hat, suitable for all formal occasions, has the unique property of attracting wild meese to follow you around.

name: Candy Cane Bait
info: This is bait for fishing. Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait on water that you are standing next to in order to start fishing. This is the only bait that is its own hook! It catches unique seasonal fish that other bait doesn't appeal to.

name: Neon Squid
info: This squid glows in neon colors! What a fine holiday gift it would make.

name: Antarctic Icefish
info: These fish have the ability to survive in antarctic waters because they actually have antifreeze in their blood! It's science, google it.

name: Gingerbread Fish
info: You know how you can dunk cookies in milk? This one was dunked in the ocean. Kinda gross.

name: Swedish Fish
info: This breed of fish is unique to the waters of Sweden, and it has a surprisingly sweet taste when eaten raw. Don't eat yours though, it's a pet.

name: Snowcone
info: Yum, fruit flavors poured into ice! At least it's yum until all the flavoring gets sucked out.

name: Toboggan
info: This sled was called "Onion Bulb" by its original owner, but you can call it whatever you want. It comes with a free purple blanket to keep your legs warm!

name: Winter Wind
info: Place this anywhere you want the wind to come ripping through and push players around! The wind blows in the direction that you would blow air when placing it, so you can place it either way.

name: Snowflake Block
info: Just one exceptionally large snowflake, perfectly preserved in lucite. I don't know how they did it, but it's nice and slippery!

name: Winter Robe
info: Be the King of Winter in this luxurious satiny robe! Note: this is a "chest item", like a necklace, so you can wear any shirts and back items you want underneath it.

name: Magical Carrot
info: With just a touch of winter magic, it's really not that hard to bring a snowman to life. I don't know why more people don't do it!

name: Hot Chocolate
info: Mmm, sweet and toasty, with marshmallows! This not only warms your insides, but it also contains a massive dose of delicious iodine to clear out any radiation you're currently suffering from. Inexplicably it also charges up Geiger Counters when consumed. I can't explain that one.

name: Tempered Axe Fragment
info: This is a broken piece of an axe blade, tempered to polished steel! With enough of these, and a suitable source of enraged winter fury, you could forge an amazing icy axe blade.

name: Icy Axe Blade
info: This blade is enchanted with winter magic! You could build an awesome weapon with a pair of these and a handle... well, it'd be awesome if you could hold it. Maybe you need something to protect your hands when holding it.

name: Steel Axe Handle
info: This thing has a nice heft, and handy notches for inserting up to two axe blades. The only real downside is that it's made entirely of metal, so if you were to place, say, magical ice blades in it, the cold would be transmitted right to your hand, and you wouldn't be able to hold it.

name: Grip Tape
info: This is handy for wrapping around the handle of a weapon or tool. It can improve your grip, as well as protect you from cold metal handles.

name: Riding Winter Wolf
info: It's just like a horse... except soft and fuzzy!

name: Weather Machine - Snowy Night
info: Man, the weather outside is frightful! And dark!

name: Elf Stockings
info: This is really just long underwear. You probably should wear pants over them, but hey, Growtopia doesn't support that, so you'll just have to be cold!

name: Sock On The Wall
info: You need to wash your socks. This one stuck to the wall!

name: Steam Gear
info: This is a cog in a vast steam machine. Or it can be, if you build one, with this in it! This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power.

name: Steam Tubes
info: Tubes for directing steam power. This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power. Steam flows straight when possible, otherwise it turns right (and turns left if it can't do that!).

name: Steam Piston
info: Steam power makes it go whump whump whump. This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power.

name: Steam Lifter Piston
info: Steam power makes it go whump whump whump up and down. This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power.

name: Steam Bellows
info: Steam power makes it go eenk-oonk-eenk (pardon the technical terminology). This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power.

name: Steam Riser Bellows
info: Steam power makes it go eenk-oonk-eenk up and down (pardon the technical terminology). This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power.

name: Steam Stomper
info: Jump on this to shoot steam below it! Use the other Steam Blocks to direct the steam where you need it.

name: Growtopia Fan Shirt
info: This amazing psychic shirt can actually display your thoughts with spectacular new morphing ink technology. Note: yeah, it just says the one thing, but you know you're thinking it.

name: T-Shirt Cannon
info: Powered by a Fuel Pack on your back, this gun can launch free T-shirts at your fellow Growtopians! Don't waste shots at anything else, it still burns fuel!

name: Ghost Fan Shirt
info: You like ghosts? No? Sure looks like you do.

name: Steam Valve
info: This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power. If steam enters this block from the top or bottom, it will go out the bigger side, and the valve will flip for the next time.

name: Steam Organ
info: This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power. When steam passes through this block, it plays beautiful music! Use your wrench to adjust what note comes out.

name: Steam Vent
info: This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power. When steam passes through this block, it vents some out with intense heat! Do not touch this for 3 seconds after steam has been through.

name: Steam Door
info: Punch it to open or shut it. But even if you don't have access to do that, you can still open and shut it with steam power!

name: Steampunk Corset
info: Tired of always choosing the survival of your internal organs over looking skinny? The corset is the thing for you!

name: Steampunk Skirt
info: Multiple layers of petticoats keep you warm!

name: Steampunk Top Hat
info: Keep an extra pair of goggles up there. You never know when you'll need them.

name: Steampunk Waistcoat
info: The perfect garment for housing a pocketwatch, monocle, and perhaps taxidermy needles. Definitely some weird stuff in those pockets.

name: Steampunk Leggings
info: Works equally well for a steampunk or a pirate! Or maybe a dancer from the 80's.

name: Steampunk Trenchcoat
info: Keep warm on those frosty London evenings in this stylish piece by Grow Couture! Note: this is a "chest item", like a necklace, so you can wear any shirts and back items you want underneath it.

name: Party Blaster
info: Take the party with you every where you go!

name: Tempered Party Tunes
info: This is a highly polished bit of music. So shiny! Enough of these might be able to forge a relic from ancient times past...

name: 80's Tape Deck
info: Wow, this is some seriously old technology. It's no good without a suitable power source and some speakers to rock out of.

name: D Battery
info: A portable source of a tiny amount of power.

name: ERROR!
info: Please contact support to fix this item!

name: Steampunk Sprocket
info: There's not a lot of difference between a sprocket and a gear. But this is a sprocket.

name: Steampunk Gearbox
info: It's a box full of sprockets and gears and whatnots! It's probably part of an awesome steampunk creation.

name: Stretched Canvas
info: It's not the prettiest decoration for your world, but it's probably got some other good uses.

name: Silkworm
info: A cute little pet for you to feed and care for! They'll eat almost anything, but don't forget to give them water too. Use your wrench to change your pet's name.

name: Silk Thread - Red
info: A single thread isn't very useful. Get 100 of these to stitch a bolt together!

info: Use Silk Bolts on this machine to sew them together into finished products. You'll need 3 bolts of cloth, and you'll have to sew them in the right order, using the right type of stitching!

name: Patchwork Mess
info: An experiment in sewing gone horribly wrong.  This is just a bunch of silk stitched together in random directions.

name: Silk Vest - Red
info: A snappy vest suitable for any occasion.
