name: Country Flag
info: Place this anywhere to proudly display your country's flag!

name: Lovebird Pendant
info: Pip pip! This little bird will follow you around forever, because it loves you. Or at least it loves that necklace, and possibly wants it back.

name: Booty Chest
info: Store your treasures inside by dropping them! When it's closed, the items are hidden. Punch to open it.

name: Love Potion #8
info: This potion isn't FDA approved for use on humans yet, maybe a later version will be. But spray a rock with it to upgrade it into a WAY better rock.

name: Golden Booty Chest
info: Smash it for Valentine's goodies! Every year the Golden Heart Crystal is locked in time and remains constant, appearing at the same frequency throughout the ages, while new items change and fade with the passage of time.

name: Sour Lollipop
info: Zing! This is one tart little lollipop.

name: Sweet Lollipop
info: Mmm! This is one sweet little lollipop.

name: Pink Marble Arch
info: This rich marble comes from the hills of Cupidia, and our finest artisans have carved it into this sturdy arch.

name: Silkworm Toy
info: Whee! Silkworms love to play with these. Whatever they are.

name: Steam Collector
info: If steam enters this block, it will be held there for up to 20 seconds. The collector will hold as much steam as it takes to shoot it out of every output (except the one that the last steam entered from), and then shoot them all out. I hope that makes sense. Try it!

name: Steam Scrambler
info: This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power. If steam enters this block, it will exit in a random legal direction.

name: Dark Cult Hood
info: When you reach level 7 in the cult, like Jairrocket, your eyes get glowy.

name: Serpent Staff
info: St. Patrick wandered around Ireland with one of these. It scared away all the other snakes because they saw it and thought he was constantly strangling a snake.

name: Roasted Cobra
info: Deep fried on a stick! This tasty treat is found at your local county fair, obviously.

name: Cobra Statuette
info: This beautifully carved image of a cobra has 2 sockets for gems in the eyes.

name: Yellow Diamond
info: Flawlessly cut by our master gemologists, enjoy this transcendent jewel, an heirloom to last a lifetime.

name: Potato Couch
info: If you feel like a couch potato, there's no better place to relax than a potato couch.

name: Potato
info: There's no end of ways to make these tasty... fry em, bake em, roast em, grill em. Just don't forget the salt!

name: Lucky Pendant
info: This pendant symbolizes two snakes eating themselves. Whatever that means, it also causes a luck dragon to follow you around! Note: it's the dragon that's lucky, not you. I guess you're just lucky to get to hang around with it!

name: Catch-of-the-Day Bait
info: This is bait for fishing. Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait on water that you are standing next to in order to start fishing. This bait won't catch anything but the Catch of the Day, which changes each day. Fish have a chance to escape, though! Bonus: Fish caught this way can be larger than the normal maximum size!

name: Rainbowfish
info: Nobody knows where the name of this fish came from, it's quite mysterious.

name: Totally Legit Bunnyfish
info: Amazing! You have caught the incredibly rare, elusive, and completely real Bunnyfish! There's nothing fake about this fish at all!

name: Seahorse
info: This rare fish is very hard to keep in an aquarium, requiring careful feeding and cleaning, and a constantly maintained temperature. Lucky for you, this is a videogame, and you can just dump it in and forget about it.

name: Mutant Fish
info: Looks like the comet's radiation has caused unfortunate mutations in the wildlife. You gotta wonder what it's doing to you...

name: Riding Bumblebee
info: You're too heavy for this bee to fly, but it can help you jump an extra time.

name: Spring Crown
info: Keep it watered or you'll end up with a crown of thorns instead of the Heralded Crown Of Spring.

name: Weather Machine - Spring
info: Punch this to enjoy springtime weather, anytime! This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: Lobster Trap
info: Put this in deep water, load it up with 5 of any type of bait, and wait... Come back and check the trap by punching it occasionally. It may be days before an animal will wander in! You just better hope they don't wander back out with your bait.

name: Lobster
info: Who ever decided that a giant ocean spider would be something tasty to eat? Shudder.

name: Alaskan King Crab
info: Strange thing about this crab: Alaska isn't actually a monarchy.

name: Dungeonist Crab
info: This crab comes armed for dungeon exploration!

name: Crawdad
info: Whether you call them crawfish, crayfish, crawdads, or even mudbugs, it's really just a little tiny lobster.

name: Brainflower
info: Flower power! This flower's roots growing down into your brain make you smarter at finding Magic Eggs in an Egg-Hunting Basket. Who knows, you might even find two sometimes!

name: Mermaid Tail
info: You don't need to trade your voice for a pair of legs... just take this off and you're all set! But this tail does make you move faster in the water, and slower on land.

name: Sushi Knife
info: This razor-sharp blade has the unique ability to slice fish up into fresh chunks for sushi! Just drop a fish item on a Cutting Board, then attack it with the Sushi Knife!

name: Fish Chunk
info: Gross, it's a slimy bit of fresh fish.

name: Cutting Board
info: Place poor innocent fish on this and then slice them up with a Sushi Knife!

name: Rice
info: The most popular food on Earth has finally come to Growtopia!

name: Maki Roll
info: Dude, you know that fish is raw, right?

name: Spring Bouquet
info: Aw, a lovely bunch of flowers to share!

name: Paint Bucket - Red
info: Brush this rosy shade onto blocks with a paintbrush to customize your world's appearance!

name: Paint Bucket - Yellow
info: Brush this lemony shade onto blocks with a paintbrush to customize your world's appearance!

name: Paint Bucket - Green
info: Brush this verdant shade onto blocks with a paintbrush to customize your world's appearance!

name: Paint Bucket - Aqua
info: Brush this aquatic shade onto blocks with a paintbrush to customize your world's appearance!

name: Paint Bucket - Blue
info: Brush this cerulean shade onto blocks with a paintbrush to customize your world's appearance!

name: Paint Bucket - Purple
info: Brush this majestic shade onto blocks with a paintbrush to customize your world's appearance!

name: Paint Bucket - Charcoal
info: Brush this ebony shade onto blocks with a paintbrush to customize your world's appearance!

name: Paint Bucket - Varnish
info: Brush this caustic fluid onto blocks with a paintbrush to wipe off any color you've painted onto them.

name: Paintbrush
info: Paint the town a variety of delightful colors with this here brush! Paint not included.

name: Steam Revolver
info: Run through this to shoot steam upward! Use the other Steam Blocks to direct the steam where you need it.

name: Steam Launcher
info: Stomp on this and... nothing happens! But pump steam into it first to charge it up, and it becomes a steam-powered trampoline!

name: Red Crayon
info: This is truly an epic crayon. A little tough to manipulate, though.

name: Yellow Crayon
info: The first day of kindergarten, you cried because you broke the yellow crayon and you were too afraid to tell anyone.

name: Green Crayon
info: This is truly an epic crayon. A little tough to manipulate, though.

name: Aqua Crayon
info: This is truly an epic crayon. A little tough to manipulate, though.

name: Blue Crayon
info: This is truly an epic crayon. A little tough to manipulate, though.

name: Purple Crayon
info: This is truly an epic crayon. A little tough to manipulate, though.

name: Raspberry Beret
info: This is the kind you find at a second-hand store.

name: Artist's Smock
info: Looks like you spilled a little there. No, over there. And there. And the first place you thought I meant.

name: Goatee
info: You're either a hipster or an evil twin. Or perhaps ... a hipster's evil twin? How would you know which one was evil!?

name: Writing Desk
info: Nowadays people prefer laptops, but sometimes a good old ink and quill is what you need. Those times were all hundreds of years ago, of course.

name: Arrow Placard
info: This sign includes a bit of added information - an arrow! The arrow points whichever direction you are facing when you place the sign.

name: Scroll Bulletin
info: Lets people communicate by leaving messages to each other.

name: Gilded Frame
info: Surround your art with a beautiful frame! Comes with a blank canvas inside if you don't have any art. Note: if your art is made of background blocks, you'll need to apply Block Glue to it to make the frame surround it.

name: Painting Easel
info: Wrench this to paint your favorite item on it!

name: Orange Shirt
info: I know you dreamed about this since Day 1 of Growtopia. It is finally here. For real. Yes - there is an Orange Shirt, and it's not just a block, you can WEAR IT.

name: Funtime Block
info: Wheeeee! This block spins wildly when somebody steps on it.

name: Weather Machine - Howling Sky
info: "Howling in shadows, living in a lunar spell, he finds his heaven..." This weather has up to 3 wolves on it, which is an incredible wolf-to-weather-machine ratio you won't find anywhere else.

name: Homeopathic Medicine
info: Exactly 100% as effective as real-life homeopathic medicine! These sugar pills are sure to cure what ails you, or my name isn't Xjlgfkvhsnas.

name: Howling Wolf Emblem
info: Slap this emblem around your world to show you are one with the wolf!

name: Charbroiled Wolf Emblem
info: Why did you burn up your beautiful wolf emblem?

name: Hero Portrait - Buddy
info: Hey, that villain was carrying a picture of Buddy, the Growtopia mascot!

name: Picasso Triggerfish
info: Also known as Hawaii's state fish, the Humuhumunukunukuapua'a. Yes, that's one of my favorite words.

name: Fish And Chips
info: Deep fried goodness. Enjoy it with some malt vinegar!

name: Battle Pet Cage
info: This is the perfect place to starve and torture your pets, turning them into brutal engines of destruction! Wrench it to insert a pet. Note: you can never remove a battle pet - they've become too dangerous to be set loose! If you destroy a cage with a pet inside, the pet is destroyed!

name: Axolotl
info: This isn't a fish, it's actually a salamander. A cute little Mexican salamander!

name: Battle Leash
info: This amazing octohedron can actually contain two Battle Pets, primed and ready to strike. Unequip and re-equip to swap which pet is active. Wrench a Battle Pet Cage to load a pet into the Leash. Wrench another player with a Battle Leash to battle them! You must have 2 pets in the Battle Leash to battle.

name: Pet Trainer
info: This trainer's stepping on your turf. Take him down with your Battle Leash!

name: Dark Cave Background
info: This far-away dirt is speckled with shiny minerals. However, this dirt is in a dark cave (I don't care where you put it, IT IS IN A DARK CAVE!!). Players can only see what's on this tile if it's in their line of sight, or they have special tools.

name: Steam Engine
info: Feed Nuclear Fuel to heat this above 500 degrees, and it will generate steam toward the left or right (depending on how it's placed)! Use the other Steam Blocks to direct the steam where you need it.

name: Lock Mover
info: Use this fabulous device anywhere in a world you have world-locked to move the World Lock to a new location.  There must be an empty space where you tap for this to work.

name: Cave Blast
info: This devastating bomb will create a brand new underground cave world, full of darkness and creepy surprises!

name: Cave Dirt
info: Yep, it's dirt. In a cave.

name: Cave Column
info: Cave Dirt hooks into this like it's got Block Glue on it, so you can build seamless caverns. These are just fun pillars to hide behind in a cave!

name: Stalagmite
info: These dangerous spikes grow from the GROUND (stalaGmite!) as water drips down and accumulates minerals. Cave Dirt will blend into them seamlessly.

name: Stalactite
info: These dangerous spikes grow from the CEILING (stalaCtite!) as water deposits minerals on its way to dripping down. Cave Dirt will blend into them seamlessly.

name: Cave Platform
info: Handy rock platforms. These connect seamlessly to Cave Dirt and can sit atop Cave Columns as well.

name: Spelunker's Headlamp
info: This hardhat protects you from falling rocks, while the headlamp lights up dark caverns.

name: Night Vision Goggles
info: Equipping these lets you disregard darkness completely! If you're not in a world you own, they consume 1 D Battery for every minute you wear them. You can wear them without a battery if you just wanna look cool, though. `4Batteries not included.``

name: Hand Torch
info: British people would call a Flashlight this, but this is an actual torch, for your hand. As opposed to an Adventure Item or wall torch. Carrying this lights up dark caves. Torches burn out at unpredictable moments, so carry several!

name: Purple Cave Crystal
info: These crystals grow naturally in caves. They don't actually glow - bioluminescent organisms feed on them and emit light. Also heat - be careful!

name: Golden Cave Crystal
info: These crystals grow naturally in caves. They don't actually glow - bioluminescent organisms feed on them and emit light. Also heat - be careful!

name: Aqua Cave Crystal
info: These crystals grow naturally in caves. They don't actually glow - bioluminescent organisms feed on them and emit light. Also heat - be careful!

name: Climbing Wall
info: Install this right next to walls. It will add bumps and grooves for Climbing Boots to latch onto, so people can climb the wall with the right tools!

name: Climbing Picks
info: These handy picks allow you to climb Climbing Walls. Just jump and hold the arrow towards the wall!

name: Climbing Boots
info: These handy boots allow you to climb Climbing Walls. Just jump and hold the arrow towards the wall!

name: Steam Pipe
info: This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power. The big difference is it's behind you so you can walk over it!

name: Pinata Pal
info: When you are feeling down and lonely, nothing cheers you up like a rainbow-colored friendly burro filled with candy!

name: Festive Banner
info: Whatever occasion you have to celebrate, this banner is sure to make it more celebratory!

name: Fish Taco
info: Fresh Baja taste, with a guacamole cream sauce.

name: Fiesta Dress
info: Got a festive occasion to celebrate? Pop on this colorful number for a night on the town!

name: Golden Treasure Hoard
info: Ooh, smash that pile of gold, jewels and priceless treasure! There's probably something GOOD inside!

name: Topaz Block
info: Flawlessly cut by our master gemologists, enjoy this transcendent jewel, an heirloom to last a lifetime.

name: Deep Iron
info: Mine this to forge stuff out of Deep Iron!

name: Deep Iron Ore
info: This is raw ore, mined from deep within the Earth. Surely there's something you can do with it!

name: Deep Iron Ingot
info: You've managed to process this ore into a pure, shining ingot, just by tossing it into a fire!

name: Pick Blade
info: This pick blade is forged from Deep Iron, which makes it particularly attuned to pickin' real darn good.

name: Guardian Pineapple
info: When activated (punch to activate), this jealous pineapple prevents anyone from using Consumable items in your world.

name: Pineapple Ring
info: Watch out, these are really slippery to stand on!

name: Pineapple Fish
info: This SHOULD be known as Hawaii's state fish!

name: Pineapple Daiquiri
info: Mmm, this non-alcoholic cocktail is sweet and fruity!

name: Pineapple Hair
info: This hair isn't made of pineapple, it's just been dyed and gelled to look like pineapple leaves.

name: Pet Trainer Cap
info: This hat says PT on it. You can wear it to show you're a Pet Trainer, but you could also use it to celebrate Physical Therapy, or Popcorn Time, or whatever you like!

name: Silkworm Leash
info: You wanna take your Silkworm for a walk? Use this on it! Note: The silkworm will become a permanent pet, no longer able to produce silk. Good news: it will also become immortal!

name: Silkworm Saddle
info: Use this on your silkworm to saddle up and ride! Note: The silkworm will become a permanent riding item, no longer able to produce silk. Good news: it will also become immortal!

name: Riding Silkworm - Red
info: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

name: Riding Silkworm - Green
info: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

name: Riding Silkworm - Blue
info: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

name: Riding Silkworm - Black
info: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

name: Riding Silkworm - White
info: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

name: Riding Silkworm - Grey
info: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

name: Riding Silkworm - Purple
info: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

name: Riding Silkworm - Yellow
info: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

name: Riding Silkworm - Aqua
info: The more legs your ride has, the smoother it is. Too bad centipedes don't grow this big.

name: CRISPR Technology
info: This is not a tasty potato chip. With this cutting-edge genetic technology, you can splice Battle Pets of different elements together! One CRISPR is used up for each cross-element splice you perform.

name: Genetic Resequencer
info: Wrench a Battle Pet Cage with a pet inside, and you can use this to resequence their DNA. It will rotate the order of their 3 powers, so that their 1st gene-spliced ability becomes their natural ability, and thus their appearance.

name: Pet Trainer Medal
info: Congratulations! You have been awarded a medal for defeating a Pet Trainer!

name: Whale Block
info: Whale whale whale, you'll really have to wail on this block to smash it. But you'll have a whale of a time doing it! And what a tail to tell it will be. I'm way ill from all these puns, I'm gonna start blubbering. ORCA.

name: Pet Trainer Whistle
info: You know how to battle a Pet Trainer, right? You just put your lips together, and blow this whistle. You might want to have a fully stocked Battle Leash first though, because Pet Trainers won't stay around waiting to fight you forever!

name: Thinking Cap
info: They say two heads are better than one. We can't arrange that, but we can get you two of what's inside your head!

name: Phlogiston
info: This fantastical substance contains the very essence of living flame.

name: Lock-Bot
info: This robot works for Locke. He'll trade you fabulous items for locks!  He'll only stick around in your world for 24 hours before he's needed elsewhere, though.

name: Lock-Bot Remote
info: This handy remote will call Lock-Bot to your world at the location you specify. It only works once, so choose wisely! Lock-Bot will leave after 24 hours.

name: Toy Lock-Bot
info: It's just like Lock-Bot, only tiny! And he doesn't trade locks, he SHOOTS them.

name: Burnt Leather
info: If this was a piece of a pig, you'd call it a pork rind. But it's a cow rind. Strong material for crafting!

name: Buckle Design
info: This paper details a method for forging a buckle out of Deep Iron. If you forge 100 Deep Iron Ingots with this design in hand, you'll make an Iron Buckle instead of a Pick Blade.

name: Iron Buckle
info: This buckle would be good for holding straps together, if you had a need for such things!

name: Weather Machine - Heatwave
info: This amazing new weather machine emits a vortex of howling flame, but if you wrench it, you'll find adjustable settings to control the color of the flames! You can only have one of these per world.

name: Riding Phoenix
info: Whoa, you're really sitting in the hotseat now. There are only 500 of these in existence, so don't lose yours!

name: Red Flip Flops
info: Bright rubber to protect your feet from pointy shells on the beach!

name: Green Flip Flops
info: Bright rubber to protect your feet from pointy shells on the beach!

name: Blue Flip Flops
info: Bright rubber to protect your feet from pointy shells on the beach!

name: Paper Airplane
info: Toss it and see where it goes! It'll smash if it hits any blocks, so aim carefully. Tap the direction you want to throw it. The further from yourself you tap, the harder you throw.

name: B.O.O. Shirt
info: The official uniform of B.O.O. - Battlers Of the Otherworldly. Join today!

name: B.O.O. Pants
info: The official uniform of B.O.O. - Battlers Of the Otherworldly. Join today!

name: Spectral Goggles
info: The spectrally polarized lenses of these goggles allow you to actually see paranormal activity. Be warned: it is very spooky! But it's there whether you can see it or not... wouldn't you rather know?

name: B.O.O. Helmet
info: The trouble with poltergeists is that they're always pushing things off of shelves (side note: cats pose the same problem). That's where the helmet comes in. Protect yourself from falling books and antiques!

name: Neutron Pack
info: This backpack contains a portable nuclear reactor. I know that sounds a bit unsafe, but... well, it is. It's a terrible idea. It has blinky lights, though. You'll need to wear a Neutron Pack to power a Neutron Gun.

name: Neutron Gun
info: This energy blaster looks impressive, but actually has no impact on our world. Rather, it creates a stream of neutrons that attracts spirits. Ghosts can't escape the beam. Which reminds me: Don't ever cross your beam with somebody else's! That would be bad.

name: Rubber Boots
info: These are tight-fitting boots made of a natural rubber that protects from slime while still allowing your feet to breathe.

name: Ghost Jar
info: Place this jar down and it will suck in a ghost that's above it. You will probably need some friends with Neutron Guns to keep the ghost contained or it will escape! A jar takes 2 seconds to activate, and then only collects spirits for 5 seconds, so time it carefully.

name: Ghost-In-A-Jar
info: Spooky! This jar contains a ghost! You can throw it to break the jar and unleash the ghost, or instead Drop it gently in front of a Spirit Storage Unit, where you can keep the ghost for good.

name: Spirit Storage Unit
info: This incredible machine was invented a hundred years ago, and still runs on Steam power! Drop Ghosts-In-A-Jar in front of it, then provide it with Steam power to store the ghosts. Warning: If you overload the device, it may explode!

name: Destroyed Spirit Storage Unit
info: An SSU that exploded. No good for anything now.

name: Ectoplasm Sample
info: This is an important scientific discovery that could change our understanding of life itself! But you know what'd be fun? Throwing it at somebody.

name: Crystallized Ghost
info: This ghost underwent some kind of reaction during a Spirit Storage explosion, and now it's been crystallized inside a solid block. Maybe one day scientists will extract its DNA and make a theme park of ghosts. Probably not, since ghosts don't have DNA.

name: Warning Block
info: When something is so dangerous there's no time for words, just throw down some yellow and black stripes!

name: Warning Background
info: When something is so dangerous there's no time for words, just throw down some yellow and black stripes!

name: Demon Control Cap
info: With this helmet, which is not a colander at all, you can control a demon dog from another dimension!

name: Haunted Pants
info: What's that eerie noise coming from in there? These pants must be haunted!

name: Root Beer
info: Ah, a cold frosty mug of root beer. The only downside is that all that carbonation is sure to make you burp a tiny bit...

name: Spray Tan
info: If you don't want to get cancer from the sun, spray this on your skin to get an ultra-realistic bronze tone! Warning: Causes lots and lots of cancer. Lots.

name: Shark-Tooth Necklace
info: I don't know if this is a tooth from every shark you've killed, or each one that's bitten you, but either way it's impressive.

name: Firefin
info: It's not too tough to figure out where this fish gets its name. During the winter, they stay in warmer waters, but for the week of Summerfest, these can be found in their old spawning grounds right here in Growtopia!

name: Bone Spikes
info: Someone has staked a bunch of bones here and sharpened the ends. I know that's dangerous in itself, but aren't you a little more concerned about exactly who did it and where they are now?

name: Ghost Charm
info: When activated (punch to activate), this horrific face terrifies even ghosts, preventing new ghosts from appearing in your world. Ghosts that are already in your world still need to be captured by B.O.O. professionals, however. The poor ghosts are trapped on this earthly plane!

name: Steam Funnel
info: This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power. Steam can enter this Funnel from 3 sides, but can only exit from one side. You figure out which!

name: Steam Funnel - Up
info: This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power. Steam can enter this Funnel from 3 sides, but can only exit from one side. You figure out which!

name: Steam Funnel - Down
info: This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power. Steam can enter this Funnel from 3 sides, but can only exit from one side. You figure out which!

name: B.O.O. Sign
info: Advertise your ghost-hunting services with this handy sign! You're a proud member of B.O.O., so let everybody know. Use your wrench to set the message.

name: Shark Tooth
info: Just when you thought it was safe to go back to the shark dentist...

name: Atomic Fireball
info: For when lava just isn't hot enough!

name: Steam Crossover
info: This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power. It's actually 2 unconnected pipes - one runs from left to down, and the other runs from up to right. Use this to keep steam from going places you don't want!

name: Steam Crank
info: This links up to other Steam blocks and can conduct steam power. When punched, this pipe rotates between horizontal and vertical. Use your wrench to decide whether to allow the public to adjust it.

name: Steam Lamp
info: This crystal lamp is powered by steam! It burns for 10 seconds each time it gets charged. It can only be powered from below.

name: Steam Spikes
info: Steam forces razor-sharp spikes from the ground in this dastardly trap! It can only be powered from below. Power it again to lower the spikes.

name: No-Face
info: Embarrassed? Feel like hiding your face? How about just removing it instead?

name: Purple Djellaba
info: This long robe is suitable for male or female Growtopians, provided they want to look snazzy and colorful!

name: Yellow Djellaba
info: This long robe is suitable for male or female Growtopians, provided they want to look snazzy and colorful!

name: Green Djellaba
info: This long robe is suitable for male or female Growtopians, provided they want to look snazzy and colorful!

name: Mini Blocks
info: These blocks are only 1/4 the size of a normal block! To make up for that, they come in sets of four.

name: Teeny Blocks
info: These blocks are only 1/4 the size of Mini Blocks! To make up for that, they come in sets of sixteen.

name: Jigsaw Wallpaper
info: Well, that was easy... it's a picture of a jigsaw puzzle!

name: Riding Broomstick
info: Which magic makes this fly? Witch magic makes this fly!

name: Techno Visor
info: This is handy technology for people who are overwhelmed with modern life - it blocks one of your ears from hearing things, and one of your eyes from seeing things. Just relax and enjoy the left half of the world.

name: Glowstick
info: This plastic tube of lethal radioactive elements is the perfect thing to swing around at a party! It also provides light.

name: Display Shelf
info: These are some big shelves. Why not display your favorite items on them? They can hold four items to display.

name: One-Way Block
info: This block can only be moved through in the direction the arrow is pointing. From the other direction, it might as well be a wall!

name: VIP Entrance
info: The fanciest door in town! The only people getting through this door are the ones who are on The List. Wrench the door to add people to The List. Or remove them, if they have offended you in some way.

name: Rhino Horn
info: Aw, it thinks you're its mama!

name: Globe
info: Add a little class to your office with a globe! You can also wrench it to check the current top worlds.

name: Challenge Timer
info: Players can punch this to begin a challenge: get from the Challenge Start Flag to the Challenge End Flag before time runs out! Wrench the timer to set up your challenge and insert prizes.

name: Challenge Start Flag
info: Use this with a Challenge Timer. Wrench it to set an ID, so it knows which Challenge Timer to work with.

name: Challenge End Flag
info: Use this with a Challenge Timer. Wrench it to set an ID, so it knows which Challenge Timer to work with.

name: Fish Wall Mount
info: Proud of your catch, but you don't want the responsibility of caring for it? Mount it to this wall plaque with your wrench! You can only display `9Perfect`` or `9Massive`` fish on this mount. Once a fish is mounted, it can never be removed.

name: Octopus Head
info: This is why aquariums have rules.

name: Stonefish
info: This is one of the most poisonous fish in the world! It's also made of rock, which is weird.

name: Tamago Sushi
info: Wait, this sushi doesn't even have fish in it!

name: Portrait
info: Demonstrating your speed-painting skills by painting pictures of anyone in your world in moments! Wrench the portrait to begin painting. It costs 2 of each color of paint for each painting.

name: Orca
info: You could put this in a fish tank, but then people would probably make documentaries about you. Not flattering ones.

name: Red Hair Dye
info: Pour this gunk on your head if you want your hair to be red! It may require multiple applications to achieve the desired color, or mixing with other dyes. The dye interacts with your natural hair color, so some colors may simply be impossible to achieve.

name: Green Hair Dye
info: Pour this gunk on your head if you want your hair to be green! It may require multiple applications to achieve the desired color, or mixing with other dyes. The dye interacts with your natural hair color, so some colors may simply be impossible to achieve.

name: Blue Hair Dye
info: Pour this gunk on your head if you want your hair to be blue! It may require multiple applications to achieve the desired color, or mixing with other dyes. The dye interacts with your natural hair color, so some colors may simply be impossible to achieve.

name: Black Hair Dye
info: Pour this gunk on your head if you want your hair to be black! It may require multiple applications to achieve the desired color, or mixing with other dyes. The dye interacts with your natural hair color, so some colors may simply be impossible to achieve.

name: Shampoo
info: Messed your hair up with dyes? Wash it out with the refreshing scent of lime, coconut, wallaby, and pears. Lather, rinse, and repeat - one bottle might not do the job.

name: Weather Machine - Stuff
info: It's rainin' stuff! This amazing new weather machine will let you choose any item you have to rain down from the sky! Wrench it to choose your item and adjust other settings. You can only have one of these per world.

name: Beehive
info: I feel like this warning is unnecessary, but I'll say it anyway: don't punch a beehive.

name: Honey
info: The sweet nectar of bee spit! Bees also craft plastic bear shapes to store it in. Nobody knows why.

name: Sorcerer Stone
info: There's a mystical gem embedded in this rock. Heck, there's probably a few in there. Smash it open and see!

name: Villain Portrait - The Harvester
info: Just before knocking him unconscious, you snapped a lovely photo of The Harvester for posterity. Put it up on the wall, show off your achievement!

name: Cosmic Power - Life Harvest
info: This is a `#Rare`` `5Cosmic`` Superpower card for use in fighting crime. You can also place it as a block! Cosmic Cards aren't used, they just have an effect as long as they are in your hand. Card effect: `wHeal 1 life every time you inflict more than 1 damage.``

name: Super Shirt - Autumn
info: Fight crime in this mighty leafy leotard!

name: Muscle Shirt - Autumn
info: Flex your muscles in this mighty leafy leotard!

name: Heroic Tights - Autumn
info: To be a leafy superhero, you really need to wear tights of some sort.

name: Super Tights - Autumn
info: To be a leafy superhero, you really need to wear tights of some sort.

name: Heroic Boots - Autumn
info: These leafy boots add nothing to your crimefighting skills except to protect you from stray Legos.

name: Super Cape - Autumn
info: You're no Heroman, but it's still pretty swell.

name: Superheroine Top - Autumn
info: Flex your muscles in this mighty leafy leotard!

name: Super Eye Mask - Autumn
info: Protect your secret identity, by hiding the inch of skin around your eyes.  Who could possibly recognize you?

name: Super Logo - Leaf
info: Emblazon this logo on your super costume to fight crime as... Leaf Lord? Lady Leaf? The Fallen Avenger? It's up to you!

name: Harvest Witch Mask
info: Normally this mask is only worn during the most profane of dark rituals, beneath a blood red moon. But you can wear it for shopping, parties, whatever!

name: Harvest Horn
info: Don't blow this horn. Never blow this horn. It is evil.

name: Ancestor Mooncake
info: This pastry is filled with a sweet bean paste. An image of your ancestor is imprinted on the top. Mix this with other Mooncakes in a Laboratory or E-Z Cook Oven to create special Harvest Festival items.

name: Blue Hanbok Top
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Orange Hanbok Top
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Blue Hanbok Pants
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Orange Hanbok Pants
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Green Hanbok Skirt
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Yellow Hanbok Skirt
info: These festival clothes are extra festive!

name: Sunflower Hair Pin
info: When sunflowers are out of season, stick this plastic replacement in your hair.

name: Lil' Sheepers
info: Baa. This little baby sheep will follow you everywhere you go! Mainly because it's tied to your wrist.

name: Sheep
info: Baaaaaaa. You can shear a sheep once every few days!

name: Wool
info: This is just a blob of wool. Not too useful. Get 100 of these to weave a bolt together!

name: Wool Bolt
info: Sew wool items by using this in a sewing machine with silk bolts. It takes 3 bolts of silk or wool to craft an item.

name: Harvest Robinsons
info: These special edition Air Robinsons are themed to celebrate the harvest, or just be bright crazy colors, like all basketball shoes.

name: Silkworm Soul
info: The great thing about silkworms is that they don't have unique souls. They're totally interchangeable! Jam this into any dead silkworm to bring it back for a 2nd chance.

name: Telephone
info: It's a phone! Dial it with your wrench (and try 12345 to start - trust us!). Growtopia doesn't have any cell service, so you're stuck with this old thing.

name: Wooden Sword
info: They use these to train in Kendo. They won't cut much, but getting whacked with one certainly does hurt!

name: Crazy Jim
info: not a real item, just for an icon in the telephone screen.

name: Code Block: Kappa
info: This block looks like a mysterious computronic data reference. But that's just for fun, I'm sure. I mean, this is just a game... isn't it?

name: Code Block: Charlie
info: This block looks like a mysterious computronic data reference. But that's just for fun, I'm sure. I mean, this is just a game... isn't it?

name: Code Block: Ouroboros
info: This block looks like a mysterious computronic data reference. But that's just for fun, I'm sure. I mean, this is just a game... isn't it?

name: Code Block: Edamame
info: This block looks like a mysterious computronic data reference. But that's just for fun, I'm sure. I mean, this is just a game... isn't it?

name: Wool Scarf
info: Your neck is toasty warm. Maybe you should put some pants on too.

name: Sheep Shears
info: This handy tool is a lot more effective at cutting wool than your fingers are, so you can get twice as much when you use it to shear a sheep!

name: Illuminati Stone
info: Finally, 100% undeniable proof! You have DISCOVERED THE TRUTH!!

name: Fossil Rock
info: This rock seems to have a fossil embedded in it. Maybe you could crack it loose if you tap very carefully with a Rock Hammer. There is a rumor, as old as time itself, that having a busy world will generate more Fossil Rock. The Growtopia Archaeological Society have officially announced that this is totally untrue. Time to bury that rumor, once and for all!

info: This rock seems to have a fossil embedded in it. Maybe you could crack it loose if you tap very carefully with a Rock Hammer. There is a rumor, as old as time itself, that having a busy world will generate more Fossil Boulder. The Growtopia Archaeological Society have officially announced that this is totally untrue. name: Igneous Rock
info: Igneous rock is formed through the cooling and solidification of magma or lava.

name: Rock Hammer
info: A precision instrument for chipping fossils out of rocks. If you find a fossil, equip this hammer and start tapping - but do it *carefully!* If the fossil comes loose and you hit again, you'll break it!

name: Rock Chisel
info: So you've extracted a fossil from a rock, but the rock is still in your way. That's where the chisel comes in! It lets you chip away the rock without damaging the fossil.

name: Fossil
info: A corpse from millions of years ago, turned to stone. It's still covered with a lot of stone, so we're not sure what it is just yet. Try cleaning it off in a Fossil Prep Station.

name: Fossil Prep Station
info: Put a fossil in this tank where special solvents and bacterial agents will slowly dissolve any remaining rock and reveal exactly what you've found. The time required varies anywhere from an hour to a day depending on how much needs dissolving. The light turns green when it's ready, so punch to collect!

name: Ammonite Block
info: A huge beautiful ammonite fossil has been extracted! It'd make a lovely coffee table.

name: Dino Ribcage
info: It's a bit grisly, but these enormous bones make kind of a fun set of monkey bars...

name: Dinosaur Mask
info: This is how you would look if a dinosaur snuck up behind you and swallowed you, but you got stuck in his throat. It's really a bad situation for everyone involved.

name: Ancient Plant Seed
info: This seed from the ancient past is completely intact - there may still be some DNA inside! Plant DNA, but still that's exciting, right?

name: Amber Block
info: This ancient tree sap has hardened into a beautiful crystal. Who knows, there might even be a mosquito inside holding dinosaur DNA! That's pretty standard for amber.

name: T-Rex Skull
info: This would make an impressive display in your museum! Even more impressive in your haunted house.

name: DNA Processor
info: This advanced device from Growtech can take in strands of ancient DNA and combine them to create real living creatures. It has terrifying ethical implications.

name: Dino DNA Strand A-273
info: This is a strand of prehistoric DNA. All we know for sure is it came from a dinosaur. Perhaps there's a way to recombine it and bring them back! That doesn't seem like a terrible idea at all.

name: Dino DNA Strand C-904
info: This is a strand of prehistoric DNA. All we know for sure is it came from a dinosaur. Perhaps there's a way to recombine it and bring them back! That doesn't seem like a terrible idea at all.

name: Dino DNA Strand G-137
info: This is a strand of prehistoric DNA. All we know for sure is it came from a dinosaur. Perhaps there's a way to recombine it and bring them back! That doesn't seem like a terrible idea at all.

name: Dino DNA Strand T-658
info: This is a strand of prehistoric DNA. All we know for sure is it came from a dinosaur. Perhaps there's a way to recombine it and bring them back! That doesn't seem like a terrible idea at all.

name: Plant DNA Strand X-277
info: This is a strand of prehistoric DNA. All we know for sure is it came from a plant. Perhaps there's a way to recombine it and bring them back! That actually sounds pretty safe, since it's a plant.

name: Plant DNA Strand Y-985
info: This is a strand of prehistoric DNA. All we know for sure is it came from a plant. Perhaps there's a way to recombine it and bring them back! That actually sounds pretty safe, since it's a plant.

name: Prehistoric Red Fern
info: It's sad to think about where this grows.

name: Purple Devourer Plant
info: This is what happens when you give a prehistoric flower a taste for magic bacon!

name: Blue Devourer Plant
info: This is what happens when you give a prehistoric flower a taste for magic bacon!

name: Prehistoric Vines
info: You can hide from rampaging dinosaurs in these vines.

name: Prehistoric Candy Vines
info: You can try to hide from rampaging dinosaurs in these vines, but you'll probably get eaten because the vines themselves taste like candy.

name: Seussian Tree
info: These particular trees, near the Jurassic seas, produced quite a crunchety fruit. Though scientists say that it tasted okay, we can't pollinate so it's moot.

name: Flowersaurus Rex
info: You monster, what fresh horror have you wrought?!!? Has science gone too far?

name: Blue Riding Raptor
info: I know, they're supposed to have feathers and stuff nowadays... Well, this is an old-school raptor!

name: Brown Riding Raptor
info: I know, they're supposed to have feathers and stuff nowadays... Well, this is an old-school raptor!

name: Red Riding Raptor
info: I know, they're supposed to have feathers and stuff nowadays... Well, this is an old-school raptor!

name: Golden Riding Raptor
info: I think this raptor has more World Locks than you do.

name: Raptor DNA Strand Alpha
info: This is a strand of prehistoric DNA. It appears to be the beginning of a velociraptor DNA sequence. Perhaps there's a way to recombine it and bring them back! That doesn't seem like a terrible idea at all.

name: Raptor DNA Strand Omega
info: This is a strand of prehistoric DNA. It appears to be the tail end of a velociraptor DNA sequence. Perhaps there's a way to recombine it and bring them back! That doesn't seem like a terrible idea at all.

name: DNA Extractor
info: This experimental device can extract prehistoric DNA from objects which contain even small traces. To give it a try, just use an item on it and see what you find! This is very new technology, so results are unpredictable, and rarely successful.

name: Stone Spear
info: In ancient times, sticks and stones were about as good as it got. The upside is it's a magic stone - this spear will teleport back into your hand once thrown!

name: Blue Hardhat
info: Head protection is required in construction areas, and at some dig sites.

name: Outback Hat
info: G'day! Barbie! Shrimp! That's not a knife, it's a hat! These hats are popular among paleontologists and other desert dwellers.

name: Fossil Brush
info: You can use this to gently brush a fossil before you pick it up, improving its quality. A Fossil Brush will be destroyed upon use (fossils are very rough until you brush them!). If you pick up a fossil, your finger oils will make a Fossil Brush useless, so be sure you brush before collecting!

name: Polished Fossil
info: This fossil has been carefully polished, so it's sure to yield something good when run through a Fossil Prep Station!

name: Doompunk Corset
info: Internal organs rotted away? The corset should fit you fine!

name: Doompunk Skirt
info: Multiple layers of petticoats keep you warm when stalking your prey!

name: Doompunk Top Hat
info: Keep an extra pair of goggles up there. You never know when you'll need them for evil.

name: Doompunk Waistcoat
info: The perfect garment for housing a pocketwatch, monocle, and perhaps poison needles. Definitely some evil stuff in those pockets.

name: Doompunk Leggings
info: Works equally well for a doompunk or a pirate! Or maybe a serial killer from the 80's.

name: Doompunk Trenchcoat
info: Keep warm while stalking people on those frosty London evenings in this stylish piece by Grow Couture! Note: this is a "chest item", like a necklace, so you can wear any shirts and back items you want underneath it.

name: Eye Of Growganoth
info: This accursed necklace binds one of the eternal and innumerable Eyes of Growganoth to your service. Just make sure you don't take *your* eye off of it - at the first sign of weakness, it will devour your soul!

name: Apocalypse Steed
info: The four horsemen have updated to more modern steeds. They're probably gonna be pretty mad when they find out you swiped one.

name: Jack o' Lantern Mask
info: Luckily this is just latex and not actually a gooey carved-out pumpkin.

name: Buzzsaw
info: This is how your shop teacher lost those fingers.

name: Rickety Wallpaper
info: So this is what the inside of a haunted house looks like!

name: Rickety Window
info: So this is what the inside of a haunted house looks like! Plus, you can see outside of it from here.

name: Rickety Door
info: Finally, your chance to escape this haunted house! Wrench the door to set the destination.

name: Death's Scythe
info: Careful where you swing that thing.

name: Demon Chariot
info: This thing goes pretty fast for a vehicle with only 2 horsepower.

name: Logarithmic Wheel
info: You know what a really good weapon is? A wagon wheel. Yeah, I mean... yeah.

name: Demonic Skull
info: Just the thing for showing your appreciation of the darker musicks.

name: Steel Spike
info: Hey, these things have a million uses! I can't think of any right now, but they totally do. Just don't leave them inside surgical patients, please.

name: Tempered Steel Spike
info: This spike is so much shinier now! Classy enough to wear to the Halloween Ball.

name: Spiked Collar
info: Ah yeah, you look tough, like a junkyard dog.

name: Malevolent Hair
info: What are you up to under that mop-top? Seems like something a little sneaky...

name: Riding Raven
info: Only dark magic could breed a raven so massive. It's so powerful it allows you to double-jump!

name: Haunted Darkness
info: It's pitch black inside this haunted house! Players can only see what's on this tile if it's in their line of sight, or they have special tools.

name: Haunted Window
info: It's so dark in here, only the window provides any relief! Players can only see what's on this tile if it's in their line of sight, or they have special tools.

name: Haunted Door
info: Finally, your chance to escape this haunted house! Wrench the door to set up a creepy question players must answer to go through.

name: Sheet Music: Spooky
info: If you aren't in range of a Boombox, this will play a spooky sound for you. There are 14 different sounds, depending on where you place it vertically. Try them all!

name: Stone Pagoda
info: There's no better place for a Grand Tournament than in a pagoda!

name: Master Peng Stonework
info: Isn't Master Peng awesome? This stonework blends in with Stone Pagoda blocks.

name: Paper Wall
info: This wallpaper is a paper wall.

name: Stone Pagoda Roof Element
info: Stick this at the ends of your pagoda roofs. It doesn't serve any functional purpose, but it sure looks nice. Just make sure you put it the right way or it'll be floating in midair.

name: Decorative Roof Dragon
info: Just for looks. Make your pagoda roofs spikey with dragons! Not so spikey they hurt, though.

name: Grand Jade Platform
info: Something stylish to stand on. Try decorating it with Decorative Roof Dragons!

name: Stone Pagoda Base
info: This is a special piece - it looks just like the bottom row of a Stone Pagoda, and it even tiles properly with Stone Pagoda blocks. The trick is, it won't tile with ones below it. Use it to put a roof in the middle of your pagoda! Kind of a key feature of pagodas, right? It will also tile with Decorative Roof Dragons.

name: Master Peng
info: Master Peng runs The Grand Tournament. Don't mess with him. But punching is how he likes to be greeted, so one punch is cool.

name: Tourney Token
info: Your reward for victory in The Grand Tournament. Put it in the Prize Ladder to win fabulous prizes!

name: Wooden Pagoda Wall
info: For a warmer look to your pagoda, try wood. Also, you can walk in front of it, which stone is less forgiving about.

name: Wooden Pagoda Door
info: Like any door, you can wrench it to set the destination.

name: Wooden Pagoda Roof
info: This is a roof for your wooden pagoda. Unlike the Wooden Pagoda Wall, this is solid, so it's safe to stand on.

name: Prize Ladder
info: Players can put Tourney Tokens in here to push their luck in winning prizes.

name: Tournament Ticket
info: This ticket allows you entry into one Grand Tournament. Visit Master Peng in the world TOURNAMENT to enter the tournament. You can battle as many times as you wish in the current tournament, but when it ends, your ticket will self-destruct.

name: Punched Tournament Ticket
info: Your ticket has been punched! You can battle in the current Tournament as many times as you like. The ticket will self-destruct when the tournament ends. Don't lose it, or you can't battle anymore!

name: Snack Fu
info: Master Ping, Master Peng's brother, runs Snack Fu, providing delicious and exotic treats to everybody watching the tournament!

name: Ramune
info: This fizzy lemon-lime drink is sure to result in some major burps.

name: Pow Stones
info: This carbonated candy crackles and pops in your mouth. Don't worry, it's probably not made from real rocks. Warning: DO NOT COMBINE WITH SODA. Super duper true urban legends verify that this is dangerous.

name: Extractium Ore
info: This mysterious element has strange properties which seem to make DNA extraction more successful!

name: Extractium Shard
info: This mysterious element seems to be present in small quantities in ancient fossils. Maybe you can combine these shards into a piece large enough to have a measurable effect on something!

name: Tournament Banner
info: Wrench this to find out key info about the Grand Tournament!

name: Jade Portcullis
info: Lock out the ruffians with this decorative gateway.

name: Weather Machine - Pagoda
info: Wow, it's pagoda season already? They're sprouting up everywhere! This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: Non La
info: This conical straw hat is useful for full sun protection, as well as carrying stuff!

name: Minor Otherworldly Bait
info: This is bait for fishing. Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait on water that you are standing next to in order to start fishing. This bait actually travels through a wormhole into a dark dimension and catches things there, instead of in the water. `4Minorly bad`` things.

name: Lesser Otherworldly Bait
info: This is bait for fishing. Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait on water that you are standing next to in order to start fishing. This bait actually travels through a wormhole into a dark dimension and catches things there, instead of in the water. `4Lesser bad`` things.

name: Penguin Mask
info: Wanna be as COOL as Master Peng? Not gonna happen. But you can wear this mask and look like a dork.

name: Mini-Peng
info: Master Peng is so swift, he can appear to be in multiple places at once. But in the extra places, he looks very small.

name: Popcorn
info: Uh oh, drama! Somebody bust out the popcorn.

name: Wasabi Peas
info: Yowza, those are some spicy peas!

name: Present Goblin Disguise
info: Disguises you as a Present Goblin, bringer of joy.

name: Stuff-4-Toys Box
info: Drop stuff in here, and we'll donate toys to needy Growtopians!

name: Letter Block - Zerp
info: This is a letter block, like you played with when you were a kid! This particular one has the letter Zerp on it. But I don't need to tell you that, you can just read it!

name: Letter Block - Forg
info: This is a letter block, like you played with when you were a kid! This particular one has the letter Forg on it. But I don't need to tell you that, you can just read it!

name: Letter Block - Wump
info: This is a letter block, like you played with when you were a kid! This particular one has the letter Wump on it. But I don't need to tell you that, you can just read it!

name: Letter Block - Doozle
info: This is a letter block, like you played with when you were a kid! This particular one has the letter Doozle on it. But I don't need to tell you that, you can just read it!

name: Hideous Holiday Sweater
info: Your grandma thinks you look adorable in this.

name: Winter Turtleneck
info: Celebrate Winterfest in cozy style, with no worries of chin-freeze.

name: Yo-Yo
info: It's a disc on a string. Try smacking stuff with it!

name: Meh, Bunny Suit
info: MrMehMeh stores the carrots he eats here.

name: Rubber Band Airplane
info: Toss it and see where it goes! It'll smash if it hits any blocks, so aim carefully. Tap the direction you want to throw it. The further from yourself you tap, the harder you throw.

name: Stuff-4-Toys Shirt
info: Stuff-4-Toys is offering these stylish t-shirts to all Silver level donators!

name: Present Goblin Home Edition
info: Dress up as a Present Goblin for fun! You won't automatically drop presents, but it's festive year-round! This costume overrides all other clothing, but if you don't like tossing tennis balls, try equipping other sportsballs with it!

name: Solsascarf
info: Solsagann is tossing out yesterday's baguettes! They are quite stale.

name: Stuff-4-Toys Tote Bag
info: Tote around your shopping with our fabulous tote bag. It lets everybody know you are serious about donating Stuff for Toys.

name: Betty Bluetooth Doll
info: This high-tech doll is the big craze this Winterfest! Everybody wants a remote-controlled doll that fires deadly lightning bolts!

name: Surg-E
info: This robot is an amazingly accurate human analog (just look at it!), capable of simulating a wide range of disease and trauma conditions. Place it anywhere and wrench it to perform surgery just like on a human being. Since you have to cut into it, it's only usable once, win or lose.

name: Caduceus
info: This symbol is your reward for saving someone with surgery. You can trade them for rare surgical prizes by calling Sales-Man on your Telephone at 53785. Double-tap this in your inventory to combine 100 of them into a Golden Caduceus.

name: Golden Caduceus
info: This is worth 100 Caducei (that's the plural of Caduceus, I looked it up!). Double-tap this in your inventory to break one back down into 100 Caducei. You can trade these for rare surgical prizes by calling Sales-Man on your Telephone at 53785.

name: Golden Dragon Statue
info: Congratulations, you won the Grand Tournament!

name: Silver Dragon Statue
info: Congratulations, you placed in the top 3 of the Grand Tournament!

name: Jade Dragon Statue
info: Congratulations, you placed in the top 10 of the Grand Tournament!

name: Surgical Pins
info: Used only in surgery. When a bone is absolutely shattered, you need to use pins to put it back together. A splint won't do it! Can only be used once you've opened an incision, of course.

name: Surgical Transfusion
info: Used only in surgery. If a patient's blood supply gets dangerously low, this will fill 'er up!

name: Surgical Defibrillator
info: Used only in surgery. If a patient's heart stops (which can happen when they are anesthetized), zap them with this to fire it up again.

name: Surgical Clamp
info: Used only in surgery. This can reduce a patient's bleeding significantly, but without closing up their incisions, like Surgical Stitches will do. You can only use this when you have open incisions.

name: Surgical Ultrasound
info: Used only in surgery. This detailed scan can inform you of any broken bones, tumors, or other physical issues within the patient's body. Use this right away to diagnose the problem!

name: Surgical Lab Kit
info: Used only in surgery. This kit will identify different microbes that could be present in the patient. Use it right away to diagnose any bacterial or viral issues. You cannot use Surgical Antibiotics until you've used a Lab Kit to identify the bacteria you're fighting.

name: Empty Surgery Tray
info: Not a real item, just used for an icon.

name: Autoclave
info: Wrench this device to clean your surgical instruments. And by "clean", we mean exchange 20 of one instrument for 1 of every other instrument.

name: Biotronic Brain Enhancer
info: This advanced cybernetic technology will increase your mental capacity, granting you 50% more XP (on average) for half an hour.

name: Plague Doctor Mask
info: There was a time when actual medical professionals would go out on the streets wearing this. It was a creepy, creepy time.

name: Plague Doctor Hat
info: Rumpled and frumpy, really showing your dedication to your craft.

name: Plague Doctor Robe
info: This robe is intended to protect you from pestilence. Sadly, it was invented in pre-scientific times, so all it really protects you from is cold weather.

name: Living Dead Remote
info: You just couldn't accept your patients' deaths. And now you've created an abomination, haven't you? What has your foul science wrought?!

name: Spare Body Part
info: Oh, nobody's even gonna notice this is missing, I'm sure. They had at least two of these when they came in.

name: Spare Body
info: Wow, you had all the right parts to make a spare body! You never know when this might come in handy.

name: Limb Connector
info: This horrible twisted spikey thing could surely jam some limbs together if you needed to do that. For some reason.

name: Massive Fang
info: Imagine the size of the wolf this came from!

name: Howler
info: This seemingly harmless statue actually launches deadly sonic blasts. Wrench it to set the rate of fire! You can place as many Howlers as you like, but only 10 blasts can exist at a time, so if you have a lot, most of them will just sit there.

name: Gemmin' Juice
info: Got your mind on your gems and your gems on your mind? Start sippin' on Gemmin' Juice! It gives you a 10% chance of getting double gems from any blocks you break for 30 minutes. Consumed when used.

name: Wolf Skull Shoulders
info: Three heads are better than one, even if two of them are empty and skinless.

name: Wolf Gate
info: Punch it to open or shut it. Anyone unlucky enough to be caught inside when it closes gets wolfed down.

name: Wolf Ticket
info: This ticket is your reward for completing Wolfworld. You can trade them for rare Wolfworld prizes by calling Sales-Man on your Telephone at 53785. Double-tap this in your inventory to combine 100 of them into an Enchanted Wolf Ticket.

name: Enchanted Wolf Ticket
info: This is worth 100 Wolf Tickets. Double-tap this in your inventory to break one back down into 100 Wolf Tickets. You can trade these for rare Wolfworld prizes by calling Sales-Man on your Telephone at 53785.

name: Sales-Man Standee
info: The perfect way to advertise your wares - with a cardboard cut-out of Sales-Man himself! Scientifically proven to drive conversions and increase ROI.

name: Sales Shades
info: Cover your eyes, the savings are simply too glorious to behold!

name: Ghost Wolf Monocle
info: This monocle is haunted by the spirit of an ancient wolf! That's more common than you'd expect among monocles.

name: Challenge of Fenrir
info: Your prowess in the Wolfworld has caused Fenrir himself to challenge you! Use this summons on `8All Howl's Eve`` to enter the halls of `1Valhowla``. Once inside, you'll have only 3 minutes to search for the 4 treasures. And don't forget `2Climbing Boots`` and a light source!

name: Party Screamer
info: Blow this horn to let everybody know where the party is! It's like a super broadcast, only you can't control what you say, because this party be OFF THE CHIZZY!!

name: Valhowla Treasure
info: Treasures for players to collect in Valhowla.

name: Party Popper
info: Get the party started with a blast of streamers!

name: Party Bunting
info: Dress the place up a little for our anniversary party!

name: Party Fowl
info: Whoa dude, major party fowl. You earned this for playing Growtopia for THREE YEARS, and over 300 hours, and reaching level 50! Wow, that's dedication.

name: IIII Block
info: It's Growtopia's fourth anniversary! Celebrate with this classic pewter-plated design reminiscent of the Roman numeral 4. Yes, you can write 4 as IIII instead of IV, that's a real thing!

name: Party Cake
info: This tastes so good it just makes you want to dance!

name: Head Bangin' Steel Wolf
info: This robotic wolf rocks hard. Punch to activate, wrench to adjust settings.

name: Pink Bunting
info: Fancy the place up a little with some lovely pink fabric.

name: Blue Bunting
info: Fancy the place up a little with some lovely blue fabric.

name: White Bunting
info: Fancy the place up a little with some lovely white fabric.

name: Green Bunting
info: Fancy the place up a little with some lovely green fabric.

name: Yellow Bunting
info: Fancy the place up a little with some lovely yellow fabric.

name: Red & White Awning
info: These are surprisingly bouncy. Hold Jump as you land for maximum bounce.

name: Green & Yellow Awning
info: These are surprisingly bouncy. Hold Jump as you land for maximum bounce.

name: Blue Awning
info: These are surprisingly bouncy. Hold Jump as you land for maximum bounce.

name: Black Awning
info: These are surprisingly bouncy. Hold Jump as you land for maximum bounce.

name: Heart Awning
info: These are surprisingly bouncy. Hold Jump as you land for maximum bounce.

name: Pink Cat As A Hat
info: Oh, the places you'll go wearing this hat! You can wear it on the train, or in the rain, or... well, actually don't wear it in the rain, it'll shrink.

name: Pink Cat As A Hat Seed
Blue Cat As A Hat
info: Oh, the places you'll go wearing this hat! You can wear it on the train, or in the rain, or... well, actually don't wear it in the rain, it'll shrink.

name: Blue Cat As A Hat Seed
Grey Cat As A Hat
info: Oh, the places you'll go wearing this hat! You can wear it on the train, or in the rain, or... well, actually don't wear it in the rain, it'll shrink.

name: Grey Cat As A Hat Seed
Orange Cat As A Hat
info: Oh, the places you'll go wearing this hat! You can wear it on the train, or in the rain, or... well, actually don't wear it in the rain, it'll shrink.

name: Orange Cat As A Hat Seed
Gruel
info: This bland flavorless mush is not delicious. The only nice thing about it is that you can feed it to a Silkworm without changing its color!

name: Pegasus
info: If you were a pegasus, you'd spend all your time flying too. Why walk on those teeny legs? Those mighty wings allow you both to double jump, too.

name: Golden Pegasus
info: If you were a pegasus, you'd spend all your time flying too. Why walk on those teeny legs? Those mighty wings allow you both to double jump, too.

name: Heart Glasses
info: The world just looks like a lovelier place through these rose-colored glasses.

name: Loveseat
info: Legs getting tired? Have a seat!

name: Golden Heart Glasses
info: The world just looks like a more expensive place through these gold-tinted glasses.

name: Chocolate Heart
info: Chocolate heals all wounds. Emotional wounds that is. It is pretty useless for broken bones. And really it doesn't do much for emotional problems either, it just tastes good.

name: Ruby Shard
info: Watch out, this is a really sharp fragment of Ruby. It seems strangely magnetically attracted to other shards like it. Maybe if you got 200 of them together, they'd fuse into something! Yeah, that's how reality works!

name: Ruby Lock
info: Locks an entire world. And looks lovely doing it. There's a 1% chance each day that a rock in the world will become Heartstone! More rocks do not increase the chance.

name: Chemsynth Processor
info: Place a row of 10 Chemsynth Tanks to the right of this machine, and then wrench it to use GrowTech's new synthetic chemical creation technology! Patent pending.

name: Chemsynth Tank
info: You'll need to attach this to the right side of a Chemsynth Processor to get any use out of it. You'll need 10 attached to a Chemsynth Processor, in fact.

name: Chemsynth Centrifuge
info: Use on a highlighted Chemsynth Tank to rotate chemicals around it. Rotates as many from the right as it can to match how many are to the left of the selected Tank.

name: Chemsynth Replicator
info: Use on a highlighted Chemsynth Tank to duplicate its contents, pushing all chemicals to the right to make room.

name: Chemsynth Catalyst
info: Use on a highlighted Chemsynth Tank to shift its color upward on the spectrum (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue, Pink, Red). This also affects all touching tanks of the same color.

name: Chemsynth Solvent
info: Use on a highlighted Chemsynth Tank to dissolve it, shifting chemicals left to fill in the gap. A random chemical is added in the rightmost tank.

name: Chemsynth Stirrer
info: Use on a highlighted Chemsynth Tank to swap the chemicals on either side of it with each other. The selected tank is unaffected.

name: Synthetic Chemical
info: This chemical was created in a lab. Its properties are virtually untested!

name: Gruesome Marker
info: Use these sort of like Doors - They have IDs, so Doors can lead to them, though you can't travel from them. Use your wrench to set their ID.

name: Skeletal Throne
info: Looks like you're the new king of the zombies! Or somebody with four legs died here.

name: Zombie Brain
info: Ew, this is a brain that popped out of a zombie's head! Maybe Sales-Man wants it. You sure don't. Double-tap this in your inventory to combine 100 of them into a Pile of Zombie Brains.

name: Pile of Zombie Brains
info: Ew, these are all brains that popped out of zombies' heads! Maybe Sales-Man wants them. You sure don't. Double-tap this in your inventory to split it up into 100 Zombie Brains.

name: Mutated Seed Core
info: This is an immature mutated seed. It'll mature into a mutated seed if you log out and back in!

name: Zombie Defense Force Helmet
info: This helmet covers your vital brain region from zombie attack. Unfortunately, zombies only need to punch you to infect you, so it's not terribly useful.

name: Zombie Defense Force Uniform
info: This is the official uniform of the Zombie Defense Force! It has lots of pockets for your lip balm, candy, paper clips, and other key zombie-fighting tools.

name: Zombie Defense Force Pants
info: You could just wear any green pants and you probably wouldn't get in trouble, but these have a cool Z logo sewn into the inside waistband.

name: Camouflage Facepaint
info: They'll never see you coming. Unless they look anywhere other than your face. At least you might freak them out - "Ah, it's a guy with no face!!"

name: AK-8087
info: The ultimate zombie-slaying weapon. Or pumpkin-slaying.

name: Barricaded Door
info: This door has been barricaded, so zombies can't get through it, only normal Growtopians! Place one and then use your Wrench on it to set the destination.

name: Infected Door
info: Yuck, this door has horrible zombie slime on it. Nobody but a zombie would dare enter it. Place one and then use your Wrench on it to set the destination.

name: Zombie Sign
info: This sign is written in Zombese, so humans can't read it, only zombies!

name: Retinal Scan Data Repository
info: This data system can store useful information, but the retinal scan prevents zombies from accessing it. Only humans can!

name: Skull Launcher
info: The ultimate zombie weapon. Actually, the only zombie weapon - you can use this while you're a zombie! (Also usable by humans)

name: Rainbow Kite
info: The most colorful kite in all of Growtopia!

name: Zombie Hound
info: Braaainnss! This little puppy just wants to play! Or maybe he's hungry... hmmm...

name: Crazy Zombie Hair
info: The undead use a lot of hairspray.

name: Objective Marker
info: Use these sort of like Doors - They have IDs, so Doors can lead to them, though you can't travel from them. Use your wrench to set their ID.

name: Infected Block
info: This block is pulsing with g-Virus infection. It should be safe to smash, just wash your hands afterward.

name: Weather Machine - Apocalypse
info: Feeling nostalgic for the end of the world? Let's bring it back! With this weather active, somebody in your world will get infected with the g-Virus every hour, and players can kill zombies in your world, with the appropriate weapon. This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: g-Virus Info Sign
info: Anybody can wrench this sign to see the current status of the g-Virus epidemic. Remember to wash your hands!

name: Mutated Cell
info: Strange mutated cells collected during the Zombie Apocalypse. If you combine 200 of them, you might be able to create new mutant life...

name: Chainlink Fence
info: The flimsiest and cheapest way to keep zombies out. Unfortunately this fence is in front of Growtopia, so it only keeps zombies from getting into the game from outside of the screen, which is a pretty unlikely situation.

name: Z.D.F. Fence
info: Let the zombies know what they're in for if they trample your fence! The Z.D.F. is ready to rumble!

name: Rusted Chainlink Fence
info: It won't take zombies long to get through this fence!

name: Commercial Oven
info: Real chefs do their cooking in GrowTech Ovens like this - 2 bays, with individual heat settings up to 11,000 K. And a warming drawer! Wrench it for information.

name: Chef's Whites

info: This portal isn't actually lucky unless you set a destination for it that is lucky. So it's really up to you!

name: Lucky Kitty

name: Bamboo

name: Golden Razor Wings

info: This is not even food. Nobody would eat this.

name: Sheet Music: Sax Note
info: If you aren't in range of a Boombox, this will play a saxophone note for you. Put it in different places for different pitches.

name: Sheet Music: Sharp Sax
info: This plays a half-step higher note than Sheet Music: Sax Note.

name: Sheet Music: Flat Sax
info: This plays a half-step lower note than Sheet Music: Sax Note.

name: Sheet Music: Repeat End
info: This marks where your song should repeat a section. The music marker will jump back to the most recent Sheet Music: Repeat Begin that's in the same row (or the beginning of the song if not). If you need to repeat a section more than once, put Repeat pairs in multiple rows.

name: Saxamaphone
info: You can't punch when holding this, you're too busy ROCKING! Punch anywhere to play music. If you punch to your left or right, you can bend the note higher or lower. Punch in your own column to play the same notes that Sheet Music: Sax Note plays.

name: Hazmat Pants

name: Hazmat Helmet
info: Protects your precious face from exposure to harmful stuff.

name: Uranium Block

name: Locked Adventure Door

info: Install this right next to walls. If a player is holding an Adventure Item - Rope, they can climb the wall.

name: Ancient Block

info: These blocks can be punched by the world owner to open or close them. But if a player lights an Adventure Brazier, they will be reversed for that player - open ones will be shut, shut ones will be open.

name: Adventure Pedestal
info: When a player who has Adventure Item - Golden Idol steps on this, their idol is placed on the pedestal, opening all Adventure Idol Gates in the world (for them only), or shutting ones that are open.

name: Adventure Idol Gate
info: These blocks can be punched by the world owner to open or close them. But if a player places an idol on an Adventure Pedestal, they will be reversed for that player - open ones will be shut, shut ones will be open.

info: This gorilla will pummel anyone who gets close! But if you have an Adventure Item - Banana, you can punch him to give it to him, and sneak by while he is eating for 10 seconds.

name: Minecart
info: Nothing says adventure like riding around in a minecart! Tracks not included (But the wheels are modified to run on any surface).

name: Adventure Item - Pineapple
info: Place this in your world to be used in your Gateways To Adventure! Players can pick it up by punching it. They lose it if they leave your world.

name: Mystery Door
info: You can set up to 5 destinations for this door with your Wrench, and when a player enters it, they'll be sent randomly to any of them!

name: Adventure Checkpoint
info: If you die, you'll respawn at the last Checkpoint you touched!
