info: Kinda creepy, like you're in a green room with no lights on...

name: Dark Blue Wallpaper
info: Kinda creepy, like you're trapped deep beneath the waves...

name: Super Squirt Gun Jetpack Pants
info: Strap these to your hips and get ready for the ride of your life. Use the power of pressurization to leap tall buildings in a single bound, then drift gently to Earth.

name: Super Squirt Gun Jetpack Pants Seed
Solar Chariot
info: Run at the speed of, well... horses. On FIRE!

name: Silk Corset
info: Feeling fat? You could exercise... or you could just cram your gut into one of these! Oh sure, you may end up with spinal deformities, but beauty demands pain!

name: Gothic Corset
info: Feeling fat? You could exercise... or you could just cram your gut into one of these! Oh sure, you may end up with spinal deformities, but beauty demands pain!

name: Unicorn Hair
info: Like unicorns? Well, so does the rest of the internet, and now you can look like one, too!

name: Emerald Pickaxe
info: This tool is worth more than the stuff you mine with it!

name: Sand Shark
info: A shark with a vicious bite. Sand Sharks can live up to seven years old. See this shark in action in Hungry Shark World!

name: Megalodon
info: Amazing! You have caught the incredibly rare and elusive Megalodon. The largest shark ever. Class: MEGA-SIZED! Along with a mega diet, it's incredibly powerful and deadly. See this shark in action in Hungry Shark World!

name: Beanbag
info: Flop down into a world of lazy wonder with this majestic sack o' beans!

name: Black Espadrille
info: Perfect for kicking back - or kicking butt! - in the tropical sun.

name: Checkered Espadrille
info: Perfect for kicking back - or kicking butt! - in the tropical sun.

name: Sports Bra
info: Get running and show off your curves while you're at it!

name: Pink Aura
info: You are burning with lively energies! Also, double-jump power.

name: Blue Aura
info: You are burning with brilliant energy! Also, double-jump power.

name: Wedding Headdress
info: Everyone should look like a queen at their own wedding.

name: Sarong
info: Casual, comfortable, and affordable! What more could you want?

name: Dress with Smock
info: This light cotton dress is adorned with adorable stripes. Aww, how cute.

name: Waistcoat and Jacket
info: The perfect garment for housing a pocketwatch and monocle. Will also keep you warm during those long winter days.

name: Orange
info: A delicious sphere, complete with sweet, tingling citrus flavor.

name: Orange Juice
info: Oranges are great. Grind the heck out of them and they're still delicious! Only, like, wetter.

name: Inside-Out Devil Wings
info: You don't jump higher than with normal devil wings, but man, you DO look pretty cool, like an inside-out devil. Wait... doesn't that make you an angel?!

name: Speed Medallion
info: This amulet bestows you with speed energy, making you run so fast that lightning trails behind you!

name: Skateboard
info: Skate or die! Alternatively you can live by doing other things, like eating and breathing. Actually, do those even if you ARE skating.

name: Antigravity Generator
info: Disables gravity in your world when activated (punch to activate)! Well, it reduces gravity, and lets everybody jump as much as they want! This sensitive technology can't be used while damaged.

name: Builder's Lock
info: Locks 200 tiles around itself. Only allows either building or breaking of blocks inside - wrench it to decide which!

name: Burning Hands
info: Spew jets of flame from your hands!

name: Riding Turtle
info: It's not the fastest transportation around, but it is the bumpiest!

name: Weather Machine - Background
info: Tired of pesky weather? Choose any Background Block with this weather machine, and your world will look like you filled it up with that block! This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: Playful Fire Sprite
info: Looks like a little blob of fire is following you! Makes sense.

name: Playful Wind Sprite
info: Looks like a little purple blob is following you! Doesn't make as much sense, but the air-colored ones didn't show up so well, so we dyed it!

name: Playful Wood Sprite
info: Looks like a little green blob is following you! Makes sense.

name: Playful Water Sprite
info: Looks like a little blob of water is following you! Makes sense.

name: Plate Greaves
info: Tired of being kicked in the shins? Aren't we all?

name: Flaming Horsie
info: There was a saddle on here, but it burned up. Eh, you can probably ride bareback.

name: Flaming Horse Chunk
info: This is fairly morbid. Also hot.

name: Newspaper
info: Great for checking the daily gazette. Equip to read.

name: Riding Chicken
info: A feathered friend to carry you to and fro! Best part? He'll never peck you to death with hordes of his angry pals!

name: Prismatic Aura
info: A fantastic aura of prismatic energy pulses around you, turning heads and bending the laws of gravity to your will. The power to double jump - and look awesome - is yours!

name: Chicken Plow
info: Ancient magic has unlocked the secrets of advanced chicken farming! Now, for the first time, your chicken will PLANT seeds instead of eating them! (When equipped, will plant whatever seed you have selected as you move!)

name: Fire Essence
info: The blazing heart of blockdom. Ow! Ow! Spicy.

name: Water Essence
info: The slippery, liquid soul of blocks. Not only looks nice - it's also refreshing!

name: Earth Essence
info: Titantic forces of dirt and stone have ground together to forge this pure piece of earth. Also makes for a nice paperweight.

name: Wind Essence
info: Fluffy clouds and raging storms howl within this airy essence. Weighs a ton, surprisingly enough. Probably something to do with physics.

name: Fissure
info: Punch it to open or shut it. Anyone unlucky enough to be caught inside when it closes becomes one with the soil. Really handy for gravediggers, too!

name: Waterfall
info: Falling water is one of the strangest natural phenomena in Growtopia. You can't jump up through it, since you're not a salmon. You can, however, drop down, since you're like everything else!

name: Hidden Door
info: Looks like an Art Deco Block, but with extra friendship - you can use this to allow access to others! Just, y'know, keep it secret. Hidden Doors are only cool if they're secret.

name: Anemone
info: Stinging denizen of the deep! It won't kill you, but it'll hurt somethin' FIERCE. Unless you're a clown fish, I guess, but they have other things to worry about.

name: Aurora
info: Dancing celestial light, compressed into handy block form! Fun Fact: Auroras are actually caused by collisions between electrically charged particles from the sun as they enter a planet's atmosphere! ...wait, that wasn't very fun, was it?

name: Obsidian
info: Volcanic glass, forged deep beneath the earth. Slippery, potentially sharp, and has absolutely nothing to do with dragons.

name: Lava Lamp
info: Groovy glows to light up your life! This lamp may be a little outdated, but who cares? It looks awesome!

name: Fire Asteroid
info: Tearing through the atmosphere, this chunk of rock has ignited with whirls of flame! Now, thanks to magnets or something, it will float and burn forever!

name: Water Asteroid
info: Laced with unobtanium, this floating rock comes complete with lovely cinematic waterfalls! The perfect touch to elevate a zen garden, or at least make your neighbors really jealous.

name: Earth Asteroid
info: You might think most asteroids are made of earth already, but this one has EXTRA earth for the dirtiest, most magnificently rocky experience to be found in a floating piece of the heavens.

name: Wind Asteroid
info: The howling winds that came down with this asteroid have become a permanent part of it! Now it will float forever, whispering the secrets of space to you as it does. (NOTE: Secrets of space may not actually be secret. Or audible.)

name: Inferno Gate
info: These blazing magical doors connect all the worlds in Growtopia. Place one and then use your Wrench on it to set the destination. Ow, hot!

name: Tidal Gate
info: These rippling magical doors connect all the worlds in Growtopia. Place one and then use your Wrench on it to set the destination. Ah, refreshing!

name: Typhoon Gate
info: These whispering magical doors connect all the worlds in Growtopia. Place one and then use your Wrench on it to set the destination. Ooh, windy!

name: Verdant Gate
info: These lush magical doors connect all the worlds in Growtopia. Place one and then use your Wrench on it to set the destination. Wow, tropical!

name: Ancient Hinge
info: Creaking with legendary power, this must be the piece of something far greater. And doorlike. Maybe.

name: Ancient Pin
info: Eons have not dulled the point of this pointy treasure. Careful! It's supernaturally pokey!

name: Ancient Bracket
info: Superb craftmanship has kept this pristine across the ages. Once part of some grand design, it can be again... if you can figure out what it will make!

name: Ancient Lens
info: Forged with long-lost sorceries, this glass remains unscratched after untold centuries! What could it reflect? Peer through it and into a time long past...

name: Crystallized Reality
info: A raw chunk of reality itself! The pure magic surrounding it could certainly be used for something spectacular... or set on a shelf to look pretty!

name: Crystallized Wealth
info: A pure piece of prosperity! The solidified richness surrounding it could certainly be used for something spectacular... or set on a shelf to look pretty!

name: Crystallized Brilliance
info: Thought given form! The tangible intelligence surrounding it could certainly be used for something spectacular... or set on a shelf to look pretty!

name: Crystallized Nature
info: A fragment of Gaia's beating heart! The unstoppable life force surrounding it could certainly be used for something spectacular... or set on a shelf to look pretty!

name: Ancestral Totem of Wisdom
info: Incredible forces of willpower and mental strength have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this totem. Equip it and ancient knowledge will be yours...

name: Ancestral Tesseract of Dimensions
info: Astonishing whirls of space and time have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this tesseract. Equip it and watch your hoard grow...

name: Ancestral Seed of Life
info: Fantastic powers of verdant might have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this seed. Equip it and the bloom of life will bend to your will...

name: Ancestral Lens of Riches
info: Unrelenting luck and luxury have been combined with the building blocks of creation to forge this lens. Equip it and unstoppable fortune will be yours... but do be careful. Power tends to corrupt, after all.

name: Ancient Altar
info: A celestial seat of crafting power - use this to make your artifacts even better. Who knew you could improve on perfection?

name: Ghastly Robe
info: Clutching darkness whispers from the very essence of this dire robe. A mantle of unfathomable shadow, only the brave dare wear it, for it is marked by the haunting touch of the grave. We don't know where it came from - only that it must have been incredibly, deeply dark.

name: Bonsai
info: Carefully tended and artfully shaped, this miniature plant is a harmonious expression of art and nature. It also makes for very tasty - but very small - salad!

name: Acorn
info: The tiny start of a mighty oak! Don't collect too many, or the squirrels will come for you.

name: Centerpiece
info: A colorful collection of leaves, candles, and wood. No fall celebration is complete without a stylish centerpiece to get in the way of people trying to enjoy their meal.

name: Maple Leaf
info: A lovely leaf, its color burnt by the changing seasons. It's a sign of hockey, Canadian patriotism, and, most importantly... pancake syrup!

name: Dragon Scales
info: Shimmering layers of reptilian armor fit for the mightiest of drakes. Surprisingly enough, they also make for a really nice wallpaper!

name: Koi Fish
info: Fishy tranquility! The majestic koi will instantly make any pond or fish tank at least 86% classier. Don't question it - it's science!

name: Leaves
info: Piles of fall leaves are good for exactly two things: Jumping into them, and who cares? I'm gonna jump in some leaves!

name: Celestial Kaleidoscope
info: Whirling mirrors of the finest crystal reveal a beautiful barrage of color and patterns. Just don't stare at them too long, or you'll start seeing psychedelic swirls everywhere! Ow, my eyes!

name: Harmonic Chimes
info: These chimes hum with crystal wisdom, bringing serenity to all who hear their gentle music. ...though they sometimes play heavy metal for no apparent reason.

name: Hay
info: Haaaaay! A big bale of harvest goodness, this is the perfect treat for a hungry horse. Just don't feed them too much. It makes them crazy.

name: Pinecone
info: The secret weapon of pine trees. Nothing says 'fall' like getting hit in the head with a big, pointy bundle of seeds! Ow!

name: Weather Machine - Autumn
info: Rev this baby up and enter a world of fall delights! Rustling leaves, setting suns, and a brisk chill in the air await you - just punch to activate! This sensitive technology will not function when damaged.

name: Tea
info: Steady your hands with a refreshing sip of herbal tea! Posh! Halves the chance of skill failure when performing surgeries! (Doesn't stack with other items that reduces skill failure chance)

name: Tea Set
info: Be careful! This upscale set of porcelain goodness is incredibly delicate. One wrong move, and you'll chip it and let all the tea ghosts out! Those are a thing, you know.

name: Scarecrow Mask
info: Act out your inner villain - or scare the bejeezus out of some birds - with this creepy harvest headgear. Who knew burlap and stitches could be so unsettling?

name: Rake
info: Tear up some topsoil with this handy home implement! Can anything really be better than punching, though?

name: Cloud Rabbit
info: Bunny bunny bunny cloud cloud cloud bunny cloud bunny cloud bunny bunny cloud cloud

name: Dryad
info: This pint-sized woodland sprite will defend the beauty of nature - and you - with all her adorable might! Just don't eat salads around  her - it's very insensitive.

name: Ancestral Lens of Riches : Level 6 Seed
Zen Garden
info: Create your own place of peace with this tranquil block. This has been carefully crafted with only the most soothing grains of sand, and trust me, it takes FOREVER to pick out the right ones.

name: Harvest Scarf
info: A whirling wisp of fabric to accent your perfect harvest style. Will also keep you warm with extra snuzzly fibers. Seriously, this thing is, like, TEN times snuzzlier than the next leading scarf.

name: Soul Stone
info: Unearthly life pulses within this strange stone! You think it might be a link to the great beyond... but what purpose could such ancient power have in the worlds of the living?

name: Plasma Globe
info: Beams of dancing light twist and twirl within this glassy orb, bringing out the mad scientist in everyone! Also makes your hair stand up, which is pretty cool.

name: Cloak of Falling Waters
info: Mystic whorls of water have been bound in shifting fabric to forge a cape fit for only the wettest, wildest Growtopians. Command one of the primeval elements through the Azure Gem of Waters pinned to this gorgeous cloak and use it to extinguish even the mightiest blazes. Or, y'know, spray people with it. It's your cape.

name: Demon Megalodon
info: Oh, what have you DONE?! This terrifying shark combines prehistoric predator power with the unholy corruption of Growganoth to create an unstoppable chomping machine! Class: DEMON-SIZED! See this shark in action in Hungry Shark World!

name: El Pollo Diablo
info: THE DEMON CHICKEN! A feathered fiend to scare and carry you to and fro! The best part? He'll absolutely peck you to death, just for fun! ...wait, that's bad.

name: Doom Plow
info: Are your crops not sufficiently terrified? Well, buckle up, because the power of Growganoth has overcharged the measely chicken plow into this fire-belching, flame-spewing monstrosity. Crazed chicken included. Do not operate while on prescription medication. Or for any other reason.

name: Killer Doctor's Smock
info: Calmly perform surgery in this horrific top. Your new and gruesome bedside manner will be an instant hit with those meat sack- uh, I mean, patients.

name: Killer Doctor's Cap
info: Terror is the new black! Nurse, pass me the scalpel!

name: Killer Doctor's Face Mask
info: Scare the bejeezus out of your patients with this deeply creepy surgeon's item. No unwanted surgery is complete without an evil mask to veil your villainous smile!

name: Killer Doctor's Pants
info: Hit the dance floor - or the nearest surgery suite - in these breezy, yet unsettling scrubs. Nothing says comfort like a two-legged memento of your latest surgery success (or failure)!

name: Demon Clown Mask
info: Hey, don't run away! IT really hurts my feelings when everyone flees my festive presence!

name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Pure White
info: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in woeful white!

name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Pure White Seed
Neon Voodoo Mask - Electric Blue
info: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in blazing blue!

name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Electric Blue Seed
Neon Voodoo Mask - Shocking Pink
info: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in petrifying pink!

name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Shocking Pink Seed
Neon Voodoo Mask - Plasma Green
info: Electric voodoo stylings to put the frighteners on your friends! Now in ghastly green!

name: Neon Voodoo Mask - Plasma Green Seed
Fish Monster Mask
info: Ew! This thing is frilly, wet, and slimy - most places won't want you around in it, except maybe those hipster fish restaurants. May I recommend the "Black Lagoon Risotto"?

name: Demented Cowl
info: Make friends with the shadows in this crazed - yet cool - cowl of darkness! Looming darkness may give those who wear this creepy cloth a pass...

name: Iron Maiden
info: Ouch! This thing packs some seriously spiky nails. However tempting it may be, do NOT go inside!

name: Looming Shadows
info: Uh, it's just a trick of the light, right? Nothing to worry about, right? RIGHT?! Oh man, you'd better move!

name: Hanging Bats
info: Dangling spooky bats on string. Don't worry, your fellow Growtopians will totally think they're the real deal. Keep those wigs covered!

name: Death Metal Radio
info: Head bang to the extreme - and maybe a bit of dizziness - with this deadly radio. Crank it up to 11 and thrash your way into any party!

name: Plastic Ghost
info: Oooo-OOO-ooooh! Who doesn't like glow-in-the-dark ghosts? Be the life of any spooky event with these spectacular specters!

name: Totally Harmless Doll
info: A completely ordinary, absolutely not-possessed, super-safe doll, perfect for children and other helpless creatures. Please don't be afraid. It's your friend. You should keep it close. Especially when you're asleep.

name: Headsman's Hood
info: Heading to a Halloween party and don't want your beautiful face to take attention away from everyone else? Hide it behind this creepy hood and sneak about in secret!

name: Doll Head Part
info: Hmm, looks like part of a doll! I bet you could make a complete one if you found the other pieces...

name: Doll Torso Part
info: Hmm, looks like part of a doll! I bet you could make a complete one if you found the other pieces...

name: Doll Legs Part
info: Hmm, looks like part of a doll! I bet you could make a complete one if you found the other pieces...

name: Pumpkin Candy
info: Pumped full of seasonal goodness! For a tasty snack, take fresh pumpkin seeds, roast in the oven in a single layer at 300F until dry (about 50 minutes), then take them out, toss with melted butter, sugar, cinnamon, and salt, and return to the oven at 350F until golden (about 12 more minutes). Growlicious!

name: Chi Harmonizer
info: A tuning fork for the fundamental forces of nature. This strange device will broaden the spectrum of chi requirements for any crystal recipes you craft... but only once! Groovy.

name: Harmonic Lock
info: Forged from the finest, most calming and balanced materials in all the worlds, this lock's peerless powers will influence ANY crystal recipes you craft. Using it to lock a world will broaden the spectrum of chi requirements for crystal balancing within! Radical!

name: Neon Gum
info: Take a piece and dazzle your friends as super funky neon lines course across your skin. Chew rapidly to get a Speed boost and surround yourself with glowing bubbles!

name: Neon Nerves
info: Check it out, chummer! Slap this colour-shifting circuitry under your skin and dazzle those dataslaves with wired speed! The only thing they'll catch is a trail of arctic light as you leave them in the dust!

name: Static Hair
info: A shocking style, for sure, but there might be more to it than that! Maybe you should check to see if it reacts with any other electrical sources...

name: Amethyst Choker
info: Clasp your neck in this flawlessly cut piece of jewelwork, and be the envy of all.

name: Opal Block
info: An enormous chunk of shimmering opal, resplendent in its square-shaped majesty. You could never build a house out of opal in the real world, which is just one more reason why Growtopia is so much cooler.

name: Kaleidoscopic Wallpaper
info: Build with these chunks of psychedelic sweetness, and their shimmering patterns will forever delight visitors to your worlds. I wonder if they'd hypnotize people, too - just look at those colors...

name: Demon Crystal
info: Vile energies ripple across the surface of this twisted relic. Ancient tales tell of a demon trapped within a profane crystal - could this be it? And if so, what of the other legends, those that speak of a crown of stars stolen by the fiend? Could this be its prison? Could there be a way to pry the crown from its clutches?

name: Celestial Lance
info: Everyone's heard of crafting swords from fallen stars, but this incredible weapon is forged from the CONSTELLATIONS themselves, radiating with the might of the heavens. Vile corruption and ancient darkness are no match for the glory of this device, for it can banish them utterly.

name: Celestial Halo
info: Ripped from the heavens, stolen by demons, and now bequeathed to you. This miraculous crown will make you as light as the aether itself - a fitting gift for one who would stand against the darkness.

name: Celestial Frame
info: Let the twinkling majesty of the heavens enclose your artwork! Comes with a blank canvas inside if you don't have any art. Note: If your art is made of background blocks, you'll need to apply Block Glue to it to make the frame surround it!

name: Celestial Dust
info: The dust of precious stones. This dust contains heavenly properties, perhaps it could be refined to form something of use.

name: Celestial Blade
info: This blade is enchanted with celesitial power! You could build an awesome weapon with one of these and a handle... well, it'd be awesome if you could hold it. Maybe you need something to protect your hands when holding it.

name: Turkey Onesie Hood
info: The crown of your turkey ensemble! Just don't lose your head over it! Gobble gobble gobble!

name: Turkey Onesie Body
info: No turkey is complete without a gobbly body, and this is the best you can find! Gobble gobble gobble!

name: Turkey Onesie Legs
info: Do the turkey trot with these gobble-tastic gams! Gobble gobble gobble!

name: Turkey Onesie Feet
info: Find your fall footing with these turkey toes! Gobble gobble gobble!

name: Turkey Carving Set
info: Reach out and get a handle on the holidays with a turkey touch! Gobble gobble gobble!

name: Turkey Onesie Tail
info: Look your Thanksgiving best with this wobbly tail! Gobble gobble gobble!

name: Turkey Onesie Beak
info: Peck your dinner to death - just like a real turkey! Gobble gobble gobble!

name: Thanksgiving Turkey Dinner - Bronze
info: You indulged in one of the year's mightiest meals and came away with this fine reward (and maybe a tummyache)! Show off this bronzed Thanksgiving turkey leg in recognition of your feat!

name: Thanksgiving Turkey Dinner - Silver
info: You indulged in one of the year's mightiest meals and came away with this fine reward (and maybe a tummyache)! Show off this silvered Thanksgiving turkey leg in recognition of your feat!

name: Thanksgiving Turkey Dinner - Gold

Gingerbread Block
info: The most delicious of blocks, spiced with ginger, cloves, nutmeg, a touch of honey, and a heaping helping of holiday goodness! Shame you can't eat it...

name: Gingerbread House
info: Growtopia is the only place it's acceptable to build a house out of gingerbread. It's far too delicious not to eat, otherwise!

name: Gingerbread Roof
info: Raise the roof! The gingerbread roof, that is. Will shelter you from syrup rain, candy hail, and sugar blizzards.

name: Gingerbread Door
info: The most welcoming doors are the ones made of gingerbread! Just be careful nobody eats it while you're distracted...

name: Holly
info: Get festive with this pretty - yet pointy - decoration!

name: Log Cabin
info: Live the life of a wilderness adventurer to the fullest with the help of this cozy cabin. Warning: Will not protect you from bears. Seriously, don't mess with those things.

name: Log Cabin Roof
info: Shelter yourself from the wilderness elements with this heavy roof of terrific timber. Stops: Wind, rain, snow, sleet, hail, lightning. Does Not Stop: Bears.

name: Log Cabin Door
info: If you're going to barricade yourself against the wilderness, it helps to have a way in and out. Fun fact: Bears never go through doors. Just... everything else.

name: Jack-in-the-Box
info: Hopping holiday fun, compacted with springs and a touch of seasonal joy to make every bounce the best yet! Also good for scaring small children and cats.

name: Twinkling Lights
info: Turn on these delightful lights and rejoice in their cozy twinkles. Just don't let them get tangled!

name: Small Icicles
info: As ice thaws, it drips down and refreezes to create these wonderful wintry spikes. I like to think of them as free, water-flavored popsicles.

name: Sheet Music: Winterfest
info: If you aren't in range of a Boombox, this will play a festive Winterfest-inspired sound for you. There are 14 different sounds, depending on how you place it vertically. Try them all!

name: White Chocolate Block
info: Also known as albino chocolate, white chocolate is just regular chocolate that's been left out in the sun too long.

name: Chocolate Swirl Block
info: Unlike the swirling vortex of Growganoth, this spiral is sweet, wholesome, and almost completely guaranteed not to devour your life force.

name: Chocolate Sprinkles Block
info: The sprinkles are the most important part of any dessert, even if it's a chocolate block. The key is to eat the chocolate first, so you can wear the sprinkle shell as a hat!

name: Chocolate Orange Block
info: Orange you glad you found this block?

name: Chocolate Cherry Block
info: Now the cherry on top of your sundae comes surrounded by chocolate! That's what I call win-win.

name: S'mores Block
info: Perfect for a cookout or a wintry cabin, there are few things better than toasting marshmallows, slapping them together with chocolate, and sandwiching the delicious mess between two graham crackers. Aw, now I've made myself hungry...

name: Cherry Jelly Block
info: A wibbly-wobbly block of cherry jelly.

name: Lime Jelly Block
info: A wibbly-wobbly block of lime jelly.

name: Blueberry Jelly Block
info: A wibbly-wobbly block of blueberry jelly.

name: Orange Jelly Block
info: A wibbly-wobbly block of orange jelly.

name: Lemon Jelly Block
info: A wibbly-wobbly block of lemon jelly.

name: A Row of Winterfest Socks
info: A perfect decoration for your fireplace, log cabin and gingerbread house. Even better if you can find someone to fill them with presents!

name: A Row of Winterfest Socks Seed
Snow Block
info: There's nothing like the soft crunch of freshly fallen snow as you clumsily plod your way through it.

name: Winterfest Dancefloor
info: Look at those lovely lights! Dance floors with colors beat dance floors with no colors every time, so let's get this party started!

name: Mistletoe
info: A bright and cheerful bundle of seasonal leaves, perfect for doorways and ceilings. Now's your chance to continue the charming tradition of kissing under it!

name: Winterfest Cracker
info: A bundle of festive goodies, best cracked open with a friend. What will you find inside?

name: Deluxe Winterfest Cracker
info: The finest and most upscale of crackers! Pop this lovely present open with a friend, and hope for something amazing!

name: Winterfest Red Paper Crown
info: Get in the spirit of Winterfest with this red paper crown, then wait for it to dissolve in your forehead sweat!

name: Winterfest Green Paper Crown
info: Get in the spirit of Winterfest with this green paper crown, then wait for it to dissolve in your forehead sweat!

name: Winterfest Silver Paper Crown
info: Get in the spirit of Winterfest with this silver paper crown, then wait for it to dissolve in your forehead sweat!

name: Winterfest Gold Paper Crown
info: Get in the spirit of Winterfest with this glowing, golden paper crown, then wait for it to dissolve in your forehead sweat!

name: Gingerbread Man
info: A deliciously dangerous Gingerbread Man. Watch out! He's full of anger - as well as sugar - and ready to defend you against all your holiday foes!

name: Gingerbread Dough
info: The spiced building block of something amazing. What could you create with this...?

name: Ice Skates of Winter
info: Glide across the ice like a pro in these dashing ice skates. No more sliding around like a jerk!

name: Snowshoes
info: Perfect for trekking through snow and doubles up as a nice pair of rackets, if you get the urge to play some tennis while you're out on the tundra.

name: Sleigh of Winter
info: Everyone will want a ride on this luxurious winter sleigh, especially with your trusty Reindeer leading the way! (We recommend charging competitive rates and hiring a marketing firm for any new sleigh-focused business models).

name: Winter Frost Bow
info: Tired of shooting boring old arrows from stupid normal bows? Well THIS holiday beast of a bow shoots freezing ice shards! How cool is that?!

name: Ice Serpent Scarf
info: You might think a frosty ice serpent wouldn't be useful in the cold, but think again! This elegant creature will wrap your neck in so much friendship, you'll stay toasty warm all winter. Um, just don't let it snuggle you TOO hard...

name: Lumberjack Coat - Scarlet
info: Everybody toss on this scarlet coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

name: Lumberjack Coat - Olive
info: Everybody toss on this olive coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

name: Lumberjack Coat - Navy
info: Everybody toss on this navy coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

name: Lumberjack Coat - Midnight
info: Everybody toss on this midnight coat and say: "I'm a lumberjack and I'm okay, I chop down trees and I work all day..."

name: Mountain Coat
info: Toss this on to keep warm and become one with the wilderness. Maybe try to befriend a bear while you're at it? No, that's crazy...

name: Mountain Cap
info: Whatever critter became this cap, I hope it was proud to know it would be forever immortalized as a sweet accessory for the top of your head.

name: Mountain Boots
info: Trudge through trackless forests and raging mountain rivers in these old-timey boots.

name: Parka Hood - Blue
info: Prevent your face from freezing off and avoid the embarrassing outcome of having icicles dangling from your nose with the help of this cozy blue parka hood.

name: Puffy Blue Jacket
info: If you ever saw a jacket and thought, "That's not NEARLY puffy enough for me," then this poofed-up piece of apparel will be perfect for you. Get it now to stay warm AND awesome all winter long!

name: Mr. Narwhal
info: The majestic narwhal, unicorn of the deep and expert poker of all things aquatic, is now yours for all your aquarium-enhancing needs!

name: Glass Piglet Squid
info: Pigs are magical creatures - they can fly, swim, turn invisible, become bacon, and now... they can be SQUID! That's what this thing is, right? A really weird pig? Hmm... maybe I should look it up...

name: Gingerbread Cookie
info: Not just ANY cookie, but a super-spiced, winterrific GINGERBREAD cookie! Go to town on this treat and it'll give you more than just a sugar rush! `2Food Buff:`` 10% chance of triple XP from all actions.

name: Gross Golden Holiday Sweater
info: Finally, the most luxuriously horrible holiday sweater you've been waiting for. Your super-wealthy, ultra-classy grandma would be proud.

name: Silverstar Bow
info: Forged from stardust, aether winds, and purest silver, this beautiful bow belongs amongst the heavens - you must have been incredibly fortunate to count it among your possessions. Well, that or you're just a really good trader. Either way, let's shoot some stuff!

name: Red Eye Drops
info: Need a new look? These drops will have you seeing red! Note: You may need multiple drops - and other colors - to achieve a desired effect. Eye drops also interact with your natural eye color, so some effects may be impossible to achieve.

name: Green Eye Drops
info: Need a new look? These drops give your eyes a green gleam! Note: You may need multiple drops - and other colors - to achieve a desired effect. Eye drops also interact with your natural eye color, so some effects may be impossible to achieve.

name: Blue Eye Drops
info: Need a new look? These drops will have you feeling anything but blue! Note: You may need multiple drops - and other colors - to achieve a desired effect. Eye drops also interact with your natural eye color, so some effects may be impossible to achieve.

name: Black Eye Drops
info: Need a new look? These drops will darken your eyes, but not your day! Note: You may need multiple drops - and other colors - to achieve a desired effect. Eye drops also interact with your natural eye color, so some effects may be impossible to achieve.

name: Eye Cleaning Solution
info: Fed up with your current eye color? This soothing and refreshing eye cleaner will leave your peepers sparkly clean - but you might need more than one bottle to finish the job!

name: Bathroom Mirror
info: Take a good look at your face! Try not to stare too long, though - no matter how beautiful you are.

name: Sun Yellow Dancefloor
info: Dance floors with color beat dance floors with no colors every time, so let's get this party started in sweet sunny yellow!

name: Hot Pink Dancefloor
info: Dance floors with color beat dance floors with no colors every time, so let's get this party started in eye-popping pink!

name: Bodacious Blue Dancefloor
info: Dance floors with color beat dance floors with no colors every time, so let's get this party started in bodacious blue!

name: Groovy Green Dancefloor
info: Dance floors with color beat dance floors with no colors every time, so let's get this party started in groovy green!

name: Raving Red Dancefloor
info: Dance floors with color beat dance floors with no colors every time, so let's get this party started in raving red!

name: Rayman's Fist
info: The perfect punch! Ever wanted to send a disembodied fist flying across the land like Rayman? Well, now you can! Land a blow like none other with this furious fist. It even comes with a friend: Globox!

name: Rayman's Hair
info: Halt your fall with this helicopter hair, courtesy of Rayman himself! How does it spin like that? And more importantly, how does it look so amazing?

name: Rayman's Hoodie
info: Stay warm and stylish with Rayman's personal hoodie. It even smells like him: waffles, vanilla, and determination!

name: Rayman's Shoes
info: Rayman's spectacular shoes are yours! These are a toe-tingling delight, with all kinds of padding and luxury features you'd expect from a platform-hopping pro like Rayman. Toss these on and enjoy comfortable - and stylish - foot-based movement from now on!

name: Rayman's Nose
info: Taking "Got your nose!" to a whole new level, aren't you? Somehow, some way, you've wound up with Rayman's nose! I hope he has a spare!

name: Equalizer Tee
info: Celebrate optimal sound balance and look great at the same time!

name: Ultra Equalizer Tee
info: This ultra version not only celebrates optimal sound balance, but it does it with mesmerizing movement! Ooh, the colors...

name: Rollback Plaque IV
info: You were there, man. You were THERE when time rolled backwards yet again, and all the fruits of your labors turned to dust in your dry, bitter fist. December 2017.

name: Flame Tee
info: Don't worry - no matter how realistic this t-shirt's flames may be, it won't light anything on fire! ...though you WILL look super hot!

name: Ultra Flame Tee
info: Don't let the flickering flames of this ultra version fool you - this shirt is NOT currently on fire! ...but your dance moves are!

name: Party Light Wave Vest
info: Be the light of the party with this bright and beautiful vest!

name: Ultra Party Light Wave Vest
info: Turn up the awesome with this ultra version - it'll really light up the night!

name: Ultra Party Light Wave Vest Seed
Party Style Top Hat
info: This isn't just a great party hat - it's the GREATEST party hat. Top the evening (and your noggin) with this finely-honed piece of wearable art!

name: Ultra Party Glow Top Hat
info: We've taken the greatest party hat known to science and given it an ultra upgrade. Okay, NOW this is clearly the best possible hat. How else could it be better?

name: Ultra Party Glow Top Hat Seed
Party Style Shades
info: Hypnotize your fellow Growtopians as they stare longingly into these dazzling shades!

name: Ultra Party Glow Shades
info: Take your party powers of shade-based hypnotism to the next level with this ultra version and never be friendless again!

name: Party Glow Sneakers
info: Light up the night - and the dance floor - by popping these hotly-glowing goodies over your toes!

name: Party Style Scarf
info: Wow, look at those colors! Ring your neck with the perfect party scarf.

name: Ultra Party Glow Scarf
info: Turn up the heat with this ultra version of the party scarf - just be careful the only thing you set on fire is the dance floor! Those bulbs get hot!

name: Megawatt Bass Speaker
info: Push partygoers around with the power of deep bass sound! The speaker focuses sound waves in the direction you place it, so pick its placement for maximum effect!

name: 5th Anniversary Block
info: Wow! FIVE YEARS! Celebrate this incredible anniversary achievement with this wonderfully wobbly (and gloriously golden) number 5!

name: Hand Drill
info: Bore through the surface of frozen blocks with this hand drill and get fishing! Be careful not to put too much strain on it, though - it may break!

name: Nuclear Detonator
info: Blast through the surface of irradiated blocks with this nuclear detonator and get fishing! It's a bit volatile though and may break!

name: Uranium Glowing Lure
info: Attract nuclear fish! Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait in nearby radioactive water to start fishing. The ghostly glowing light of uranium will catch unique fish that other bait can't entice!

name: Mega-Pellet Bait
info: Attract frosty fish! Equip a fishing rod and then use this bait in nearby ice water to start fishing. The icy shimmer of this bait will catch unique fish that other lures can't entice!

name: Training Port
info: This port is for adding or removing fish for Training! Use your wrench to manage the fish, just like real fish. You can only place this on a fish tank.

name: Fish Medicine
info: Make a sick Training Fish bright and healthy with this healing potion. One dose is enough to make even the sickest fish all better!

name: Fish Reviver
info: Resurrect a dead Training Fish with a revivifying zap! One shocking charge is enough to reach beyond the veil and bring a fish back from the dead! Comes with a 100% zombie-free guarantee!

name: Fish Flakes
info: Every fish adores these tasty flakes! Give a pinch to your Training Fish and fill their scaly bellies with aquatic goodness! Take the guesswork out of finnicky feedings with a treat you know they'll love!

name: Maidmare Fish
info: A terrifying creature forged by the awful effects of radiation! Don't stare too long or "she'll" get upset...

name: Maidmare
info: A terrifying creature forged by the awful effects of radiation! Your enemies will flee in terror from this creepy creature's mega fishy, slimetacular wet smooch attack!

name: Double-Headed Angel-Devil Fish
info: Good heavens! This is one heck of a fish. Embodying the best (and worst) of the cosmos, this split-faced aberration loves giving good and bad advice.

name: Riding Double-Headed Angel-Devil Fish
info: Good heavens! This is one heck of a riding fish. Embodying the best (and worst) of the cosmos, this split-faced aberration loves giving good and bad advice while carrying you to and fro.

name: Double-Headed Angel-Devil Fish Leash
info: Good heavens! This is one heck of a pet. Embodying the best (and worst) of the cosmos, this split-faced aberration loves giving good and bad advice while floating at your side.

name: Absolutely Real Elephant Fish
info: A genuine elephant fish that totally exists. Ha! Look at his silly nose! Just hide your peanuts while they're around - they're obsessed.

name: Absolutely Real Elephant Fish Leash
info: A genuine elephant fish pet that totally exists. Ha! Look at his silly nose! Will delight onlookers as it follows you around, dispensing wisdom and menacing peanut sellers.

name: Absolutely Real Elephant Fish Leash Seed
Cuttlefish
info: You may think this is a fish, but you'd be wrong! Cuttlefish are molluscs - but "Cuttlemollusc," doesn't quite roll off the tongue does it?

name: Riding Cuttlefish
info: Writhing tentacles clear the way as you ride into town on this slimy beast! All shall tremble before your mighty fish- err... mollusc!

name: Cuttlefish Leash
info: You may think this is a fish, but you'd be wrong! Cuttlefish are molluscs - but "Cuttlemollusc," doesn't quite roll off the tongue does it? Either way, it'll be happy to follow you around, no matter what you call it.

name: Riding Stonefish
info: Through careful training, one of the most poisonous fish in the world can now be ridden without fear! Careful, though - they're still quite pointy.

name: Stonefish Leash
info: This is one of the most poisonous fish in the world... and you have it following you around?! You're crazy!

name: Riding Sand Shark
info: Out of the sand and happy on land, this sand shark has decided to let you ride it around. Isn't that nice of him?

name: Sand Shark Leash
info: Out of the sand and happy on land, this sand shark has decided to follow you around like a toothy balloon. Isn't that nice of him?

name: Riding Seahorse
info: Neither fish nor horse, but after careful feeding, it's still a trusty steed! Ride this undersea mount into battle and become a Knight of the Seahorse! It's a very prestigious order, you know.

name: Seahorse Leash
info: This rare fish is very hard to keep in an aquarium. Lucky for you, this is a videogame, and it's happy to float beside you and impress everyone who sees it!

name: Battle Gar
info: The snappiest, toothiest, chompin'est fish is out of the tank - and out for blood! This battle gar will chow down on your foes and bring you victory! ...just don't get too close to those snappy jaws!

name: Battle Mutant Fish
info: Strange mutations can make for the meanest fish, as this battling mutant will prove! Good thing it's on your side - with that extra eye, it can always keep a lookout while it takes down your foes!

name: Alpha Great White Shark
info: The king predator of the sea. Full of teeth and bereft of mercy, this abyssal biter can shred unwary swimmers in seconds! Dum-dum, dumm-dum... dum, dum, dum, dum, dum, dum, dum, dum, dumm, dum - sh, sh, sh, SHAAARK! Aiiiieee!

name: Riding Alpha Great White Shark
info: How do you make the king predator of the sea even cooler? Toss a saddle on and ride them into the sunset, of course! Little-known fact: Great whites love Westerns, and secretly wish they could survive in the desert.

name: Riding Alpha Great White Shark Seed
Alpha Great White Shark Leash
info: The king predator of the sea will follow you around and watch your back. Take him on dates for an extra-romantic companion. Nobody can resist the owner of a deep sea terror, and this is one of the deepest, most terrifying things you can get!

name: Alpha Great White Shark Leash Seed
Weird Manta Ray
info: Once a peaceful vegetarian, this manta has emerged from the depths of toxic sludge with a hunger for other fish and a nasty sting!

name: Riding Weird Manta Ray
info: This voracious beast can now be ridden across the land, striking fear (and awe) into all who gaze upon it. Perfect for those who always wanted to ride a carpet with teeth.

name: Weird Manta Ray Leash
info: Flapping wings curl through the air at your side, but this is no pet bird - it's a really creepy manta ray! Happy to be freed from toxic sludge, it floats beside you as a loyal friend.

name: Goldfish Leash
info: These aren't made of gold, which is actually a good thing - otherwise they'd be too heavy to float beside you, looking all fishy and cool!

name: Catfish Leash
info: Hey! It's not a real cat at all! It doesn't even purr! Well, at least it's friendly enough to follow you around. Here kitty!

name: Sunfish Leash
info: If there's one fish that can brighten your day as it follows you around, this is it. Warning: Not a real sun.

name: Bass Leash
info: Don't slap the bass - you'd just hurt it, and all it wants is to follow you around.

name: Mahi Mahi Leash
info: The fish so nice they named it twice - now it will follow you around, and thrice as nice!

name: Dogfish Leash
info: This adorable Dogfish will follow you around like a little lost puppy. They're so obedient!

name: Whale Leash
info: This giant of the ocean is a mammal and extremely heavy - so how the heck does it float whilst following you around?

name: Picasso Triggerfish Leash
info: Also known as Hawaii's state fish, the Humuhumunukunukuapua'a, which is probably the best name ever. Regardless of what you call it, it'll still follow you around with majestic grace.

name: Ice Crust Block
info: Solid ice! Maybe you can use something to bore a hole inside it...?

name: Goldfish Bowler Hat
info: Who's to say you can't wear a goldfish on your head? Silly people, that's who. They just don't understand how great it is to rock a goldfish upstairs. Don't listen to them. They're not cool like you.

name: Catfish Slippers
info: The warmest, fluffiest fish-based slippers around, these are the cat's meow!

name: Dogfish Slippers
info: Arf! For times when your dogs are barkin', slide on a pair of these slippers and relax in fishy comfort.

name: Picasso Face
info: Someone's turned this triggerfish into a masterpiece for your face! Awesome!

name: Tentacle Beard
info: Arrrr, me hearties! Sail the seven seas with flailing tentacles on your face, and all will know your name and tremble before your rubbery glory.

name: Puffer Fish Block
info: Puffer Fish expand when scared, and here in Growtopia, they're always terrified for some reason. Watch out for those spikes!

name: Queen Conch Shell
info: Blow into this like a trumpet and enjoy the soothing tunes of the sea wherever you may be. Or set it on a shelf and discuss tall tales of the briny deep with your best mates. Ya harr!

name: Davy Jones' Chest
info: Store treasures of the deep (or your grandma's garage sale) within its barnacled interior by dropping them! When it's closed, the items are hidden! Punch it to open it!

name: Radiation Block
info: Don't worry, the deadly radiation is still safely stored inside this block - however, don't go prodding and poking it just in case!

name: Radiation Sign
info: Radical! Write stuff on it to tell your friends! Use your Wrench to change the message.

name: Fancy Fish Wall Mount
info: Proud of your catch, but you don't want the responsibility of caring for it? Place it on this fancy mount with your wrench! You can only display `9Perfect`` or `9Massive`` fish on this mount. Once a fish is mounted, it can never be removed.

name: Tiny Frozen Chunk
info: Oh no! The frigid waters froze your bait into a tiny chunk! Consume to get a Mega-Pellet Bait.

name: Small Frozen Chunk
info: Oh no! The frigid waters froze your bait into a small chunk! Consume to get a Mega-Pellet Bait.

name: Large Frozen Chunk
info: Oh no! The frigid waters froze your bait into a large chunk! Consume to get a Mega-Pellet Bait.

name: Tiny Radioactive Bit
info: Yikes! The radioactive waters blasted your bait into a tiny radioactive bit! With only trace amounts (honest) of radiation, consume to get a Uranium Glowing Lure.

name: Small Radioactive Bit
info: Yikes! The radioactive waters blasted your bait into a small radioactive bit! With only trace amounts (honest) of radiation, consume to get a Uranium Glowing Lure.

name: Large Radioactive Bit
info: Yikes! The radioactive waters blasted your bait into a large radioactive bit! With only trace amounts (honest) of radiation, consume to get a Uranium Glowing Lure.

name: MAGPLANT 5000
info: Tired of picking things up with your puny human hands only to put them down later? With the awesome power of MAGNETS, these woes will be a thing of the past! GrowTech proudly presents the MAGPLANT 5000, an all-in-one item-sucking and planting masterpiece. Simply target the machine to the seed or block of your choosing, and it will collect and store any that drop in your world! WARNING: Only collects items from breaking blocks and harvesting!

name: MAGPLANT 5000 Remote
info: Switch your patent-pending MAGPLANT 5000 to plant mode, and this handy remote will place any blocks or seeds it contains wherever you target! Wow! It's not a miracle - it's SCIENCE! (TM)

name: Cupid Leash
info: This cherubic companion brings romance wherever he goes! With feathery wings and a love-laced bow, he's an unstoppable source of sweetness.

name: Heart Shirt
info: Forget wearing your heart on your sleeve - put it right out there on your shirt so everyone can see how lovable you are!

name: Golden Heart Shirt
info: True heartthrobs don't just assume people will realize how amazing they are - they wear awesome animated shirts like this to show off their romantic might for them!

name: USMom's Talaria
info: Made to the exacting specifications of its angelic sponsor, these winged wonders will get you where you need to be in a blur of flapping finery! Sponsored by USMom.

name: Golden Talaria
info: For times when ordinary winged shoes won't do, pop these shining masterpieces on and show the world you're not just faster and flightier than the average footwearer - you're also fancier.

name: Heart Necklace
info: A heart that's incomplete is a symbol of want, of the need to belong, and that means this necklace is looking for a match. Find your valentine out there and be whole again!

name: Weather Machine - Valentine's
info: Love is in the air! Send hearts sailing through pink and fluffy skies with this adorable weather machine and everyone will know what a romantic you are! This sensitive technology will not function while damaged.

name: Teddy Bear Block
info: This is probably the only safe bear out there - and he's huggably wonderful! No need to worry about claws and doom with a plush companion like this. If only real bears were as friendly...

name: Love Birds
info: Chirp chirp! Learn the songs of love from these sweethearts. They're so happy together, they can't wait to share their joy with the world!

name: Love Curtain
info: A tender-hearted drapery to hide you and your sweetheart from prying eyes! Just make sure you know them well - otherwise you might end up getting in a less-than-affectionate fight!

name: Valentine's Dust
info: A sprinkle of romance, a touch of affection, and a dash of intimacy, all ground up into one passionate powder! What could it be for?

name: Valentine's Card
info: Show the world you care by using this card to send a gift of love to a fellow Growtopian! They'll surely appreciate the gesture, and who knows - perhaps your generosity will be rewarded!

name: Laser Grid
info: This is just a harmless frame with cool-looking lights on it, right? Huh. Now they're getting brighter. And hotter. Um... maybe you should move. No, faster than that! FASTER!

name: ShockBot - Level 1
info: Direct your ShockBot from this control platform, and send it sailing into the faces of the unwary! Ouch! That one hurts! This CyBot can take up to 5 commands.

name: SpikeBot - Level 1
info: Direct your SpikeBot from this control platform. If anyone so much as GRAZES its deadly surface, they'll be dead, dead, dead! This CyBot can take up to 5 commands.

name: Command - Move Left
info: Send your CyBots one square to the left with this command!

name: Command - Move Right
info: Send your CyBots one square to the right with this command!

name: Command - Move Up
info: Send your CyBots one square straight up with this command!

name: Command - Move Down
info: Send your CyBots one square straight down with this command!

name: Command - Pause
info: Make your CyBots stop for a moment with this command!

name: Command - Basic Shot Left
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 4 squares to the left with this command!

name: Command - Basic Shot Right
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 4 squares to the right with this command!

name: Command - Basic Shot Up
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 4 squares straight up with this command!

name: Command - Basic Shot Down
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 4 squares straight down with this command!

name: Command - Improved Shot Left
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 8 squares to the left with this command!

name: Command - Improved Shot Right
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 8 squares to the right with this command!

name: Command - Improved Shot Up
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 8 squares straight up with this command!

name: Command - Improved Shot Down
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 8 squares straight down with this command!

name: Command - Long Shot Left
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 12 squares to the left with this command!

name: Command - Long Shot Right
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 12 squares to the right with this command!

name: Command - Long Shot Up
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 12 squares straight up with this command!

name: Command - Long Shot Down
info: Make your CyBots (the ones that can shoot, that is) fire 12 squares straight down with this command!

name: Small Seed Pack
info: Contains `$5`` randomly chosen seeds, 4 `3Common`` seeds, and 1 `1Rare`` seed! Use it on yourself to open it - who knows what you'll get?!<CR><CR>*All valid seeds have an equal % chance.<CR>`3Common`` seeds between rarity 2 - 12.<CR>`1Rare`` seeds between rarity 13 - 21.

name: ShooterBot - Level 1
info: Line up the perfect shot for your ShooterBot with this control platform! One touch of its deadly laser cannon, and your foes will be history. This CyBot can take up to 5 commands.

name: FlameBot - Level 1
info: Your enemies will run in panic before the power of your FlameBot - hurts to touch, and hurts even more when it fires its Inferno Cannon! This CyBot can take up to 5 commands.

name: Will of the Wild
info: The powerful forces of the wild elements; fire, water and earth live in this ethereal hair - just don't mention the air element! The mage that tamed these wild forces could never control his wind, and he's already the butt of all jokes at mage parties!

name: Giant Pot O' Gold
info: Gleaming treasures await! Let's see if you have the luck o' the Irish - drop stuff in here, and wonderful items may emerge!

name: Weather Machine - St. Paddy's Day
info: Celebrate St. Patrick's Day in style with the most magical of all weather! You can only have one of these per world.

name: Weather Machine - St. Paddy's Day Seed
Drinks Hat
info: Celebrate alllll day - *hic* - long with this hands-free, extra-*hic*-strong drinking device. Urp. 'Scuse me.

name: Faerie Face Paint
info: Bring out your natural beauty and turn yourself into a true spirit of nature. You won't get magic powers from it, though - unless you count looking lovely as a power!

name: Irish Dance Dress
info: You might fling your shoes off when the spirit of the dance takes over, but at least you can be confident this dress will stay firmly on your body.

name: Lucky Clover Background
info: A lovely stylized image of a clover, the luck o' the Irish is with you!

name: Sheet Music: Flute Note
info: If you aren't in range of a Boombox, this will play a flute note for you. Put it in different places for different pitches.

name: Sheet Music: Sharp Flute
info: This plays a half-step higher note than Sheet Music: Flute Note.

name: Sheet Music: Flat Flute
info: This plays a half-step lower note than Sheet Music: Flute Note.

name: Harp
info: The heavenly sounds of the harp - who can resist the soothing pleasure of running their fingers across the strings?

name: Giant's Causeway Block
info: This remarkable block will create an area of interlocking basalt columns - legend has it they were created by a giant!

name: Rainbowfish Leash
info: Nobody knows where the name of this fish came from - it's quite mysterious - but what we DO know is that it'll fill your world with happiness and glee as it follows you around.

name: Rainbow Cape
info: A mesmerizing rainbow ripple cape. Dazzle your friends!

name: Magical Rainbow Fishing Rod
info: Equip this and then use bait on water next to you to go fishing! All you have to do is wait for a bite, and then punch the fish before it escapes! If you miss, your bait is wasted, so punch fast. You will suffer mischievous effects when catching fish with this rod! Only found in Blarney 6 and 8.

name: Paper Dividing Wall
info: Delicate, stylish paper makes for a fine traditional wall. Just don't lean on it too hard!

name: Decorative Paper Wall
info: This is made of delicate, stylish paper for a fine traditional wallpaper.

name: Chinese Arch
info: An arch of great cultural significance and history. Plus it looks nifty.

name: Coin Door
info: The gateway to prosperity! May it always be open to you.

name: Fortune Cookie
info: A tasty treat with a touch of wisdom. Crack one open for instant enlightenment (and prizes)!

name: Lucky Token
info: Legend says these will link your world to the realm of the ancients, where great gods of chance watch over us. Perhaps if you add this to your world, they will bless you with a small piece of their vast fortunes...

name: Draconic Wings
info: Shimmering scales of pure power coat these marvelous wings, marking them as the sign of the truly fortunate. These give you the power to double jump... and look amazing. Fortune has smiled on you for possessing this! There are only 1300 in existence!

name: Red Dragon Head
info: The head of the dragon! What else could you add to this, I wonder...?

name: Red Dragon Body
info: The body of the dragon! See how long you can make it!

name: Red Dragon Legs
info: The legs of the dragon! See how long you can make it!

name: Red Dragon Tail
info: The tail of the dragon! An end, perhaps... or is it a new beginning?

name: Lunar Spice Spray
info: Packed with rich spices and wholesome powers, this spray will speed up the growth of one tree from the Lunar New Year event by 24 hours!

name: Chinese Fireworks

name: Chinese Crackers
