name: Game Grave Egg
info: Use your wrench to set which team this block belongs to! During a Game, players of that team will respawn here.

name: Growmoji Bunny
info: Pop a bunny into your chat and get your hop on! Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: Bear Spirit
info: You are one with your spirit animal! The awesome guidance of the Bear Spirit has given you the gift of double jump! Which is something wild bears do. Don't look it up. Just trust us.

name: Rainbow Hair
info: Style your hair in shimmering rainbow light to amuse your friends and infuriate Leprechauns. Also works great for reading late at night.

name: Intergalactic Warrior Hair
info: YOUR HAIR IS NOW PURE POWER AND THAT POWER IS OVER NINE THOUSAAAAAAAAAAND! BELIEVE IN THIS HAIR, FOR THIS HAIR BELIEVES IN YOU!

name: Egg Rescue Ticket
info: Growtopia requires you, great adventurer, to save Easter and rescue the eggs from Bunny Barko. This ticket entitles the holder to one entry in the Great Growtopia Easter Egg Rescue project. Present this to claim your reward! Fabulous prizes await all who participate.

name: Dumb Leader
info: Not used, it's just an icon.

name: WOTD Trophy 2018
info: The best of all possible trophies in 2018.

name: GrowScan 9000
info: Bewildered by blocks? Mystified by machines? Well, struggle no more! The GrowScan 9000 is here to help! Wrench this incredible invention and you'll instantly learn about every last block in your world - Check stats, find items, and more with a flip of the wrench! Wow!

name: Whip of Truth
info: Whirling with wisdom and knowledge long forgotten, the Whip of Truth can pull secrets from the very air - AND those you whap with it! Under its gleaming golden might, no falsehoods can survive...

name: Ring Of Shrinking
info: Become your very own Mini-You! Fool your friends with this amazing optical illusion, now with complete lack of particle emitters! Once again, we reiterate that this is an illusion - Growtech accepts no responsibility for users getting stuck in tight spaces (or inability to use auras convincingly).

name: Sheet Music: Spanish Guitar Note
info: Magnifico! This sheet will play a spanish guitar note for you, as along as you aren't in range of a boombox. Put it in different places for different pitches!

name: Sheet Music: Spanish Guitar Note Seed
Sheet Music: Sharp Spanish Guitar
info: This sheet will play a spanish guitar note for you - a half-step higher note than Sheet Music: Spanish Guitar Note - as along as you aren't in range of a boombox. Put it in different places for different pitches!

name: Sheet Music: Sharp Spanish Guitar Seed
Sheet Music: Flat Spanish Guitar
info: This sheet will play a spanish guitar note for you - a half-step lower note than Sheet Music: Spanish Guitar Note - as along as you aren't in range of a boombox. Put it in different places for different pitches!

name: Sheet Music: Flat Spanish Guitar Seed
Axolotl Leash
info: Kudos to you! You've trained a fish that's actually a salamander! Now that he's worldly and wise, this mighty little Mexican salamander is all too happy to follow you around!

name: Riding Axolotl
info: After some intensive training, this cute little Mexican critter can now be ridden across the land - and he's stronger than he looks. Ride through town and give a jaunty wave to jealous passersby from atop this majestic steed!

name: Riding Fiesta Axolotl
info: What's this now? The cute little Mexican critter is wearing a sombrero? Well, things just got a whole lot more adorable, didn't they?

name: Feather Headdress
info: If you're the slightest bit ticklish, stay away from this flamboyant, feather-adorned headgear. If not, then wear it with grace and become The Tickle Master!

name: Fiesta Mariachi Guitar
info: Bring the party everywhere you go. When you /dance with this, you can perform for your friends!

name: Magnifico Carne Guacamole - Bueno
info: One great guacamole! Will have you saying, "I don't give a guac!" as you and your pet charge into battle! `2Food Buff``: 100 gems for every Pet Trainer defeated.

name: Magnifico Carne Guacamole - Sabroso
info: One grandly tasty guacamole! Will have you saying, "I don't give a guac!" as you and your pet charge into battle! `2Food Buff``: 150 gems for every Pet Trainer defeated.

name: Magnifico Carne Guacamole - Perfecto
info: One glamorously perfect guacamole! Will have you saying, "I don't give a guac!" as you and your pet charge into battle! `2Food Buff``: 200 gems for every Pet Trainer defeated.

name: Growmoji Cactus
info: Pop some spicey spikes into your chat with this cactus! Just consume to add it to your available Growmojis!

name: Pinata Lasso
info: Make the PiÃ±ata Bash more fun than ever by snaring the Ultra PiÃ±ata with this lasso! It'll seriously reduce the speed it travels for 15 seconds!

name: Bandolier
info: The favored garb of a legendary outlaw, this is the perfect gear for rustling cattle, robbing trains, and - surprisingly - afternoon tea. Who knew?

name: Dual Six-Shooters
info: Did you shoot 11 bullets... or 12? Trick question: These guns never run out! Sure, NONE of Growtopia's guns ever run out, but these come loaded with extra grit and vigor! Yahoo!

name: Dark Spirit Board
info: Able to commune with dark and devastating powers from beyond the veil, this board can rip answers from the other side in the hands of a talented medium! Requires 5 brave Growtopians to stand in a circle around the board in order to properly contact the Realms Beyond. `5Only the owner of a world can place this board for safety reasons.`` `4WARNING: Using this means meddling with incredibly strong powers that can damage - and maybe destroy - worlds! Be careful where you use it. Your bedroom may not be the best idea!``

name: Spirit Board
info: Tired of paying overpriced mediums and fortune tellers to chat up the dead? Don't throw your money away! Invest in a Spirit Board and start contacting ghosts on your own! It's like a seance in a box!

name: Spirit Guide
info: This little ghost will guide you on your travels, and he'll even reduce the chance of a Spirit Board breaking when summoning ghosts! Aww, isn't that nice of him?

name: Ghost-Be-Gone
info: A blast of ectoplasmic annihilation! Use this mighty mix to remove all ghosts from the world!

name: Dumpster
info: Pretty standard place to put all your trash, but that's about it. At least it's not on fire.

name: White Brick Wall
info: Combines a fairly boring color with a moderately boring building material to create... a somewhat boring wall. Huzzah.

name: Fuse Box
info: Your standard wall, now with electrical wires and junctions and stuff! Everything's cooler when you stick a fuse box on it.

name: Otherworldly Block
info: This thing isn't from around here. I've looked at a lot of blocks, but not many that looked back! Especially from another world...

name: Otherworldly Warning Light
info: Alert! Alert! This spiritually-attuned light will flash on if it detects otherworldly entities nearby! Use it to prepare yourself for an onslaught from the afterlife!

name: Boss Goo
info: Rare spectral ichor! You don't get this from just any ghost. I bet it could be turned into something useful... `6Warning: Is sure to overload any Spirit Storage Unit! Good news, though: The more ghosts you have in the SSU before you add this, the better your odds for something really good!

name: Mind-Ghost-In-A-Jar
info: Spooky! This jar contains a ghost - a mental one! You can throw it to break the jar and unleash the ghost, or instead drop it gently in front of a Spirit Storage Unit, where you can keep the ghost for good!

name: Ghost Trap
info: Snags spirits in a snap! Place this trap down and it'll suck in a ghost that's above it. The Ghost Trap generates an enhanced field that is larger than a ghost jar, but you'll probably still need some friends with Neutron Guns to keep the ghost contained or it will escape! A trap takes 2 seconds to activate, and then only collects spirits for 5 seconds, so time it carefully.

name: Containment Field Power Node
info: Power this node with little ghosts to activate. Put four active nodes near each other to create a containment field that can weaken a Boss Ghost! `5Note: The Boss Ghost can only be damaged while weakened inside the field!``

name: Neutron Power Glove
info: Summons deadly spectral energies to give you the awesome power to punch ghosts dead! Well, again. Actually, we're not sure where they go... but they're not happy about it!

name: White Brick Pillar
info: You'd think adding a pillar to a boring white wall made of boring white bricks would make it more exciting, but... turns out it's a boring pillar, too. Dang.

name: Neutron Focus Core
info: Insert this into your Neutron Pack to give it a little extra oomph. Will deal double damage for a short time before burning out, so use it wisely!

name: Foil Hat
info: Paranoid there's someone out there, inclined to meddle with your mind? Don this fancy little hat and fear no more! Its foily goodness will protect you from even the most powerful mind control!

name: Summer Event Player Medal: Gold
info: Awarded for achieving FIRST PLACE in the Player Leaderboards during the Summer season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Summer Event Player Medal: Gold Seed
EctoJuicer
info: Infuse your muscles with the unearthly might of the Other Side! This spectral potion gives you the strength to wring every last drop of ectoplasm from a defeated Boss Ghost, granting you an EXTRA Boss Goo after a successful banishing!

name: Bamboo Frame
info: Use a touch of the tropics to make your art pop! Comes with a blank canvas inside if you don't have any art. Note: if your art is made of background blocks, you'll need to apply Block Glue to it to make the frame surround it!

name: Pineapple Koa Lantern
info: Light up your next luau with this stylishly fiery lantern! Ow! So hot right now.

name: Pineapple Sign
info: Point the way to your next party (and a few other points besides) with this multi-directional sign. Where to, Growtopian?

name: Pineapple Tiki Door
info: You can't open the door to a tropical adventure if you don't, y'know, actually have a door. Try this one!

name: Pineapple Fish Leash
info: This sweet (and slightly sour) fish has flopped out of the tropical waters it calls home and onto a leash! Take him out for your next luau!

name: Pineapple Tiki Mask
info: Show off your pineapple spirit with this leering mask! Looks just as great on a shelf as it does on your face! Wait... was this actually a fish at one point?

name: Pineapple Spear
info: Now you're playing with pine-power! Wield the true might of the pineapple and blast blocks into oblivion with this delicious spear!

name: Pine-ch Buggy
info: Part car, part pineapple, all style. There might be a lot of cars on the road, but none can compare to the four-wheeled fury of the Pine-ch Buggy!

name: Pineapple Engine Part
info: A sweet-smelling piece of a larger whole, this engine part is infused with pineapple power!

name: Pineapple Wheel
info: Reinforced with pineapple rubble and filled with concentrated pineapple scent, this wheel will get you on the road - when you collect a few more, that is.

name: Pineapple Plating
info: Offering unmatched pine-tection to its passengers, there's no safer way to travel than in a pineapple-plated car. Get a few more pieces and build your masterpiece!

name: Super Pineapple Guardian Charm
info: Pining for protection? Make the power of the pineapple guardian personal with this amazing necklace! When activated, grants immunity to thrown consumables for 5 seconds (starts as soon as you get hit), followed by a 5-minute cooldown.

name: Growmoji Super Pineapple
info: Pop a Super Pineapple into your chat! Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: Dumb Question 1
info: Not used, it's just a dumb question.

name: Dumb Question 2
info: Not used, it's just another dumb question.

name: Dumb Question 3
info: Not used, it's yet another dumb question.

name: Summer Event Player Medal: Bronze
info: Awarded for achieving THIRD PLACE in the Player Leaderboards during the Summer season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Summer Event Player Medal: Bronze Seed
Summer Event Player Medal: Silver
info: Awarded for achieving SECOND PLACE in the Player Leaderboards during the Summer season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Summer Event Player Medal: Silver Seed
Summer Event Guild Medal: Bronze
info: Awarded for achieving THIRD PLACE in the Guild Leaderboards during the Summer season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Summer Event Guild Medal: Bronze Seed
Summer Event Guild Medal: Silver
info: Awarded for achieving SECOND PLACE in the Guild Leaderboards during the Summer season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Summer Event Guild Medal: Silver Seed
Summer Event Guild Medal: Gold
info: Awarded for achieving FIRST PLACE in the Guild Leaderboards during the Summer season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Summer Event Guild Medal: Gold Seed
Extract-O-Snap
info: Got a big pile of junk and don't want to waste time sorting through it? Have no fear: Extract-O-Snap is here! This handy hook will scan any stacks you target and then extract your desired item in a snap!

name: Extractor Dynamo
info: Building on the design of the Extract-O-Snap, the Extractor Dynamo will analyze stacks of items within range and extract anything you desire. Best of all, it can do this as many times as you like - it's a permanently awesome addition to your item-sorting setup!

name: Aurora Wings
info: Glowing with the majesty of the high heavens, these wings shift and shimmer with all the colors of a wild aurora. They also send out shimmering motes of light, which not only look amazing, but also make everything 200% more sparkly!

name: SearBot - Level 1
info: GrowTech's engineers were trying to invent a way to make multiple grilled cheese sandwiches at the same time, but ended up creating this terrifying CyBot of burning pain! Funny how often that happens. Can take up to 5 CyBot commands.

name: SearBot - Level 2
info: GrowTech's engineers were trying to invent a way to make multiple grilled cheese sandwiches at the same time, but ended up creating this terrifying CyBot of burning pain! Funny how often that happens. Can take up to 10 CyBot commands.

name: SearBot - Level 3
info: GrowTech's engineers were trying to invent a way to make multiple grilled cheese sandwiches at the same time, but ended up creating this terrifying CyBot of burning pain! Funny how often that happens. Can take up to 15 CyBot commands.

name: SearBot - Level 4
info: GrowTech's engineers were trying to invent a way to make multiple grilled cheese sandwiches at the same time, but ended up creating this terrifying CyBot of burning pain! Funny how often that happens. Can take up to 20 CyBot commands.

name: Deathtrap Wall
info: Ready to pulverize unsuspecting parkourists! Don't linger too long near these, or you'll be the subject of a very... pointed exchange!

name: Dimension Block
info: Now you see them, now you don't! These blocks like to phase in and out of our visual dimension, but don't worry - they're still there!

name: Royal Gilt Bathtub
info: If you're going to look your best, shouldn't you start with the place you clean up? All that glitters may not be gold, but this tub certainly is!

name: Royal Canopy Bed
info: The perfect place to drift to sleep after a hard day of watching knights joust, fools juggle, and peasants till crops.

name: Throne
info: Lord it over your lessers from this seat of power (lessers not included).

name: Banquet Dining Chair
info: Perfect for pulling up to a medieval banquet table laden with roasts and goblets!

name: Banquet Table
info: The perfect place for a feast (or a politically-charged argument with lords and ladies). Add more pieces for more guests!

name: Castle Chandelier
info: Shed a little light on your drafty keep with this bejeweled chandelier. Also handy for interrupting sword fights!

name: Iron Torch
info: A sconce of iron with a light of crackling fire, just like in olden times! Punch to turn on and off, just like in... uh... never?

name: Suit of Armor
info: Look, but don't touch! This spiky suit will shred the unwary with even the barest touch. Someone really ought to put a rope around it or something...

name: Bear Wall Mount
info: Rar! Show everyone what a fearsome hunter (or antique collector) you are with this trophy. Warning: May not impress anyone born after the 19th century.

name: Gibbet
info: Too many thieves and rapscallions stinking up your castle? Toss the riff-raff into this hanging cage and turn them into a cheerful decoration instead!

name: Castle Door
info: There's only one way into the best castles, and it isn't a Hidden Door or a Hospital Door or a Log Cabin Door or a Saloon Door or a- say, we've got a lot of doors in Growtopia, don't we?

name: Castle Stone
info: Don't build a castle out of just anything - use special Castle-brand (TM) stone for a catapult-resistant treat that's sure to impress visiting nobles and stinky peasants alike!

name: Castle Stone Background
info: All good castles need walls on multiple sides. Don't just put up some blocks on the front and call it a day - add these background blocks for a true castle experience!

name: Castle Turret
info: Top your castle with more than just flat stonework! These turrets are great for spying on your knights when they think they're on a break, too!

name: Castle Sewage Pipe
info: Castles are pretty disgusting places, and this is where all that grossness goes. It's really kinda awful, so try not to go for a swim. Or, like, put it near anything you don't want to smell terrible.

name: Tunic - Royal Red
info: Rocking the clothing world for thousands of years and still going strong, this tunic isn't just a medieval fashion statement: It's also red.

name: Tunic - Royal Blue
info: Rocking the clothing world for thousands of years and still going strong, this tunic isn't just a medieval fashion statement: It's also blue.

name: Tunic - Royal Green
info: Rocking the clothing world for thousands of years and still going strong, this tunic isn't just a medieval fashion statement: It's also green.

name: Guild Steed
info: A trusty steed for a trusted guildmate! Collect one for all your allies and have a parade! Or keep them all to yourself and taunt your friends. Either way, this horse is just happy to help.

name: Guild Night Stallion
info: A mighty steed for a mighty guild. This midnight mount has giant hooves and an even bigger attitude. Perfect for real leaders!

name: Summer Token
info: Access to the wonders of the Summer Season! Collect these to unlock its many rewards!

name: Overstuffed Vintage Leather Armchair
info: Now THIS is comfort. If the best chairs are fluffy and supportive, then this is like sitting in a cloud that's also a therapist.

name: Articulated Reading Lamp
info: Toss a light on your work (or a good book) and spend the night in illumination with this angled lamp. Now that's a bright idea!

name: Castle Moat
info: Keep out peasants and other undesirables with this gross moat! Nobody will want to take a dive in these waters!

name: Surgical Tool Bag
info: A bag of medical goodness! This bottomless sack somehow produces surgery tools, even if it's empty! We assume someone fills it when you're not watching, but who? And why?! It's on a timed lock, so it can only be opened once every five days.

name: Holographic Mannequin
info: Send your fashion shows to the future with the flickering fun of holograms! This mannequin will wear anything a normal mannequin can, and look super futuristic while it does!

name: Architect's Robes
info: Keep warm long into the night with these well-tailored robes. Perfect for workaholic architects who want to jot down just a few more diagrams before bedtime!

name: Architect's Compass
info: Keep your finest tools close at hand by putting them around your neck on a chain! Looks pretty blingin' too, which, as any architect will tell you, is a must-have for neckwear.

name: Architect's Beret
info: Cover up your wispy architect hair with this classy beret, ensuring the whole world will know you're cultured, and making it less likely for them to guess you're bald.

name: Architect's Beard
info: No master of diagrams and charts can be trusted unless they also have a big, highly-educated beard to back them up. Now THAT'S the face of an architect!

name: Architectural Diagrams
info: One of your finest projects! Pop these plans on the wall to let everyone know your angled achievement!

name: Anatomical Diagrams
info: You've studied the frameworks that support buildings, the heavens, and even the body itself - and you have the notes and drawings to prove it! Growtopians are brilliantly engineered, and these notes prove it!

name: Biological Diagram - Fauna
info: All your notes on animals would fill a library, but this piece is just too nice to stick in a book - so let's stick it on a wall, instead!

name: Botanical Diagram - Flora
info: All your notes on plants would fill a library, but this piece is just too nice to stick in a book - so let's stick it on a wall, instead!

name: Drafting Table
info: You can't create buildings and other beautiful things on just ANY table: You need a place with the perfect angle, and this drafting table is IT!

name: Loaded Bookshelf
info: These shelves are the best way to show everyone how much you've learned from (and how much you've spent on) books! Build them ever-higher and surround yourself with knowledge!

name: Anomalizing Reliable Hammer
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks, and guaranteed to never break!

name: Anomalizing Pristine Hammer
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

name: Exquisite Hammer
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected blocks!

name: Anomalizing Reliable Scythe
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected trees, and guaranteed to never break!

name: Anomalizing Pristine Scythe
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected trees! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

name: Exquisite Scythe
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected trees!

name: Anomalizing Reliable Bone Saw
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected patients, and guaranteed to never break!

name: Anomalizing Pristine Bone Saw
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected patients! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

name: Exquisite Bone Saw
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected patients!

name: Reliable Anomarod
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected fish, and guaranteed to never break!

name: Pristine Anomarod
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected fish! Note: The fragile anomaly-seeking circuitry in these devices is prone to failure and may break! Use with care!

name: Exquisite Anomarod
info: Built to exacting specifications by GrowTech engineers to find and remove temporal anomalies from infected fish! This exquisite rod will catch 10% bigger fish than normal.

name: Amulet of Force
info: The mystic Jewel of Might empowers this amulet, lending its supernatural strength to the wearer and giving them a little extra oomph when they want to break stuff!

name: Glove of the Giants
info: A big glove demands a big owner, but this glove takes it a step further - it'll MAKE you bigger! Slip the glove on and send the might of the giants coursing through your veins. You'll be towering over your friends and squashing your problems like bugs in no time!

name: Summer Blaster Shirt
info: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! This shirt doesn't just say you're cool - it also says you're hot! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Ultra Summer Blaster Shirt
info: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster style! This shirt doesn't just say you're ULTRA COOL - it also says you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another line of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Summer Blaster Pants
info: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! These pants don't just say you're cool - they also say you're hot! Try to find another line of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Ultra Summer Blaster Pants
info: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster style! These pants don't just say you're ULTRA COOL - they also say you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another line of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Growmoji Peace Sign
info: Calm your chat with a touch of peace! Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: Growmoji Terrified Face
info: Give your chat a jolt of terror! Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: Growmoji Trollface
info: Troll your chat as badly as you troll your friends! Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: Growmoji Evil Devil
info: Mock your chat with this fiendish face! Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: Weather Machine - Guild
info: Proud of your guild and its amazing mascot? Well, time to show it off in style! This machine will set your world of choice spinning with weather based on YOUR special mascot! Now that's guild power!

name: World Architect
info: Need help planning your next great creation? The World Architect will project a numbered grid over your entire world, scaling as you zoom in and out to let you pinpoint blocks and locations for tweaking!

name: Flaming Aura
info: Strap on this awesome item and prepare to receive an aura of brilliant fire energy! Also, double-jump power. We're not sure how that part works.

name: Storage Box Xtreme - Level 1
info: The scientific brains at GrowTech have created this ridiculously useful box to help you store large amounts of items! Unfortunately, those pesky untradeable items can't be placed here - those GrowTech geniuses were too busy celebrating after they made the first version! Note: Only World Lock owners can use this item.

name: Storage Box Xtreme - Level 2
info: The scientific brains at GrowTech have created this ridiculously useful box to help you store huge amounts of items! Unfortunately, those pesky untradeable items can't be placed here - those GrowTech geniuses were too busy celebrating after they made the first version! Note: Only World Lock owners can use this item.

name: Storage Box Xtreme - Level 3
info: The scientific brains at GrowTech have created this ridiculously useful box to help you store massive amounts of items! Unfortunately, those pesky untradeable items can't be placed here - those GrowTech geniuses were too busy celebrating after they made the first version! Note: Only World Lock owners can use this item.

name: Dumb Checkmark
info: Not used, it's just a dumb checkmark.

name: Raptor Legs
info: Everybody do the dinosaur! Pop on these prehistoric legs and leap into the fray with all the speed of an angry raptor! Just be careful, or you might go out the same way - with a fiery meteor!

name: Mirage Platform
info: Get an eyeful of anything that passes over this vision-shifting tile! Its enhanced optics will twist and warp any Growtopian who gets close!

name: Smoog the Great Dragon
info: Ancient flames and armored scales await your command! Smoog is a proud and fearsome beast, but he's decided to allow you - yes, YOU - to have the honor of being his rider! Who needs horses or cars when you can sit astride a mighty DRAGON?

name: Dancemaster's Crown
info: Let's boogie! Nobody can resist the awesome beat of the DANCEMASTER - and when you wear this gleaming helm, that's you! Use its funky power to get everybody's groove on and start a dance party at the drop of a hat! This hat, specifically.

name: Summer Blaster Glasses
info: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! These glasses don't just say you're cool - they also say you're hot! Try to find another kind of eyewear that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Ultra Summer Blaster Glasses
info: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster style! These glasses don't just say you're ULTRA COOL - they also say you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another kind of eyewear that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Bubble Machine
info: Bubble up! This machine will fill the air with bright and beautiful bubbles - perfect for a summer pool party, a sweet midnight rave, or a really classy pizza night.

name: Beach Ball
info: Inflated with extra summer fun! Bounce this onto the beach and relax in the sun and sand!

name: Watermelon Slice
info: Juicy and sweet, but definitely NOT seedless! Take a bite and get ready to blast the world with weaponized watermelon!

name: Phoenix Sword
info: Swirling flame and eternal glory are yours, for you possess the blade of emperors: The Phoenix Sword! Astonishingly rare, incredibly powerful, and explosively sharp, this weapon will proclaim its wielder as a force to be reckoned with! Wield it well, for you are worthy. There are only 500 of them in existence, in all of Growtopia!

name: Crushed Ice
info: Tasty! A summertime treat with a sweet kick and an icy crunch. Just don't eat it too fast!

name: Deep-Fried Tropical Ice Cream
info: Now you're thinking with fryers! The only thing better than an icy cool treat is an icy cool treat wrapped in fried batter!

name: Firefin Leash
info: This blazing fish is out of the water and at your side, happy to light your way with glowing gills and searing scales!

name: Flaming Floaties
info: Not a strong swimmer? Toss these fire-themed floaties on and keep your arms dry! At least they'll be okay! Not sure about the rest of you, though...

name: Growmoji Fireworks
info: Pop a burst of fireworks into your chat! Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!!

name: Deck Chair
info: Drop down and relax in the summertime with this playful deck chair! Now all you need is a deck!

name: Flying Disc
info: Whirls through the air with a simple toss. I bet you could play a really fun version of golf with this!

name: Crab Wall Mount
info: Proud of your catch, but you don't want the responsibility of caring for it? Mount it to this wall plaque with your wrench! You can only display `9Perfect`` or `9Massive`` crabs and lobsters on this mount. Once a crab or lobster is mounted, it can never be removed.

name: Embers
info: Crackling sparks of a greater flame. What could these create?

name: Flaming Feathers
info: Capable of cutting through wind and rain like a hot knife through butter. Imagine what you could make with these if you got enough together...

name: Danieldd's Chimera Wings
info: Forged from bladed feathers of flame and fury, these wings will let you tear through the skies with the might of the chimera! Sponsored by Danieldd!

name: Growpedia
info: A helpful tool to guide you on your way! Use this to see your quests - oh, and welcome to Growtopia!

name: Mighty Tiger
info: The terror of dark jungles and rustling fields has been tamed! This awesome beast comes to you from distant lands, willing to lend its primal might - and incredible stride - to your efforts! Rise up to the challenge of your rivals with your new feline friend!

name: Startopian Empire - Uniform Pants
info: Are you ready to travel the stars? To explore strange new worlds and fight for the glory of Startopia? Then you'll need to look the part! These pants are vacuum-pressed and ready for space - get the rest of your uniform together and enlist today!

name: Startopian Empire - Uniform Mini-Skirt
info: Are you ready to travel the stars? To explore strange new worlds and fight for the glory of Startopia? Then you'll need to look the part! This mini-skirt is expertly tailored and ready for space - get the rest of your uniform together and enlist today!

name: Startopian Empire - Command Class Uniform
info: Show everyone you're a ranked officer of Startopia! Those who bear the Command Class uniform have excellent leadership and political abilities. Wearing this also provides a slight boost to your ship rating for all Reputation-based skill checks!

name: Startopian Empire - Command Class Uniform Seed
Startopian Empire - Engineer Class Uniform
info: Show everyone you're a ranked officer of Startopia! Those who bear the Engineer Class uniform have excellent maintenance and systems abilities. Wearing this also provides a slight boost to your ship rating for all Ship Health-based skill checks!

name: Startopian Empire - Engineer Class Uniform Seed
Startopian Empire - Medic Class Uniform
info: Show everyone you're a ranked officer of Startopia! Those who bear the Medic Class uniform have excellent personnel and healing abilities. Wearing this also provides a slight boost to your ship rating for all Crew-based skill checks!

name: Startopian Empire - Medic Class Uniform Seed
Startopian Empire - Phase Blaster
info: Cut down vile Xenoid raiders, defend yourself against Greezak hunters, and make pirates shake in their stolen boots with a blast of hot plasma from a Startopian blaster! For the Empire! Made on Proxima Centauri II. All space rights reserved.

name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Helmet
info: This helm will keep your noggin safe from all kinds of extraterrestrial threats, like the brain-sucking mosquitorrasques of Vreebin VII! Show everyone you're a loyal soldier of Startopia with the official Mk.II Combat Troop outfit!

name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Helmet Seed
Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Body Armor
info: This body armor will keep your torso safe from all kinds of extraterrestrial threats, like the heart-stealing shadowfiends of Xarhoom IX! Show everyone you're a loyal soldier of Startopia with the official Mk.II Combat Troop outfit!

name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Body Armor Seed
Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Leg Armor
info: These plated pants will keep your legs safe from all kinds of extraterrestrial threats, like the bone-melting lava worms of Multak VIII! Show everyone you're a loyal soldier of Startopia with the official Mk.II Combat Troop outfit!

name: Startopian Empire - Combat Troop Mk.II Leg Armor Seed
Startopian Empire - Combat Rifle
info: This combat rifle will mow down alien hordes and toast a mean marshmallow, but only when fired in the name of the Emperor! All hail Startopia! Made on Gliese III. Firing upon giraffes will void warranty.

name: Greezak Horde - Warrior Helmet
info: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! This helmet is styled in the traditional manner of the Greezak, with plenty of breathing room and a pocket for snacks.

name: Greezak Horde - Warrior Armor
info: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! This armor has been retailored to fit your Growtopian body, as the Greezak have a few extra limbs. All the better to catch their prey, you see.

name: Greezak Horde - Warrior Leg Armor
info: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! These leg plates are aerodynamic and whisper-quiet, perfect for a hunting party (or a late-night snack run).

name: Greezak Horde - Warrior Leg Armor Seed
Greezak Horde - Skull Necklace
info: The fearsome warriors of the Greezak Horde welcome you to the hunt! This necklace of trophies was taken from a veteran Greezak, and chronicles the results of his many successful (and delicious) hunts.

name: Greezak Horde - Shoulder Cannon
info: Lock onto your prey and fire! This incredibly deadly shoulder cannon is designed to leave a Greezak warrior's hands free so he can fight and fire at the same time! The plasma bolts it shoots are low-energy, so they don't ruin animal pelts.

name: LordStar Environment Mask
info: The mask of a daring outlaw king! Raid ancient alien treasures and splash your name across the cosmos from behind this fantastic mask! All will (probably) remember you!

name: Space Thruster Boost Boots
info: Zip through space and hover like a champ with these high-tech boost boots! Thanks to a HyperTech dynamo core, these can keep you off the ground forever, meaning you'll never have dirty shoes again! Now THAT'S progress!

name: Alien Mind Protector
info: Alien in your brain! Alien in your brain! Thankfully, this is one of the few times that's actually a good thing, because you're fortunate enough to have a Mind Protector along for the ride! This clever controller will keep your gray matter safe from those who might try to mess with your thoughts!

name: MagTron LightCycle
info: Flaring with HyperTech superluminal banding and an everlasting reactor, this bike is unstoppably cool AND eco-friendly. It'll never run out of juice, and as long as you're riding it, you'll never be out of style.

name: Ferungi Ears
info: A race of a galactic merchants and business dealers, the Ferungi love to chat. That's why their ears are so huge - they never want to miss a conversation (or a potential trade secret)!

name: Volcanix Ears
info: Very pointy! And the pointier the ears, the wiser the Volcanix, as they say. The founding race of the Stellarix Union, the Volcanix are a deeply pragmatic and calculating people with long lifespans. These factors have led them to become distant, even detached from galactic affairs, which is why it's up to the Startopian Empire to keep the peace!

name: Startopian Empire - Force Shield & Phase Blaster
info: The most advanced personal combat gear ever designed for Startopian Special Forces, this blaster/shield combination uses re-engineered HyperTech repulsors to deflect attacks and keep their wielder safe even as they unleash blazing lances of plasma on their foes! When activated, grants immunity to thrown consumables for 5 seconds (starts as soon as you get hit), followed by a 30-minute cooldown.

name: Startopian Empire - Force Shield & Phase Blaster Seed
Robot Legs
info: Tired of using your boring human legs like a sucker? Well, fear not, because the advanced surgical teams of the Stellarix Union have crafted these incredible robot legs to take you to and fro without having to waste a single calorie! Powered by Stellithium X9 battery nodes and guaranteed to work for 2 billion steps or your buckazoids back, these legs will keep on walking long after you drop!

name: Starship Floor Tile
info: Welded durallium tiles to keep up with all manner of interstellar wear and tear. If you're going to be flying through a vacuum in a fragile metal box, you'd better have something solid underfoot.

name: Starship Wall
info: Keep out the horrors of space with these welded durallium walls. A must-have for the discerning starship captain.

name: Starship Door
info: When you have to enter a room on a spaceship, do you want it to be through lame door with HINGES, or whisper-smooth sliding metal panels? The choice is clear.

name: Starship Transporter
info: A new Checkpoint for a new future! Take a walk by this device to save your bio-signatures in its transporter buffer! If you die, you'll respawn at the last Checkpoint you touched!

name: Starship Console Panel
info: Make a few important adjustments to your starship systems with this easy-access console.

name: Starship Porthole
info: Enjoy staring into the endless void of space but don't want to go for a spacewalk to see it? Pop a porthole into your starship and enjoy the view instead!

name: Starship Airlock
info: A deadly dangerous vacuum lurks beyond the metal safety of your starship - so let's add a way to get to it quickly! This airlock is a one-way ticket into the void, so if it's open while you're nearby, watch your step!

name: Starship Deck Ladders
info: A quick and easy way to get to higher places on your starship! Note that these ladders are based off of the ancient GrowTech ladder technology, so you can still only go up, not down. But now you can do it in SPACE!

name: Looming Triffid
info: The Triffid is the second-deadliest creature on Parblaax XII, capable of devouring a Greezak warrior whole in mere seconds! Don't step beneath it, or you'll find out first-hand just how quick they are!

name: Xenoid Acid Pool
info: A seething pit of Xenoid poison, this caustic block will set anything that touches it ablaze, and is exactly the sort of thing that keeps the Xenoid from being invited to the nicer parties.

name: Greezak Hive Floor
info: Few Startopians have seen the inside of a Greezak Hive and lived, so whoever got you this floor block was either very brave or very lucky!

name: Greezak Hive Wall
info: Few Startopians have seen the inside of a Greezak Hive and lived, so whoever got you this wall block was either very brave or very lucky!

name: The Varlaak
info: A toothy maw of ever-hungering destruction, the Varlaak is only too happy to eat anything that comes close. Terribly dangerous, but also an easy way to dispose of kitchen scraps and unwanted guests!

name: Replicator
info: HyperTech engineering at its finest, the Replicator uses chronoburners to help you prepare your food, granting a small chance to get a temporal COPY of whatever you create! That's two dishes for the price of one! Wow! Thanks, HyperTech!

name: Star Tool Droid
info: A tireless forgebot, this droid works constantly, hoping to produce a useful Star Tool for its owner. Creating these advanced pieces of technology takes time, however, so you shouldn't expect a new tool any sooner than once every five days.

name: Star Fuel
info: While every starship uses Growtomic Energy to power its systems and engines, revving up its Emergency Warp requires something with a bit more kick! That's where Star Fuel comes in: Every time you escape a dangerous situation (or fail a mission), you'll use up Star Fuel to do it! Always make sure you have enough!

name: Buckazoid
info: The currency of the stars! This buckazoid is your reward for successfully completing a mission for the Startopian Empire. You can exchange buckazoids for rare interstellar prizes by calling Sales-Man on your Telephone at 53785! Double-tap this in your inventory to combine 100 of them into a Mega Buckazoid!

name: Imperial Starship Blast
info: Command your very own Starship and explore the cosmos! This blast contains one of 3 possible Imperial ship types - which will you get? Note: Each Starship comes with a full tank of gas, an Imperial Helm - Mk. I, Imperial Reactor - Mk. I and an Imperial Viewscreen - Mk. I, so you'll be all set for your adventure among the stars! Extra Note: A Starship also comes with an assortment of space-age blocks!

name: Starship Sickbay Bed

name: HyperTech Antigravity Field
info: Gravity got you down? Well, thanks to this salvaged HyperTech artifact, you can kick it to the curb and float in freedom! As long as you stay inside the antigrav field, you and the ground will be nothing more than distant acquaintances!

name: Summer Blaster Mohawk
info: Rock the season with the new Summer Blaster style! This mohawk doesn't just say you're cool - it also says you're hot! Try to find another kind of hairstyle that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Ultra Summer Blaster Mohawk
info: Rock the season in ULTRA Summer Blaster Style! This mohawk don't just say you're ULTRA COOL - it also says you're ULTRA HOT! Try to find another kind of hairstyle that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, i'll wait...

name: Squirrel King
info: All shall kneel before the nuttiest ruler of all: YOU! Wield the twitchy might of the squirrel empire with this wondrous tail. Acorns are your ammunition, the trees are your home, and the world is your kingdom. Go forth and chitter with pride!

name: Scepter of the Honor Guard

name: Scepter of the Honor Guard Seed
Cloak of Hoveration
info: Say hello to the friendliest threads around! This cape will take you to and fro with style, and happily yank you high into the air whenever you desire! It's like a very loyal blanket, but with a touch of magic to make your day extra lofty!

name: Red Contact Lens
info: Give your eyes an overhaul and get the red in with these pupil-painting lenses! You may need multiple lenses - and other colors - to achieve a desired effect.

name: Green Contact Lens

name: Blue Contact Lens

name: Black Contact Lens

name: Contact Lens Cleaning Solution

name: Rara Skirt
info: You'll be a "rara" beauty when you don this skirt! Who can resist those colors?

name: Gravity Well
info: When GrowTech accidentally spawned a swarm of miniature black holes, shareholders were worried the damage to spacetime might hurt business. Fortunately, their engineers were able to harness the power of the singularity to create these irresistible blocks! Punch to turn it on and feel the pull of the void!

name: Little Red Hoodie
info: My, what fine fashion you have! This hoodie will keep you warm and, more importantly, looking great in all kinds of weather!

name: Big Bad Blue Hoodie
info: Time to huff, puff, and blue your hood down! This hoodie will keep you warm and, more importantly, looking great in all kinds of weather!

name: Punk Purple Hoodie
info: Break out of the routine and set your own style (as long as it's purple)! This hoodie will keep you warm and, more importantly, looking great in all kinds of weather!

name: Dabstep Low Top Sneakers
info: Light up every footfall and move to a better beat with these dabulous shoes! When you're wearing these, the world is your dance floor!

name: Horns of Infinity
info: Ripped from the endless gulf between the stars, these twisted horns still carry a touch of hyperspace! They'll accelerate you into the great beyond, but just remember - when you stare into the void... the void stares back!

name: Rhinestone Evening Dress
info: All eyes will be on you when you stride into the ballroom in this vintage dress! It sparkles and shines like a constellation, setting you among the stars!

name: Plaid Skirt
info: Perfectly plaid for the budding lady lumberjack in you!

name: Peplum Top
info: A cute color for an even cuter Growtopian!

name: Stripy Jumpsuit
info: They say stripes are slimming, but nobody ever mentioned how good they look on you!

name: French Maid's Dress
info: Ooh la la! Grab your feather duster and put on your best French accent, because this dress is made to impress! Oui, mademoiselle!

name: Twintail Hair
info: When one tail o' hair just won't do, try doubling up with these twins! Your locks never looked so good!

name: Braided Hair
info: As bright, fresh, and braided as a fine pastry, this hair doesn't just look stylish - it also looks DELICIOUS.

name: Growmoji Face Mask
info: When you're tired of using all those crazy facial muscles, this mask is here to help! Hide your tired human face with this reliable, totally-not-creepy one instead!

name: Pet Rock
info: Brought to you by popular demand, meet the most playful, incredibly popular, and astonishingly amazing friend for all Growtopians... A ROCK! All sales final.

name: Mega Growtoken
info: Now you're talking! This is worth 100 growtokens! Double-tap this in your inventory to break it back down into 100 growtokens. Spend them in the store on special items! Try dialing 12345 or 53785 on your Telephone for details!

name: Bubble Gun
info: Pop! Pop! Bring a boatload of bubbles to any occasion with this poppin' fresh firearm!

name: Oink-Oink Nose
info: Got a nose for food? Or is it truffles? Either way, for those who need to show the world their piggy powers, this nose knows best!

name: Sheet Music: Violin Note
info: Maestro! This sheet will play a violin note for you, as along as you aren't in range of a boombox. Put it in different places for different pitches!

name: Sheet Music: Sharp Violin
info: This sheet will play a violin note for you - a half-step higher note than Sheet Music: Violin Note - as along as you aren't in range of a boombox. Put it in different places for different pitches!

name: Sheet Music: Flat Violin
info: This sheet will play a violin note for you - a half-step lower note than Sheet Music: Violin Note - as along as you aren't in range of a boombox. Put it in different places for different pitches!

name: Bubblicious Hair
info: Dying for that fresh-out-of-the-bubble-bath look? Well, die no more! Top your melon with these bodacious bubbles and LIVE! Whoever snagged this hairdo had to be quick so the bubbles wouldn't pop and super-chilly so they'd stay in place, all to bring it to you!

name: Fire Punk Hair
info: Are you fed up with the status quo? Want to burn the system and start anew? Then start with your hair! This sizzling style will show you're not just a thorn in the system - you're making anarchy look GOOD. Whoever snagged this hairdo had to be quick so the flames wouldn't go out and super-hot so they'd stay bright, all to bring it to you!

name: Nightwings
info: Wrap yourself in harrowing darkness and take to the skies! These wings are spun from midnight shadows, harvested from those with a touch of the starry void in their souls - dare you wear them?

name: Crystal Shard Necklace
info: Shimmering crystals and gems to adorn only the fanciest of necks! Strangely magnetic, these crystals must amplify the personal pull of those who wear them! Careful, though - these shards are sharp!

name: Growmoji Party

name: 3-Day Free Subscription Token

name: 14-Day Free Subscription Token
info: Consume this for fourteen full days of special treatment! You'll get a chance of doubling any XP earned, 10 season tokens (as long as there's a seasonal clash running), and 100 gems every day!

name: 30-Day Premium Subscription Token
info: Consume this for thirty full days of special treatment! You'll get 70 season tokens (as long as there's a seasonal clash running), and 4000 gems every day and a chance of doubling any XP earned, growtime reduction on all seeds planted and Exclusive Skins!

name: 365-Day Premium Subscription Token

name: Raw Gauntlet of Elements
info: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. While each stone is very powerful individually, combining their might in this gauntlet will grant the wearer the ability to manipulate the very building blocks of reality! Be warned, however, for adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier I
info: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth Stone and can move any block with Earth Chi. This is only the beginning, though - there are more stones to be found! Be warned, however, for adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier I Seed
Gauntlet of Elements - Tier II
info: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth and Wind Stones and can move any block with Earth or Wind Chi. This is only the beginning, though - there are more stones to be found! Be warned, however, for adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier II Seed
Gauntlet of Elements - Tier III
info: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth, Wind, and Fire Stones and can move any block with Earth, Wind, or Fire Chi. Now we're getting somewhere! More stones await, however, and don't forget: Adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier III Seed
Gauntlet of Elements - Tier IV
info: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth, Wind, Fire, and Death Stones and can move any block with Earth, Wind, or Fire Chi. It also now seals its bearer's fate, snatching them away from the mortal plane upon their demise! Now we're getting somewhere! More stones await, however, and don't forget: Adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier IV Seed
Gauntlet of Elements - Tier V
info: This incredibly strong gauntlet was designed for a single purpose: To hold the six Elemental Stones. It currently holds the Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, and Death Stones and can now move nearly any block! It also now seals its bearer's fate, snatching them away from the mortal plane upon their demise! It's nearly complete now! Only a single stone awaits, and don't forget: Adding a stone to this gauntlet requires the sacrifice of a soul in similar form. Doing so will bind the Elemental Stone to the guantlet and focus its power!

name: Gauntlet of Elements - Tier V Seed
Exquisite Gauntlet of Elements
info: Behold: The completed Gauntlet of Elements! Empowered by the might of the Earth, Wind, Fire, Water, Life, and Death Stones, it allows its wielder to move nearly any block, seals their fate upon their demise, and with the Life Stone, brings them back through a resurrection rift! A truly awe-inspiring relic, this must have taken tremendous effort to create. Any who possess it are mighty, indeed. All hail!

If you think knitting with thread is hard, just try doing it with moonbeams and magic! The result is worth it though, as these clothes won't just make you look amazing - you'll be able to channel their inherent power into blasts of cosmic energy!
