Luckily, it has to obey the holder of its remote - and that's you! Just don't, like, lose that thing. We've had to put down about eighty drone uprisings already...

name: Winter Freezer Cuddly Fox Scarf
info: Celebrate the season with a foxy new addition to the Winter Freezer style! This super-cuddly scarf doesn't just keep you warm - it also makes you cool! Try to find another adorable animal that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...!

name: Winter Freezer Cuddly Fox Scarf Seed
Ultra Winter Freezer Cuddly Fox Scarf
info: Celebrate the season with an ULTRA-FOXY new addition to the Winter Freezer style! This super-cuddly scarf doesn't just keep you ULTRA WARM - it also makes you ULTRA COOL! Try to find another adorable animal that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...!

name: Ultra Winter Freezer Cuddly Fox Scarf Seed
Doppelganger Projector
info: Ever wished there were more of you in the world? Well, take a step onto this shimmering platform, and your wish will be granted! Advanced Mimic Engine scanners in this block will project copies of anyone who stands on top of them! Try it out and you'll really start seeing double!

name: Robotic MK.IV Wings
info: After a great deal of experimentation and only, like, ten major accidents, GrowTech's engineers have worked out all the kinks and produced these fantastically fancy, almost certainly safe wings! Just... don't ask about Wings MK.I-III. They had... problems.

name: Sprite's Robe
info: Don this beautiful robe to summon the power of a playful sprite! Every jump will transform you into a Sprite for a time and take you bounding above the world!

name: Sonic Buster Sword
info: Smash the limits with this intensely powerful weapon! Oversized might for oversized heroics, this weapon swirls with spirit energy - a devastating weapon in the right hands, and a gorgeous conversation piece in just about any!

name: Treasure Blast
info: Enter a world of snow-capped peaks and long-forgotten mysteries! Riddles and secrets - and a ton of treasure - await those who brave this blast's blocks! Remember, when you use this, it'll create a new world by typing in a new name! No sense in searching for clues to great treasures in well-trod worlds, is there?

name: Map Fragment
info: A piece of a larger mystery! This fragment can't tell you much on its own, but if you manage to patch enough together, well, just imagine the treasures they might reveal...

name: Treasure Map
info: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They get a little easier to see when you're moving faster, though...

name: Treasure Map
info: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They're hard to make out in the light of day, though...

name: Treasure Map
info: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The paper seems incredibly dry, though...

name: Treasure Map
info: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The paper seems quite damp, though...

name: Treasure Map
info: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The language isn't like anything you've heard of on Earth, though...

name: Treasure Map
info: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! The runes have a dangerous sheen of gold, though...

name: Map of Tyr
info: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

name: Map of Odin
info: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

name: Map of Thor
info: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

name: Map of Frigg
info: This map's letters are hard to see in the light of day, and even those you CAN make out seem to change from moment to moment...

name: Legendary Map - Untouched
info: Ooh! This is one heck of a map! Looks like there's a lot of scrambled text and hidden messages here - you'd need a powerful algorithm to make sense of it all...

name: Legendary Map - Scanned
info: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They seem to change from moment to moment, and never in a form you can decipher!

name: Legendary Map - Magnified
info: This map is covered in strange designs and shifting letters! They seem to change from moment to moment, and never in a form you can decipher!

name: Legendary Map - Deciphered
info: The runes of the frozen cliffs match certain ones all over your map! When you put them together, a final message becomes clear, but the letters seem strangely faded to you, as if your eyes just aren't quite evolved - or mutated - enough to make them out...

name: Frozen Stone Cliffs
info: Clasp these crags with crooked hands, and you'll have the perfect blocks to build a home in lonely lands...

name: Glacier Background
info: Brr! This background seems to radiate an unearthly chill. It's like standing near the heart of winter...

name: Rune Stone
info: Etched with ancient knowledge! Could this be code for a mystic spell? A lost technology? Or... hmm... a growcery list?

name: Altar
info: What strange ceremonies took place here? More importantly, what strange ceremonies will YOU perform here?

name: Hidden Treasure
info: Glittering secrets! But be careful! Don't tell anyone about it! If you do, it won't be hidden anymore - it'll just be regular treasure, and who wants that?

name: Rune Carved Stone Pillar
info: Holds up the ceiling and looks wonderfully ancient! What do you suppose those runes say?

name: Long Boat
info: Drive yourself to new lands - and battle treacherous waters - with this hand-hewn craft!

name: Round Shield
info: Circles are the superior defense setup! This baby deflects 7.8% more blows than all other shield shapes! Invest now!

name: Frigg's Belt
info: Spun from the finest gold and made with craftsmanship of such surpassing grace, the Aesir themselves will applaud its bearer. Good thing that's you, eh?

name: Meat
info: A big honkin' hunk of deliciousness! Take a bite and you'll find yourself infused with gigantic meaty might! Time to feast!

name: Battle Boar
info: Supercharged with porcine fury, its terrible oinks will be the last thing your foes ever hear!

name: Golden Battle Boar
info: Gleaming in the light of war, this gorgeous boar is the most beautiful - and deadly - of its kind!

name: Weather Machine - Frozen Cliffs
info: Take your world to new heights with this breathtaking backing of icy mountains and perilous canyons! Whirling lands of snow await - just punch to activate! Oh, and remember, this is delicate machinery we're dealing with here, and it won't function when damaged.

name: Tyr's Spear
info: Justice and duty resonate in the heart of this godly weapon, propelling it far beyond its wielder's reach and into the very heart of evil!

name: Huginn and Muninn - Odin's Ravens
info: Thought and Memory, perfectly perched on each shoulder to whisper the world's secrets into your ears! Just make sure to feed them, or they might take a chunk out of you in return!

name: Huginn and Muninn - Odin's Ravens Seed
Mjolnir
info: The hammer of the gods! Wreathed in myth and forged with a core of living lightning, this legendary artifact was once lost in the gulf between the stars! Will you succeed on its former owner's cosmic quest? Are you... worthy?

name: Eir's Healing Rune
info: Infused with the medical might of Eir, a healing goddess, this rune will grant swift recovery and aid to any who hold it! Also grants minty fresh breath, which is an especially nice benefit when you consider the standard Viking diet.

name: Thor's Chariot
info: Looks like Thor misplaced his wheels! Fortunately, his feisty goats, Tanngrisnir and Tanngnjostr, have taken a liking to you and decided to forgo the standard BITE BITE BITE greeting they tend to use on new owners. Let's ride!

name: Growmoji Cake
info: Celebrate the party by baking some delicious cake for your chat! Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: The Amazing Hexagon - 6th Anniversary Block
info: Six sides for six incredible years! How cool is this hexagon? Almost as cool as you, for being a part of a game that's grown and thrived like none other!

name: The Amazing Hexagon - 6th Anniversary Block Seed
Super Party Launcher
info: Those other ravers laughed at you. They thought you didn't have the moves to dance with them. They thought your game was weak and your accessories were weaker. Well, joke's on them, because now you're ready to party the night away with the ultimate in confetti domination! Who's laughing NOW, foolish ravers?! Kinda hard to make fun of someone when you've got paper confetti and maybe a Mach 5 firework in your face, isn't it??

name: Black Party Table
info: For the classiest of shindigs. Fine china not included.

name: Party Punch Bowl
info: A great place to gather drinks for the whole crew... or one uber-mega thirst-quencher for yourself!

name: Balloon Decoration
info: The most whimsical of interior design choices.

name: Air Horn
info: Little-known fact: All Growtopia air horns are actually the sound of a very angry camel screaming.

name: Floating Speakers
info: These aren't for pool parties - they're for you! Hit the air on waves of sound with these thumpin' good boomboxes!

name: Golden Party-In-A-Box
info: Sparkling with luxury and gold-plated fun! You can just barely hear amped-up techno music coming from deep inside this box. Maybe you should open it and see if a truly righteous party comes out?

name: Goat Leash
info: The leash to one of two very famous goats! Let's see... this particularly bitey boy is either named "Teeth-Barer" or "Teeth Grinder". I'm not sure how to find out which without getting bitten, however, so your guess is as good as mine!

name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Crimson
info: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is red, for the Crimson Court!

name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Purple
info: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is purple, for the Noble Bastion!

name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Silver
info: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is silver, for the Silver Spire!

name: Dragon Warrior's Shield - Diamond
info: An unyielding defense against claws, fangs, spiky tails, and the blazing breath of even the mightiest drakes! Comes in a variety of colors, all related to ancient customs and knightly orders! Looks like this one is diamond, for the rarest of all: The Radiant Souls!

name: Growmoji Heart with Arrow
info: Pin down your lover's heart with an arrow in your chat! Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: Chinese Temple Pillar
info: Might not be a pillar of heaven, but these will still do a great job of holding up the foundations of a temple tall enough to reach it!

name: Chinese Prayer Wheel
info: Painted with lovely colors to please the heavens! Give them a spin for a little extra luck!

name: Chinese Temple Background
info: Richly-carved and decorated wood, perfect for enclosing a heavenly space!

name: Chinese Temple Awning
info: These loops and swirls of painted wood have a whimsical flair that's a perfect fit for overlooking any place of peace!

name: Incense Urn
info: Wisps of aromatic smoke spill from this heavy urn, filling the air with calming scents!

name: Draconic Rocket Parasol
info: To the heavens! In honor of the original creators of fireworks, this parasol has been loaded up with a dragon's worth! Use them to blast your way into the heavens, and then float gently down to Earth when you're done! There are only 1200 in existence!

name: Growmoji Lucky Token
info: Celebrate the New Year by popping a little luck into your chat! Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: Year of the Pig Lucky Token
info: Legend says these will link your world to the realm of the ancients, where great gods of chance watch over us. Perhaps if you add this to your world, they will bless you with a small piece of their vast fortunes...

name: Year of the Pig Lucky Token Seed
Dragon Glass
info: Forged in pools of molten rock by the unfathomable heat of a dragon's fire, this glass is touched by the mystic qualities of their creators!

name: Toasted Village Wall
info: This endured the worst heat of a passing firedrake - it's a miracle it's still standing!

name: Toasted Village Background
info: Covered in ash and soot, this wall is more carbon than wood!

name: Toasted Village Door
info: Warped by a firedrake's flames, it's hard to believe this door even opens now!

name: Toasted Village Roof
info: The villagers who took shelter under this roof when a firedrake attacked are lucky it didn't burn all the way through! Things certainly got a little singed, though!

name: Toasted Village Window
info: The perfect place to look out on devastated crops - and keep an eye out for a returning dragon!

name: Toasted Village Fence
info: This blasted fence won't be corralling too many animals now - it looks like a stiff breeze could knock it over!

name: Toasted Villager Shirt
info: Toasty! This top took a quick blast of flame from a dragon, and it shows!

name: Toasted Villager Hat
info: Toasty! Whoever wore this was pretty unlucky when a dragon came to town, though better this hat than its bearer's head, I suppose...

name: Toasted Villager Pants
info: Toasty! It's unclear whether these pants were present during a dragon's attack, or their owner simply told a TON of lies...

name: Toasted Villager Shoes
info: Toasty! Talk about a hotfoot! For a very brief run, these must've felt like the worst case of athelete's foot in history!

name: Toasted Face Smudges
info: Toasty! Just gotten blitzed by a firedrake with nothing to show for it? Not true! These toasty smudges are proof that you've faced the flame... and survived!

name: Dragon Knight's Helm
info: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! This helm is but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your noggin safe! Also doubles as a really cool motorcycle helmet.

name: Dragon Knight's Chestplate
info: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! This chestplate is but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your body safe! And hey, it's got great resale value - even if a dragon burns you out of it, this armor will still be left behind for the next intrepid knight!

name: Dragon Knight's Greaves
info: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! These greaves are but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your legs safe! Trust me, when you're dealing with dragons, preserving your ability to run away is critical.

name: Dragon Knight's Sabatons
info: Forged in a master blacksmith's furnace and stamped with runes of protection, a Dragon Knight's suit of armor is their last and best line of defense against the horrid flames and claws of their scaly foes! These shoes are but one link of many in that chain of defense, a perfect way to keep your feet safe! Keep these in mind the next time you want to try walking on coals at a luau, too - I mean, who would do that in bare feet??

name: Legendary Dragon Knight's Wings
info: Bestowed upon only the bravest, most prestigious, most skilled Dragon Knights, these wings are so rare that in all the centuries since the first Dragon Knights arose, barely a handful have been awarded. Will you be the next to bear their illustrious might? To take to the skies and soar like the very dragons you hunt? If you possess these wings, there's little question you've proven your worth - and dedication.

name: Dragon Knight's Spear
info: Capable of subduing the mightiest drake! Of course, you need to actually GET the pointy tip of the spear TO the drake, but that's where all the Dragon Knight armor comes in handy!

name: Dragon Throne
info: Fit for a dragon king! Well, not an ACTUAL dragon - they're much too large - but for a ruler who's really into dragon theming, it's perfect!

name: Dragon Mirror
info: Reflects your draconic side! The great serpent of fate accents this polished glass - the perfect accessory for a creepy old fortune-teller's shop, or perhaps a Dragon Knight's trophy room!

name: Dragon Lamp
info: The only safe way to light up a room with a dragon (all other ways seem to involve fire - lots and lots and lots and lots of fire)!

name: Dragon Turtle
info: A snapping beast of the crushing deep! It's said that the oldest dragon turtles can grow so large, whole islands can grow on their backs!

name: Dragon Turtle Charm
info: A snapping beast of the crushing deep! It's said that the oldest dragon turtles can grow so large, whole islands can grow on their backs! Fortunately, this one's still small and feisty, and seems happy to follow you on your adventures!

name: Super-Dragon Mask
info: Look! Up in the sky! It's a bird! It's a plane! It's... SUPER DRA- AIIEEE! RUN! THERE'S FIRE EVERYWHERE!

name: Ghost Dragon Charm
info: A dragon pulled from the Other Side! Top Dragonologists have been debating whether this creature is actually the ghost of a single dragon or a conjoined ectoplasmic hive composed of many smaller ghosts working together, but all of them can agree that it keeps eating anyone who asks about it, so it's best not to worry.

name: Gourmet Dragon Claw
info: A dragon who appreciates the finer things in life - as long as you can eat them.

name: Emergency Dragon Claw
info: Not all dragons are here to stomp and burn! Sure, this dragon still causes emergencies, but it also helps to patch people up afterward!

name: Jormungandr
info: A spiraling serpent of the fathomless deep, this colossal beast once circled all of Midgard with coils the size of warships! Now it's taking a break from causing maelstroms to join you in your adventures!

name: Prehistoric Dragon Claw
info: A dragon from a bygone time, what it lacks in modern refinements it more than makes up for in ancient biting power and unintelligible grunts!

name: Star Dragon Claw
info: A living constellation, this beautiful dragon was born in the heart of a brilliant nebula. It's come down to your world to explore, and it's very happy to have you as its guide!

name: Chaos Dragon
info: Don't look at it. Don't think about it. Don't. Even. Move. This... THING isn't a dragon. I don't know what it is - only that it's deadly dangerous and forged from the void itself. Beware, dear Growtopian, because I think it's noticed you...

name: Stone Egg
info: Unyielding, solid stone, and yet... you think you can hear the faintest pulse of a heartbeat from within!

name: Hatching Stone Egg
info: It's... it's hatching! There's something inside this egg, and it's coming out soon! Ooh, what could it be??

name: Ghost Egg
info: A dragon egg, touched by the essence of the Other Side!

name: Hatching Ghost Egg
info: It's... it's hatching! There's something inside this egg, and it's coming out soon! Ooh, what could it be??

name: Water Egg
info: A dragon egg, touched by the spirit of the stormy seas!

name: Hatching Water Egg
info: It's... it's hatching! There's something inside this egg, and it's coming out soon! Ooh, what could it be??

name: Void Egg
info: A dragon egg, touched by the blackness from between the stars!

name: Hatching Void Egg
info: It's... it's hatching! There's something inside this egg, and it's coming out soon! Ooh, what could it be??

name: Dragon Soul
info: The mystic strength of the smallest of dragons is too much for even the afterlife to handle! This bit of spirited flotsam has been left behind to flit mindlessly through our world. Perhaps you could give it purpose...?

name: Mentorship Certificate
info: Help your friends (and kind newbies) discover the worlds and wonders of Growtopia! This certificate allows its bearer to access the Mentor System, add new apprentices, and get rewards for their accomplishments! Note that while an apprentice can only have one mentor, a mentor can have many apprentices!

name: Apprentice Ticket - Level 1
info: A sign of your progress as an apprentice! Keep going for bigger and better rewards!

name: Apprentice Ticket - Level 5
info: A sign of your progress as an apprentice! Keep going for bigger and better rewards!

name: Apprentice Ticket - Level 10
info: A sign of your progress as an apprentice! Keep going for bigger and better rewards!

name: Apprentice Ticket - Level 20
info: A sign of your progress as an apprentice! Keep going for bigger and better rewards!

name: Apprentice Ticket - Level 30
info: A sign of your progress as an apprentice! Incredible work! This is the highest ticket you can get (so far)!

name: Mentor Ticket - Level 1
info: One of your apprentices has progressed nicely, and here's the proof! Keep helping them out for bigger and better rewards!

name: Mentor Ticket - Level 5
info: One of your apprentices has progressed nicely, and here's the proof! Keep helping them out for bigger and better rewards!

name: Mentor Ticket - Level 10
info: One of your apprentices has progressed nicely, and here's the proof! Keep helping them out for bigger and better rewards!

name: Mentor Ticket - Level 20
info: One of your apprentices has progressed nicely, and here's the proof! Keep helping them out for bigger and better rewards!

name: Mentor Ticket - Level 30
info: One of your apprentices has progressed nicely, and here's the proof! Wow, they've reached the maximum possible ticket level (so far)! This calls for a celebration for both of you!

name: Heartcastle Stone
info: Mortared with love and affection, these stones aren't just a monument to nobility - they're also the building blocks of romance!

name: Heartcastle Stone Background
info: These stones practically radiate adoration! As much as they love you, you'll love the way they look even more!

name: Heartcastle Gate
info: While the ways to a Growtopian's heart are nearly as varied as the things they can accomplish, this portal is just about as clear and direct as you can get! Romance lies beyond!

name: Heartcastle Turret
info: Stamped with hearts and forged with everlasting care, these turrets will form the top of the loveliest castle yet!

name: Heartcastle Column
info: Emotional support is often harder to come by than physical, but this column tries to accomplish both! It'll lift your spirits even as it lifts your buildings!

name: Heartking's Crown
info: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Heart! This crown is part of the King's personal wardrobe, and his warmth and affection for his subjects practically spill from it!

name: Heartking's Robes
info: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Hearts! These robes are part of the King's personal wardrobe, and his warmth and affection for his subjects practically spill from them!

name: Heartqueen's Crown
info: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Hearts! This crown is part of the Queen's personal wardrobe, and her delight and care for her subjects practically explode from it!

name: Heartqueen's Robes
info: Love rules, and who better to embody that than the grandest nobility in all the Heartlands: the King and Queen of Hearts! These robes are part of the Queen's personal wardrobe, and her delight and care for her subjects practically explode from them!

name: Heartstaff
info: Taken from the personal armory of the King and Queen of Heart, this staff is capable of batting away all but the saddest thoughts and mending even the most melancholy of hearts!

name: Golden Heartstaff
info: Infused with the golden light of romance, this heartstaff has been enhanced beyond its already-impressive start as a weapon of the heart to become a shining example of the power of love! Careful, though - for love can sometimes hit far harder than any edge!

name: Heartsword
info: Taken from the personal armory of the King and Queen of Heart, this sword is capable of slicing through all but the saddest thoughts and bringing joy to even the most melancholy of hearts!

name: Golden Heartsword
info: Infused with the golden light of romance, this heartsword has been enhanced beyond its already-impressive start as a weapon of the heart to become a shining example of the power of love! Careful, though - for love can sometimes cut far deeper than any blade!

name: Stained Glass Heartwings
info: Shining, radiant, wondrous. These wings aren't powered by magic or science or anything so mundane - they're infused with purest love, capable of uplifting all who wear them into the skies! Touch the heavens and smile, for by wearing these beauties, you have proclaimed yourself a true champions of the heart!

name: Morty the Gray Elephant
info: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's fashionable gray ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

name: Morty the Orange Elephant
info: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's fashionable orange ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

name: Morty the Pink Elephant
info: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's fashionable pink ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

name: Morty the Diamond Elephant
info: Have you ever forgotten how amazing you look? How cool your style is? Well an elephant NEVER forgets, so take a tour in Morty's incredibly rare and glorious diamond ears and remember your awesomeness for all time! Wait - what's that? Your friends don't think it's all that great? Well, maybe a HAIL OF PEANUTS will make them reconsider! GET 'EM, MORTY!

name: Spring Token
info: Access to the wonders of the Spring Season! Collect these to unlock its many rewards!

name: Manor House Sandstone
info: Carefully shaped by a legion of butlers for maximum snootitude, these sandstones are the building blocks of elegance, grace, and really fancy manors.

name: Manor House Sandstone Background
info: What's behind those wealthy walls? Wealthy backgrounds, of course.

name: Manor House Door
info: A door this fancy surely opens onto a realm of opulence and grace! Or, like, a volcano. Hey, it's your door - you can put it wherever you want, really.

name: Manor House Sandstone Steps
info: Steps to greatness. Carefully crafted to be impossible to climb for those lacking the requisite degree of nobility!

name: Manor House Red Striped Wallpaper
info: For only the fanciest of manors (the red stripes are actually finely-crushed rubies)!

name: Manor House Red Striped Wallpaper Seed
Gilt Inlaid Ceiling
info: Have you been using cheap, boring ceiling blocks? Well, the Court of Style finds you GILTY! The sentence: You must use these slick new inlaid tiles, instead!

name: Baroque Iron Fence
info: Keeps the riffraff out, but lets them look inside at all the cool things they're missing!

name: Baroque Iron Gate
info: The only problem with this gate is the constant repair bills, but you know what they say: If it ain't baroque, don't fix it!

name: Candle Wall Sconce
info: Practically guaranteed to reveal a hidden passage! If only you knew which way to turn it...

name: Luxurious Wall Clock
info: Taking the phrase "Time is money" quite literally, this clock makes time-telling a work of art!

name: Topiary Hedge
info: Almost certainly not going to come to life and attack you. Probably. Okay, it's like 50-50 at this point, but for a hedge this good-looking, it's worth the risk!

name: Statue Pillar
info: Holds up stuff and looks good doing it - now that's efficient!

name: Sandstone Fireplace
info: Intended for manor houses with dark secrets, this fireplace is perfect for staring into smoldering ashes and brooding.

name: Garden Trellis Tunnel
info: When you're rich, you shouldn't have to choose between tunnels or gardens, and with this block, you can finally have both!

name: Hibiscus
info: A lovely flower for any occasion - it even makes for a nice tea!

name: Lavender
info: Famously purple flowers, lavender not only looks beautiful just about anywhere, but it has a calming effect as well!

name: Garden Planter
info: Stop leaving your poor plants in the dirty ground! Use this planter to keep them nice and secure, instead!

name: Armillary Sundial
info: Shows your place in the heavens and tells the time! Studies show that the more cool-looking devices you have, the smarter and more successful you are, so you should probably load up on these.

name: Baroque Fountain
info: Finally, something to make water useful! Imagine this fountain sparkling in your manor's gardens on a hot summer day... Just don't dive in - it'd be gauche!

name: Greenhouse
info: Keep the chill of winter away from your plants and have a blooming garden all year 'round!

name: Garden Bird House
info: Miss the cheerful tweeting of birds amidst your many manicured hedges? This lovely birdhouse will bring them back, and chirpier than ever!

name: Garden Bench
info: Why build a beautiful garden if you're not going to take the time to enjoy it? Set this bench in the middle of all that loveliness and unwind!

name: Garden Shears
info: Keep those unruly hedges in check with a dainty snip-snip from these shears!

name: Country Tweed Waistcoat & Tie
info: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes. With this fine waistcoat/tie combo, you'll be the last word in rural nobility!

name: Country Tweed Open Jacket
info: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes. This jacket will make you seem anything but closed - after all, a friend in tweed is a friend indeed!

name: Country Tweed Trousers
info: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! These trousers are perfect for a stroll through your gardens or perhaps a vigorous game of croquet!

name: Country Tweed Flat Cap
info: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! This cap will keep the sun out of your eyes as you walk your manor's grounds and make you look extra-jaunty as you tip it to your neighbors!

name: Country Tweed Jacket & Yellow Tie
info: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! The touch of yellow in this jacket/tie combo would go marvelously with a spring festival - perhaps in your new manor's gardens?

name: Country Tweed Jacket & Yellow Tie Seed
Country Riding Breeches
info: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! These bonzer breeches will keep you on horseback long after lesser riders have gone home! Try on a pair today - there's nothing wrong with being comfortable AND fashionable, after all.

name: Country Riding Hat
info: Cor! Part of a smashing new line of country-inspired clothes! This fine hat doesn't make you a better rider, but it DOES make you a more dashing one, and honestly, isn't that what riding animals is all about?

name: Guild Show Horse
info: Bred and groomed for competition, this flawless horse will have the judges saying anything but 'neigh'!

name: Guild Noble's Carriage
info: Sure, carriages like this look amazing on the outside, but what their owners won't tell you is that the interior is tricked out with a full surround sound system, flatscreen TVs, the latest gaming consoles, and a well-organized selection of candy!

name: Eagle Spirit
info: You are one with your spirit animal! The awesome guidance of the Eagle Spirit has given you the gift of double jump! Now go forth and clasp some crags with crooked hands!

name: War Hammers of Darkness
info: Seething with dark powers and intended for even darker designs, these weapons are for only the most tortured, brooding souls. You'd better have a tragic backstory all lined up before you even THINK of touching one!

name: Condor Wings
info: Condors are some of the largest flying birds in the world, which makes these wings fit for only the biggest and baddest Growtopians! Will you take on the condor's mantle and soar, or are you more of a... chicken?

name: Airplane Wings
info: Zoom! You don't need a silly engine, propeller, or any of that other mechanical garbage - not when you have THESE wings! Take to the skies just like the airplanes of old! Note: You may need to drink one or two liters of oil per day to keep them properly flappy.

name: Sturdy Crackfire Fighter
info: Pkow! Pkow! Stake your claim on the skies and do battle with old-fashioned flair in this crackfire fighter! Just make sure you're home in time for tea and toast!

name: Cardboard Sky Starter
info: You don't need a roaring engine or a blazing gun to claim the skies - just a bit of cardboard and a strong imagination! This Sky Starter will get you going, but it's up to you to make it soar!

name: Aviator Scarf
info: There's no point in flying around heroically if you don't have a flappy scarf to keep yourself warm! Nobody trusts a shivering hero, after all.

name: Aviator Jacket
info: Keeps you warm as you dance with the clouds and comes with all kinds of cool patches to show off your many marvelous accomplishments!

name: Aviator Glasses
info: Carefully sculpted to shine with a heroic glint as you pilot your battered-but-victorious plane home from battle!

name: Aviator Fighter Pilot Hat
info: No self-respecting hero of the skies would go out without a dashing hat! Keep your perfectly-slicked hair and brilliant brain warm in even the chilliest clouds with this!

name: Air Force Flight Suit
info: Time to show everyone you've got the right stuff! Commandeer the fastest jets and set the most dangerous records in this super-sleek flight suit!

name: Growmoji Shamrock
info: Want to add some shamrock shenanigans in your chat? Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: Spring Flinger Frog Mask
info: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! This mask doesn't just give you the face of a swift and hoppy frog - it also gives you a new style that stays fresh on water AND land! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Ultra Spring Flinger Frog Mask
info: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! This mask doesn't just give you the face of an ULTRA swift and hoppy frog - it also gives you a new style that stays ULTRA fresh on water AND land! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Ultra Spring Flinger Frog Mask Seed
Paintball Power Popper
info: Got tons of paint on your hands but feeling tired of walking ALL THE WAY over to a wall, or friend, or inanimate object to cover them in it? Well, whine no more! This high-powered paintball popper will plaster your pals in premium paint without pause (phew)!

name: Flaming Boxing Gloves
info: These gloves aren't aflame with basic fire - they're alight with the burning heart of BATTLE! Furious ringside magic has been embedded in these gloves, wrapping them in an eternal halo of blazing punch-power! And no, they are very definitely NOT regulation...

name: Up, Up, and Away Block
info: Look! Up in the sky! It's a bird! It's a plane! It's... it's... you?

name: Up, Up, and Away Block Seed
Spring Flinger Frog Suit
info: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! This suit doesn't just turn you into a swift and hoppy frog - it also turns you into an amphibiously cool one! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Ultra Spring Flinger Frog Suit
info: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! This suit doesn't just turn you into an ULTRA swift and hoppy frog - it also gives you a new style that stays ULTRA fresh on water AND land! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Ultra Spring Flinger Frog Suit Seed
Forged Iron Skin
info: A gift of the gods, shaped by magic and fused by cosmic heat, this skin makes for the perfect armor. You'll never tire, never fall, never take one step back! ...though you may have to deal with a spot of rust now and then.

name: Ionic Pulse Cannon Tank
info: The titanium treads, super-heavy armor, and GrowTech hyperfusion reactor alone would make this the most expensive tank in history, and that's before you add an Ionic Pulse Devastator 7777 turret on top! Truly a tank for the most powerful nations - or richest collectors - in all the realms!

name: Slippery Flag Pole
info: Skip the stairs and get to the ground floor in a flash with this super-slippery pole! A quick trick of firemen everywhere, now yours to use for more than just emergencies!

name: Spring Chest
info: SPRING CHEST, ICON ONLY! NO DESCRIPTION NECESSARY! IF YOU'RE READING THIS, THE POLICE HAVE BEEN NOTIFIED AND YOU'RE IN TROUBLE.

name: Burnished Sword
info: Shining with the help of GrowTech's extra-strength Sword Wax ("Wax on, slice off!"), this burnished blade is ready to chop your foes! Chosen by GusBhas, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for July, 2019!

name: GrowCon Plaque
info: If you close your eyes near this block, you can almost feel the warmth of camaraderie and good cheer from many fellow con-goers! A beautiful plaque for a beautiful person, this was specially made for those who attended a live GrowCon event!

name: Spring Event Player Medal: Bronze
info: Awarded for achieving THIRD PLACE in the Player Leaderboards during the Spring season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Spring Event Player Medal: Bronze Seed
Spring Event Player Medal: Silver
info: Awarded for achieving SECOND PLACE in the Player Leaderboards during the Spring season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Spring Event Player Medal: Silver Seed
Spring Event Player Medal: Gold
info: Awarded for achieving FIRST PLACE in the Player Leaderboards during the Spring season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Spring Event Player Medal: Gold Seed
Spring Event Guild Medal: Bronze
info: Awarded for achieving THIRD PLACE in the Guild Leaderboards during the Spring season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Spring Event Guild Medal: Bronze Seed
Spring Event Guild Medal: Silver
info: Awarded for achieving SECOND PLACE in the Guild Leaderboards during the Spring season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Spring Event Guild Medal: Silver Seed
Spring Event Guild Medal: Gold
info: Awarded for achieving FIRST PLACE in the Guild Leaderboards during the Spring season. Show off your victory by placing this medal in your world, and congratulations!

name: Spring Event Guild Medal: Gold Seed
Kairos' Apollo
info: In loving memory of Apollo. Kairos' loyal, loving companion. A special creature that will always be by her side and in her heart.

name: Celtic Cross
info: Great for marking interesting landmarks as you walk the highlands.

name: Minilith Stone
info: It might take a lot of miniliths, but pile them all together, and you can have your very own MEGALITH in your back yard!

name: Faerie Lanterns
info: Light the garden path with these magical faerie lights. Just between you and me, it's probably just bio-luminescent fungi at work, but... let's go with magic!

name: Heather Bush
info: A lucky highland bush, perfect for decorating pathways, gardens, or avant-garde hairstyles.

name: Lucky Chair
info: About as lucky as basic wooden chairs can get!

name: Moss-Covered Stone
info: While this stone may not be rollin', it sure has the moss laying heavy.

name: Money Tree
info: So apparently money DOES grow on trees. Only problem with this money is that it's actually pretty worthless around here...

name: Four-Leaf Clover Checkpoint
info: A hundred times luckier than a normal checkpoint! Unfortunately, normal checkpoints have zero natural luck, so mathematically this one is... uh... really nice-looking!

name: Kelpie
info: A shape-shifting water spirit, this creature normally hangs out in the lochs of Scotland, but it's decided to make an exception to adventure with you! Only found in Blarney 2 and 3.

name: Bagpipes
info: Ahh, the most calming and gentle of musical instruments. Just listen... *FREEOOOOOOOWWWWWWW HEORRRRRRNNNNNN EEEEEEEEEEEEE HOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!*

name: Fairy
info: A mighty magical sprite! You might think it's odd that it took over six years for an actual fairy to show up in Growtopia, but just remember, Fairy Wings were the VERY FIRST wing to be added to the game, and it took the Fairy Union a long time to get over it! Only found in Blarney 1 and 4.

name: Lucky Broach
info: Absolutely guaranteed to be maybe sorta kinda luckier than the average broach! ...possibly. A little. ... ... ...okay, not really.

name: Money Gun
info: Ka-ching! This doesn't just make it rain - it's an instant MONEY FLOOD! WOOHOO!

name: Rollback Plaque V
info: You were there, man. You were THERE when time rolled backwards yet again, the server burned to bits, and all the fruits of your labors turned to dust in your dry, bitter fist. February 2019.

name: Hellfire Horns - Black
info: Searing bright with the infernal black blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

name: Hellfire Horns - Blue
info: Searing bright with the infernal blue blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

name: Hellfire Horns - Orange
info: Searing bright with the infernal orange blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

name: Hellfire Horns - Ruby
info: Searing bright with the infernal ruby blaze of the Underworld, these horns are stronger than tempered growmantium, sharper than a honed growlecular sabre, and more stylish than even the greatest GrowTech tailors could imagine!

name: Spring Flinger Shoes
info: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! These shoes won't just put a smile on your face and a spring in your step - they'll also give you a new style that works wonders in both boring boardrooms AND beautiful beaches! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...

name: Ultra Spring Flinger Shoes
info: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! These shoes won't just put an ULTRA-happy smile on your face and an ULTRA-swift spring in your step - they'll also give you a new style that works wonders in both boring boardrooms AND beautiful beaches! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ultra way! Go on, I'll wait...

name: S.P.I.D.E.R. Legs
info: At last! The Speedy Palpating Incredibly Deadly Electronic Roamers are the perfect replacement for those pesky human legs everyone seems to have. Seriously, have you noticed how many people have those weak, totally non-metallic and uninteresting NORMAL legs? Why would you want something so... overdone? Use the S.P.I.D.E.R., and get going in wonderfully horrible style!

name: Trickster
info: A portable cannon, the Trickster will kill your enemies, and you too, so watch out! Wrench it to set the rate of fire! You can place as many Tricksters as you like, but only 10 blasts can exist at a time, so if you have a lot, most of them will just sit there.

name: Junk Cannon
info: No block stays awesome forever, even if you're firing it out of a recoilless GrowTech-certified gauss chamber with 1.21 growgajoules of force... which is why the Junk Cannon is leagues ahead of all other block-blasting battlegear! What CAN'T it fire? Where does it get all those blocks from? How can it never run out of ammunition? Sorry, the answers to those questions can only be provided if you have GrowTech Security Clearance Level Indigo or higher, but hey - you can still shoot the gun as much as you want! Woohoo!

name: Purple Aura
info: You are burning with magical, octarine energies!

name: Green Aura
info: You are burning with earthly, verdant energies!

name: Growmoji Grin
info: Want to add a big cheesy grin to your chat? Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: WOTD Trophy 2019
info: The best of all possible trophies in 2019.

name: Balloon Bunny
info: Bunny bunny bunny balloon balloon balloon bunny balloon bunny balloon bunny bunny balloon balloon.

name: Pet Egg
info: This creature is so friendly, it hasn't even hatched and it already wants to be your friend!

name: Big Goofy Teeth
info: Do you ever feel like you can never show enough teeth? Well, toss these on and give yourself a grin that'll rival even the rarest rabbits!

name: Claws of Barko
info: Honed in lightless caves where only the most devious rabbits dare to hop, these claws are used for far deadlier things than digging cute bunny burrows!

name: Bowler Bunny Hat
info: Perfect for when you need to attend a very stylish event that happens to be hosted by rabbits.

name: Drabbit's Foot
info: Once upon a time, a dragon and a rabbit loved each other very much. Even the wisest sages aren't sure how this happened, and nobody likes to think about how it worked, but the wondrous drabbit was the result, and now with this talisman, a touch of its provider-enhancing wisdom can be yours!

name: Easter Egg
info: May or may not be full of chocolate. There's probably something good inside, though! Only time will tell...

name: Hatching Easter Egg
info: It's... it's hatching! There's something inside this egg, and it's coming out soon! Ooh, what could it be??

name: Psychotic Bunny Mask
info: Styled after Hannibun Lopter, the notorious psycho-rabbit!

name: Riding Bunny
info: Takes you to and fro with little hops and a lot of love! There's no cuter way to travel - just look at that cute bunny face and twitchy nose!

name: Easter Egg Cannon
info: Powered by a Fuel Pack on your back, this gun can launch free easter egg blocks at your fellow Growtopians! Don't waste shots at anything else, though, because they still burn fuel!

name: Easter Island Head
info: This isn't a REAL Moai - those are much bigger and weigh thousands of pounds - but rather a cunningly-painted and carved chunk of styrofoam. Looks pretty convincing, though!

name: Flower Pinwheel
info: Enjoy the whirling beauty of this spinny pinwheel.

name: Easter Checkpoint
info: You are risen! Hop back from the afterlife with the help of this seasonal checkpoint. Remember, if you die, you'll respawn at the last checkpoint you touched!

name: Easter Egg - Growtopia
info: Fired from the Easter Egg Cannon, this block celebrates the season and Growtopia, all in one go!

name: Easter Egg - Ghost
info: Fired from the Easter Egg Cannon, this block looks like it belongs on the Other Side!

name: Easter Egg - Pineapple
info: Fired from the Easter Egg Cannon, this block doesn't look like any egg you've ever heard of!
