name: Mah-Kah-Ron Hat
info: The subscriber item for March 2019, chosen by EloraFaline! So good-looking, you'd swear it's a deliciously crispy treat instead of a lovely hat - but don't eat it, because then you wouldn't have a hat, and you'd also have eaten a bunch of fabric, which would probably be bad.

name: 30-Day Premium Subscription Token
info: Consume this for thirty full days of special treatment! You'll get 70 season tokens (as long as there's a seasonal clash running), and 4000 gems every day and a chance of doubling any XP earned, growtime reduction on all seeds planted and Exclusive Skins!

name: 1-Year Subscription Token
info: Consume this for a full YEAR of special treatment! You'll get 70 season tokens (as long as there's a seasonal clash running), 9600 gems and 1 World Lock every day and a chance of doubling any XP earned, growtime reduction on all seeds planted and Exclusive Skins!

name: Holy Jeans
info: Jam-packed with so much holy might, they're, uh... wait, are these just jeans with lots of holes in them? But... how'd they get so dang POWERFUL, then?

name: Buddy's Block Head
info: The nicest block around - it's not just your friend... it's your buddy! Equip it and watch your hoard grow... Gives you a chance of dropping an additional block when breaking blocks!

name: Glowy Cape
info: Bringing light to even the darkest places and dimmest worlds, this cape will surround its bearer with an astonishingly pure light!

name: Building Blocks Machine
info: Eager to add some new building materials to your construction stockpile? Tired of collecting them from random worlds and weirdos? Well, pop this beauty in your world and it'll start cranking out awesome blocks in no time! Careful, though - blocks don't just come from nothing, and this machine will eventually run out of power once it makes a bunch! `4WARNING!`` `6DO NOT BREAK! The Building Blocks Machine will NOT return to your backpack if broken!``

name: Used Building Blocks Machine
info: This mighty machine has run out of fuel, and now lies dormant.

name: Creepy Baby Block
info: Uh, so this is a block now. A... terrifying block. Whoever suggested this, I hope my nightmares were worth it.

name: Digital Dirt
info: The most classic block of all, only this time it's made out of hard light and trillions of lines of code! Whoa.

name: Granite Column
info: Stately and strong, this column can be the cornerstone of an empire!

name: Clouds Wallpaper
info: Who can be bothered to go OUTSIDE to look at clouds these days? Put up a few walls of these perfect clouds and enjoy them from the comfort of your own home!

name: Skull Wallpaper
info: Metal. Show your friends and family it's not just a phase with the help of this highly spooky skull pattern!

name: Dinosaur Wallpaper
info: Rar! Stay in the past with this prehistoric paper! If you close your eyes, you can almost hear their roars!

name: Lava Falls
info: The only thing more dangerous than a pool of molten rock is a falling column of it! Watch out for splashes!

name: Clouds Background
info: Behind every fluffy, beautiful cloud is... another fluffy, beautiful cloud! I mean, what else were you expecting? Weasels?

name: Dark Walnut Block
info: Smells like mustaches, flannel, and fine watches.

name: Dark Walnut Wall
info: If you need an interior that reminds you of classic, manly styles and rough-edged elegance, set this background up and get ready for the perfect setting to relax in your favorite overstuffed armchair.

name: Dark Walnut Ladders
info: A normal ladder will get you to the same place, sure, but it certainly won't do it with such well-crafted - and extra-safe - rungs. Every handhold will feel like shaking hands with a grizzled craftsman!

name: Rickety Ladders
info: Uh, mind your step on these - these splintery, timeworn rungs don't look like they'll hold much weight!

name: Growmoji Smile Block
info: Tired of Growmojis only showing up in chat? Well, now you can use this to add a smile to your world!

name: Growmoji Wow Block
info: Tired of Growmojis only showing up in chat? Well, now you can use this to add some 'wow' to your world!

name: Dark Aqua Wallpaper
info: The color of deep ocean waters! Kinda creepy, like you're stuck inside an aquatic tank with no lights on...

name: Dark Yellow Wallpaper
info: The color of fading beauty! Kinda creepy, like you're in the middle of a decaying field of flowers!

name: Dark Purple Wallpaper
info: The color of a crumbling empire! Kinda creepy, like you're traveling through a transdimensional vortex!

name: Dark Orange Wallpaper
info: The color of a forgotten dream! Kinda creepy, like you're trapped inside a rotten orange!

name: Dark Brown Wallpaper
info: The color of old decay! Kinda creepy, like you're stuck down a toilet!

name: Dark Grey Wallpaper
info: The color of winter skies! Kinda creepy, like you're inside the worst prison ever!

name: Water Dispenser
info: Refreshing! Say, what do you call a water dispenser in a desert? ... ... A thirst-aid kit!

name: Waiting Room Chair
info: Extremely comfy, which is good, because you're going to be waiting here a while!

name: Ceiling Fan
info: Dusty with age and kind of creaky, but it still spins after all these years! That's one tough fan!

name: Starship Security Camera
info: Keep track of invading aliens and lazy crewmembers with this state-of-the-art camera! This device will watch your world and keep a record of everybody who enters! You may have up to 8 of these in a world.

name: Starship Mess Hall Table
info: The perfect place to eat space food! Try the kanzlok - I hear it's delicious.

name: Starship Mess Hall Stool
info: The perfect place to sit as you enjoy a nice space lunch with your space friends! Location: Probably in space!

name: Sea Urchin
info: Aquatic pointiness of the deep-sea variety.

name: Copper Block
info: Highly conductive, and quite precious - don't leave this laying around at a construction site!

name: Sea Lantern
info: Cutting through the murky depths with a fragile glow! This little light of mine, I'm gonna let it shine...

name: Bubble Block
info: Someone managed to get these bubbles to stay in place, which is a neat trick. Very delicate, yet also oddly satisfying to pop!

name: Manhole Cover
info: Keep dangerous tunnels into the underdark sealed shut with this mega-heavy manhole cover! There won't be any pedestrians falling in on its watch!

name: Dark Castle Stone
info: A bleak stone for a dark lord, this carefully-hewn block is designed to keep heroes from climbing up and foiling your villainous plans!

name: Dark Castle Stone Background
info: Behind the walls of every impregnable stronghold lie... more stones!

name: Dark Castle Door
info: Abandon hope, all ye who enter here! The Dark Lord is IN!

name: Dark Castle Turret
info: The perfect place to send down hails of arrows on unsuspecting heroes!

name: Red Stuff
info: Now stuff comes in red too! What stuff could it be?

name: White Stuff
info: Now stuff comes in white too! This is some pure stuff!

name: Black Stuff
info: Now stuff comes in black too! It is nothingness!

name: Heavy Chains
info: Perfect for heavy industry! Or, like, tying up giant wolves. It's your chain.

name: Doggy Block
info: Having a ruff day? This block will be sure to brighten it!

name: Kitty Block
info: Feeling traumeowtized? This block will be sure to brighten your day!

name: Dumb Billboard
info: not used, it's just an icon.

name: Thingamabob
info: I have no idea what this thing does. It's something electronic? Maybe?

name: Da Vinci Wings
info: Da Vinci actually thought he could fly with these. He was totally wrong - they only let you double jump and glide.

name: Genie's Lamp - Green
info: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a glorious green genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

name: Genie's Lamp - Yellow
info: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a youthful yellow genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

name: Genie's Lamp - Red
info: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a resplendent red genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

name: Genie's Lamp - Blue
info: Who needs wishes when you can GRANT them? This lamp will transform you into a brilliant blue genie of magic and mirth. Phenomenal cosmic power awaits!

name: Spring Flinger Squirrel Mask
info: Celebrate the season with the new Spring Flinger Style! This mask doesn't just give you the face of a cheeky squirrel - it also helps you stay twitchy on land AND tree alike! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both! Go on, I'll wait...!

name: Ultra Spring Flinger Squirrel Suit
info: Celebrate the season with the new ULTRA Spring Flinger Style! This suit doesn't just turn you into an ULTRA cheeky squirrel - it also gives you a new style that stays ULTRA twitchy on land AND tree alike! Try to find another piece of clothing that can do both, and in such an ULTRA way! Go on, I'll wait...!

name: Ultra Spring Flinger Squirrel Suit Seed
Mud Puddle
info: Ugh, what a mess of a mudhole! Try not to get stuck here - it'll be slow going with all this thick, gloppy mud!

name: Steampunk Wings
info: Clattering gears and finely-tuned cogs whir and whiz as you don these brass and copper beauties! Thanks to the meticulous magic of steam and jewel precision of luxury mechanists, these wings are at home in the soot-streaked skies of any steampunk world!

name: Magic Magnet
info: Tired of wading through clouds of items and loading up your inventory with random junk when all you want is a single thing? Just tune this magnet to the proper frequencies and it'll nab exactly what you're missing as you move past!

name: Legendary Comet Hair
info: The Night of the Comet is alive... in your HAIR! Roiling with color, every follicle of this otherworldly hair was chipped out of the cosmos, flowing and bubbling with all the energy of the great beyond!

name: Reg4shi's Archangel Wings
info: He has intervened for the sake of Growtopians time and again, for he sees the potential for heroism, creativity and selflessness in each of us. He has even sacrificed his weekends to fight on our behalf. For that alone, we always have and always will believe in him.

name: Coati Scarf
info: This little South American raccoon is full of mischief and curiosity, but right now, he needs a soft place to snuzzle up! Will you let him hop onto your shoulders and share some adorable warmth?

name: Fiesta Coati Scarf
info: This little guy knows how to party! Full of spicy style and fearsome curiosity, there's nothing more rambunctious than a coati out on the town - and around your neck!

name: Riding Llama
info: Careful! They may look fluffy and weird, but these guys spit. And bite. And talk about you behind your back. Llamas, right?

name: Pueblock
info: Este es un bloque de construccion muy tradicional!

name: Pueblock Window
info: Este es un bloque de ventana muy tradicional!

name: Pueblock Door
info: Este es un bloque de puerta muy tradicional!

name: Pueblock Wallpaper
info: Este es un fondo de pantalla muy tradicional!

name: Colored Corn
info: Little-known fact about colored corn: It tastes nearly exactly like regular corn.

name: Saguaro Cactus
info: A hardy cactus, these spiky boys can live over a hundred years and grow as tall as you can build them!

name: Scarfy-Scarf
info: Whether you're rocketing down city streets on an apocalyptic adventure or simply trying to keep warm while looking good, this scarf won't let you down! Chosen by TraxyGT, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for April, 2019!

name: Wriggling Maggots
info: Maggots are an important part of our ecosystem, helping to break down dead matter and recyle it for... oh, you want me to LOOK at them? No way! I'm out of here!

name: Bed Bugs
info: Chittering, biting, and seemingly-indestructible, these creepy-crawlies prove that some nightmares are real.

name: Worm
info: Part of a gigantic worm! How big can you grow it?

name: Brain Block
info: Think you're smart? Just a single Brain Block has more thinkin' power than TEN normal Growtopians... and that's before you start adding more to it!

name: Insect Glue Wallpaper
info: The only problem with laying down a sticky trap to catch bugs is that you wind up with a writhing wall of gross bugs. Ew.

name: Hairy Arm
info: Ever wanted someone to give you a hand? How about a BIG one?

name: Hairy Leg
info: Ever wanted a leg up on the competition? How about a BIG one?

name: Pillar of the Dead
info: Y'know, as interior design choices go, there's something organic and wholesome about skulls - I mean, they were just going to waste away in the ground, weren't they? Now they can brighten up your solarium! Or, like, a Bastion of Eternal Evil. Either works.

name: Googly-Woogly Glooberhellifreakilisticexpialigrossness Fleshy Eyed Wall
info: It's hard to tell if this is a wall of flesh with eyes on it, or a wall of eyes with flesh on it, but either way, it's horrifying!

name: Googly-Woogly Glooberhellifreakilisticexpialigrossness Fleshy Eyed Wall Seed
Googly-Woogly Glooberhellifreakilisticexpialigrossness Fleshy Eye
info: When a normal eye just won't do, take the freak factor to the next, most googly-woogly power possible with these putrid peepers! Just be careful - they aren't your friends!

name: Googly-Woogly Glooberhellifreakilisticexpialigrossness Fleshy Teeth
info: When normal teeth just aren't terrifying enough, take the freak factor to the next, most googly-woogly power possible with these brutal biters! Just be careful - they aren't your friends!

name: Hairy Legs
info: Who needs pants when you have all-natural heating for your legs?

name: Eyes on Stalks
info: Alien eyes for your alien face, with alien lasers to destroy the human race!

name: Riding Poop
info: Yes, it's real, and it moves just as quickly as you do after one too many fast food meals!

name: The Beast with a Thousand Eyes Mask
info: Keep your eye on the prize - literally every prize - with this horrific headful of staring alien eyeballs!

name: The Beast with a Thousand Eyes Mask Seed
Puggly
info: This dogbomination eats everything when your back is turned, and then horks it right back up when it has your attention! How cute! Wait, did I say cute? I meant BLEARGHGHGHGH!

name: The Fly
info: A buzzing beast, engorged by science and merged with your poor head! How will you ever date again?

name: Horrid Snotty Face
info: Just dripping with happiness, this is truly a face only a mother could love!

name: Extra Undead Arms
info: Since when was two arms enough for you to get anything done? Let's stack on a few more and get this party started!

name: Riding 'roach
info: Just a friendly cockroach you decided to befriend instead of squish! It'll take you wherever you like, provided there's some delicious rotting food for it to snack on along the way!

name: Undead Slippers
info: Technically, all your shoes are dead. These just happen to be particularly obvious about it.

name: Giant Eye Head
info: Give your friends an eyeful with this baleful, beady-eyed orb! As an added bonus, you can probably win every last staring contest now!

name: Bob The Gross Blob
info: Not to be confused with Bob the Handsome Blob!

name: Fatberg Block
info: Congealed oil, grease, hair, and other squishy unmentionables, pulled out of the nearest sewer and plonked right into your hands! Don't say we never gave you anything!

name: Disgusting Mess Block
info: If creating horrible piles of wretched misery was an art form, this would be a five-star effort! Unfortunately, it's not, which just makes this an abomination.

name: Strawberry Slime Block
info: Yuck, this compressed pink stuff is slippery and gross! Smells faintly of strawberries, though. Well... rotten strawberries.

name: Rotting Sea Goo
info: Ugh! A Mutant Mixer with the taste of salted stink and deepsea death.

name: Space Poop
info: Ugh! A Mutant Mixer with the taste of antigravity vomit and interstellar waste cyclers.

name: Burnt Slime
info: Ugh! A Mutant Mixer with the taste of uncleaned fryers and festering grease traps.

name: Putrid Gas
info: Ugh! A Mutant Mixer with the taste of medical mishaps and hospital dumpsters.

name: Festering Urchin & Poop Pie
info: Gah! A stale crust is the least of your worries. Take a bite of this and you'll simultaneously wish you were drowning in an undersea cave AND suffocating in hard vacuum.

name: Putrid Gas Filled Blood Maggot Crepes
info: Gah! Rubbery eggs are the least of your worries. Farty fumes welcome you to a bite that's equal parts old blood and bloated maggots.

name: Putrid Gas Filled Blood Maggot Crepes Seed
Alien Bloodied Brains Strudel
info: Gah! Old dough is the least of your worries. Writhing alien brains scream as you bite into them, sending out jets of gray blood.

name: Rotting Fish Guts Club Sandwich
info: Gah! Expired mayonnaise is the least of your worries. Fetid fish guts flop out between your fingers as you hold this horrific sandwich.

name: Rotting Fish Guts Club Sandwich Seed
Festering Fish Guts Taco
info: Why. It's like you took all that's awful about fish guts - everything - and then jammed them into a taco to add a little crunch to the squish.

name: Alien Brains Strudel
info: Why. This strudel is writhing with half-baked alien brains! They're trying to escape!

name: Maggot-Slathered Fish & Sticks
info: Why. Because undercooked fish and moldy breading isn't awful enough, you've managed to top it with a slithering slurry of fresh maggots.

name: Blood Filled Crepes
info: Why. These things are practically heaving with decomposing gas, ready to pop in a fountain of dirty blood the second you bite down!

name: Growmoji Ill
info: Want to add some ill emotions to your chat? Just consume this to add it to your available growmojis!

name: Blob of Goop
info: A blob of goop for Spaced-Faced!

name: Inflamed Nose
info: Don't get too excited by the name - this nose doesn't shoot fire, unfortunately. It's just the sign of a sick Growtopian!

name: Dirt Grass Hair
info: Wow, your hair looks like the grass on top of dirt!

name: Galactic Destructor - Green
info: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in giga-green, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

name: Galactic Destructor - Purple
info: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in pew-pew-purple, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

name: Galactic Destructor - Red
info: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in red-alert-red, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

name: Galactic Destructor - Blue
info: Stolen from an Imperial shipment and bearing Galactic Danger Code THX1136, this super-weapon has but one purpose: Total destruction! A galactic menace in blaster-blue, this monster of a weapon will take all of your strength to lift, and all of your courage to fire.

name: Doctor's Blingin' Cross
info: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! It's said that those who wear the Cross of Bling will experience dramatically shorter lives, but they'll be full of adventure, right up to the end!

name: Doctor's Blingin' Cap
info: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! The Cap of Bling is a treasured hallmark of doctorhood, as it protects patients from seeing your mussy bedhead and dandruff! They'll never know!

name: Doctor's Blingin' Mask
info: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! Because doctors encounter all manner of diseases, it's imperative that they keep from infecting their patients. The Mask of Bling is said to reduce the chances of contagion by 110%! Nobody is sure how that's mathematically possible, but they won't question it, either!

name: Doctor's Blingin' Top
info: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! The Top of Bling is specially-woven to protect its bearer from the slices and dices of errant scalpels and thrashing patients! You can never be too careful when battling the slow creep of entropy!

name: Doctor's Blingin' Pants
info: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! Fun fact: At least 83% of all infections start from dirty knees! Wearing pants as well-made and sterile as these drops that rate down to NOTHING, which just goes to show that you can be professional and look amazing at the same time.

name: Hands of the Void
info: Deadly claws of chaos and rage, spun from the essence of haunted realms beyond the stars. Sometimes the void touches you, but with these, yours will be the touch of that strange darkness.

name: Feet of the Void
info: Dire darkness wraps your feet, turning every step into a footfall of doom. Flowers wither in your wake, small animals run screeching, and your shoes very definitely will not fit anymore.

name: Gut Buster
info: Looks terrifying, but this mess of guts is actually just the results of a stolen medical Train-E, some creative arts and crafts, and a whole lot of duct tape to stick it to your torso!

name: Stitchlips
info: Tired of all that talking? Take matters into your own hands and slap some stitches on those loquacious lips! You'll be silenced in seconds!

name: Clockwork Fish
info: A clanking, clattering fish of grumpy gears! Doesn't like much of anything, so this should be a real training challenge, but on the other hand, imagine the prestige of having trained a mecha-fish of your very own!

name: Clockwork Fish Leash
info: This well-oiled fish has decided its grumpy days are behind it - it's decided to follow you around in all its clankering, over-geared beauty!

name: Clockwork Eyes
info: Gear yourself up for success and stare down your rivals with these superb spinners! The only downside? They need a lot of oil to keep spinning!

name: Mean Wolf Block
info: This wolf is none too happy about being stuck as a block, and he's going to take out all his anger on anyone who gets close!

name: Howly Hat
info: Awooo! Tired or turning your head to the skies to howl at the moon on your own? Now this hat will do all your howling for you! Think of all the time you'll save!

name: Ecto-Lock
info: A superbly spooky lock that not only locks an entire world, but also attracts other ghosts to join the party!

name: Steppin' Ghost
info: Ghosts don't make for very reliable platforms, but thankfully it looks like this spirit is going to stick around!

name: Cupcake Hat
info: Show everyone your love of baked delights by topping yourself with a giant treat of your very own! Looks good enough to eat!

name: Big Belly
info: Looks like all that fine food has gotten the best of you! You should try to cut down on the caloric blocks and start punching more of them for exercise, but until then, this big 'ol belly is a sign of your sins.

name: Punchy Fist
info: Produced with concentrated punching power, this block will give everyone who touches it a swift hit into the skies!

name: Gem Hair
info: Hair spun from twinkling crystals and concentrated gems! Its worth? Incalculable. Its beauty? Inconceivable. Your look? Incredible.

name: Chicken Feet
info: Ba-kaw! You've been afflicted by the infectious chickenfoot virus! Fortunately, the only real symptoms are having sweet chicken feet and an occasional taste for bugs.

name: Terrifying Toothface
info: Yikes! This toothy maw has one too many chompers! Can you imagine the dentist bills? And all the toothpaste? Sheesh, this thing is scary in more ways than one!

name: Loving Halo
info: A sign of a truly gracious and adoring soul. This halo marks you with love and adoration, healing you quickly with the power of the heart! Aww!

name: Chaos Corruption
info: Racing lines of chaos have consumed your blood, filling you with fiendish energy. While the corruption feeds on your spirit, you'll be faster, but at what cost?

name: Block o' Barf
info: Cleanup in Aisle 3! Can someone get a mop?

name: Wormtouch
info: Wiggly worms are the best diggers, so it makes perfect sense that replacing your arms with GIANT WORMS would give you impressive digging skills. 100% perfect, unquestionable sense...

name: Snakewolf
info: Slithering with serpent speed, howling at the moon, and looking like a million world locks, this mythical snakewolf is your newest friend! Notes for care: Snakewolf likes rare steaks, lots of head scratches, and destroying your enemies.

name: Ghostking's Glory
info: All ghosts flock to the holder of the Ghostking's crown. Stolen from his empty throne on the Other Side, this spectral crown proclaims you the true ruler of all ghostkind! Unfortunately, that means you're about to make a lot of booful buddies! At least... until the Ghostking finds you...

name: The Fattenator
info: Dang, you are HUGE. With thickness like this, nobody's going to have much luck pushing YOU around.

name: Med-A-Check
info: Think you might have a malady on your hands? Use the advanced tech of the Med-A-Check to scan your patient! Only has enough power for one complete scan, but will tell you exactly what malady your patient has! Note: Will not be consumed if its target has no malady.

name: Dummy Item for Surgical Maladies
info: You shouldn't be able to read this, you sneaky person, you.

name: Dummy Item for Surgical Maladies Seed
Legendary Clash Key - Series 2
info: A key to a mysterious treasure! This key is for Clash Series 2, running from Summer Clash 2019 through Spring Clash 2020. After three seasons, those who collect at least 10 of these keys will be able to open a special treasure chest. Make sure you have enough - just one won't do it!

name: Darkening Hood
info: Shrouding its bearer in stylish shadows, this hood is the perfect way to stay awesomely anonymous! Chosen by Placental, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for May, 2019!

name: Pineapple Checkpoint Totem
info: Let the pineapples be your sweet salvation! Remember, if you die, you'll respawn at the last checkpoint you touched!

name: Grumpy Pet Pineapple
info: This tiny terror hates feeling like the runt of the pineapple litter. He'll follow you around, but don't make jokes about his size! He's very upset about... well... everything!

name: Slippery Pineapple Squishers
info: As everyone knows, pineapples are the fastest of the fruits. Now, thanks to advanced GrowTech Squishscience, we've managed to imbue the speedy juice of the pineapple into these hyper-advanced shoes. What? You say they're just hollowed-out pineapples? Don't be silly - if that were true, how could they make you move so quickly?

name: Pineapple Skin Shirt
info: A tough skin for a tough Growtopian, both hiding a sweet, wonderful interior!

name: Howling Pineapple Crown
info: YEAAAAAAAAAAAAH! This pineapple is down to terrorize the town! Perched on your head, it will scream its fruity head off at anyone who comes near! Why, you ask? What, do pineapples suddenly need REASONS to start yelling at people?

name: Dangerous Pineapple Juice Backpack
info: This backpack is filled with swirling, deadly dangerous juice from only the most malicious of pineapples! With such feisty energy, you could certainly power something huge... like a Harvester!

name: Dangerous Pineapple
info: An all-new, all-deadly pineapple! Careful how you eat these - many have tried to tame the Dangerous Pineapple, and nearly all have met with a truly tragic fate...

name: Super Pineapple Party Crate
info: The scent of pineapple is nearly overpowering! Smash this tasty crate for Super Pineapple Party goodies!

name: Pinedelier
info: Crystal pineapples filled with enchanted pinelights for the classiest possible pineapple experience!

name: Looming Pineapple
info: A demon-possessed pineapple, out for blood! Or maybe just hugs! Either way, its touch is deadly, so you'd better MOVE!

name: Prickly Pineapple
info: This pineapple cannot make it clearer: It does NOT like you, or your friends, or anyone really, and it will SPIKE the next person who doesn't get that concept.

name: Vaccine Drop
info: A piece of a true medical marvel, and perhaps your only hope of curing the deadliest of diseases! Collect enough of these precious drops and combine them into a final, super-effective form!

name: UV Vaccine
info: This wonder of modern medicine is the Universal Vicious Vaccine, and your only hope against the most dangerous of maladies! Hold onto this as you operate, and be careful, because it'll get used whether you're successful or not!

name: Vile Vial - Chaos Infection
info: Filled with the swirling essence of the Chaosbearer itself, this deadly vial will afflict ANYONE it touches with a Chaos Infection! (Except if they already have another malady, of course - these diseases are very polite in that regard)

name: Vile Vial - Moldy Guts
info: Filled with the grumbling grossness of internal ick, this deadly vial will afflict ANYONE it touches with Moldy Guts! (Except if they already have another malady, of course - these diseases are very polite in that regard)

name: Vile Vial - Brainworms
info: Filled with wriggly parasitic woe, this deadly vial will afflict ANYONE it touches with Brainworms! (Except if they already have another malady, of course - these diseases are very polite in that regard)

name: Vile Vial - Lupus
info: Filled with the howling madness at the heart of every Wolf World, this deadly vial will afflict ANYONE it touches with Lupus! (Except if they already have another malady, of course - these diseases are very polite in that regard)

name: Vile Vial - Ecto-Bones
info: Filled with the chilling despair of the Other Side, this deadly vial will afflict ANYONE it touches with Ecto-Bones! (Except if they already have another malady, of course - these diseases are very polite in that regard)

name: Vile Vial - Fatty Liver
info: Filled with the ultra-caloric output of only the most perfect cooking, this deadly vial will afflict ANYONE it touches with a Fatty Liver! (Except if they already have another malady, of course - these diseases are very polite in that regard)

name: Doctor's Blingin' Booties
info: Gleaming gold to mark its bearer as the finest - and most stylish - doctor in all the worlds! Set with nonslip treads of solid gold, these blingtastic booties will help you keep your footing in even the most slippery of surgical scenarios!

name: Angel of Mercy's Wings
info: You bear the wings of a true savior, a surgeon without peer who has saved countless lives in their pursuit of the greater good. All who can hear the beat of these magnificently medicinal wings will know that their salvation has arrived.

name: Caduceaxe
info: Capable of extracting pure medical might from blocks, this caduceaxe is your ticket to vaccination victory! There's a chance it may break on vaccine extraction, but hey - it also has a chance of getting you more than a few fragments!

name: SurgWorld Blast
info: Your gateway to a world of medical wonders! A SurgWorld is a place of care and healing, with all kinds of interesting blocks, top tips on how to treat people with surgery, and an increased chance of getting maladies while you work!

name: Train-E
info: A prototype variant of the Surg-E, the surgical scenarios (and prizes) you can encounter on Train-E are limited, but it's the perfect way to learn Surgery!

name: Surgical Block
info: Infused with medical goodness! Mmm, that's some healthy blocks!

name: Surgical Waste
info: DANGER! No matter how healthy and medicinal this waste looks, it's STILL LAVA, which means DO NOT TOUCH!

name: Aggregate Concrete
info: Healthy rocks for a healthful world! I mean, don't EAT them or anything - they're just nice to have around.

name: Rotten Pineapple Block
info: The problem with pineapple is it gets mushy when left in the sun for too long.

name: Sourloaf Pineapple Block

info: WAKE UP! GET HARVESTING! START TRADING! What? NO, you don't have time to do your hair! Just GO GO GO! Growtopia waits for no-one, and certainly no hair!

name: Raccoon Leash
info: Super-sneaky trash panda pet! Chitters and squeaks and loves treats (also, making a mess)!

name: Panda Leash
info: A much more official panda than the raccoon, this stoic plant-muncher has just two requests: More bamboo, and MORE BAMBOO!

name: Weather Machine - Meteor Shower
info: A skyful of streaking lights can be yours with this all-new (and all-stellar) weather machine! Quick! Make a wish!

name: Riding World Lock - Green Light
info: Yahoo! Forget cars and dragons and sneakers and starships - when you want to see the worlds of Growtopia, only the world lock can take you anywhere! Hit the gas on this speedy security device and leave your friends in its glowing green wake!

Masquerade Ball Mask
info: With this decorative mask, even the most average growtopian can be the Belle of the Ball! Chosen by Ch4knuGT, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for August, 2019!

name: Tea Basket
info: Toss this on and any items you collect from a fully-grown tree will fall directly into your inventory! A little flimsy, so it's likely to break after you've collected a lot of stuff, but no less useful for it!

name: Leaf Blower
info: Tired of dealing with people? Wish they'd all just leaf you alone? Well, fire up this blower's GrowTech turbine and a storm of wind and fallen foliage will blast them into next year!

name: Scarecrow Pet
info: This little guy's tired of frightening birds (that time a flock of ravens stole his hat was the last straw), so he's decided to join up with you and see if your adventures are his kind of field!

name: Mosquito King's Wings
info: On one hand, these wings will make you royalty and you'll constantly be surrounded by your adoring subjects. On the other, those subjects will be mosquitoes, and mosquitoes are the worst.

name: Ladakh Mask
info: Part of a cultural celebration of life, this mask isn't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! It's also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

name: Ladakh Shirt
info: Part of a cultural celebration of life, this shirt isn't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! It's also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

name: Ladakh Pants
info: Part of a cultural celebration of life, these pants aren't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! They're also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

name: Ladakh Shoes
info: Part of a cultural celebration of life, these shoes aren't just a good-looking potential piece of your outfit! They're also used in a major dance festival in the Indian region of - you guessed it - Ladakh!

name: Harvest Moon Charm
info: Mystic moonlight seeps from this charm, tipping your fields toward balance. As a result, while you wear it, your crops will be blessed with a higher chance of dropping Balance Mooncakes during the harvest!

name: Chopping Wood Block
info: Use this block to axe tree blocks a few questions! Questions like: What will you become after a good choppin'?!

name: Weeping Willow
info: The trunk of a lovely willow tree! It may be weeping now, but just think how happy it'll be once it's settled in your world!

name: Weeping Willow Branch
info: The branches of a lovely willow tree! It may be weeping now, but just think how happy it'll be once it's settled in your world!

name: Weeping Willow Foliage
info: Assorted swaying leaves for a lovely willow tree! It may be weeping now, but just think how happy it'll be once it's settled in your world!

name: Weeping Willow Streamers
info: Long, delicate strands of leaves to hang from a lovely willow tree! It may be weeping now, but just think how happy it'll be once it's settled in your world!

name: Wood Chips
info: Somethin' got chopped, and here's the result! Nice work!

name: Woven Wood Bolt
info: All those wood chips made for terrible snacks, but with a little sew-how, you found a new purpose for them in this beautiful bolt! Now what can you make with THIS, I wonder...?

name: Broken Tea Basket
info: Looks like this tea basket took on too many trees! Don't fret, though - maybe with a little work (and some more raw materials), you can fix it up!

name: Dual Crescent Blade
info: Forged in swirling desert sands, these ancient blades carry a hint of the siroccos in which they were made!

name: Sun Blade
info: Bane of vampires and mole people, the glorious Sun Blade casts a brilliant glow when held aloft! As a side bonus, it also provides its wielder with their daily recommended dose of Vitamin D.

name: Storm Breaker
info: As wielders of an ancient elemental power, those who hold this sky-shaking weapon will inspire awe in all who view them. Lo, the clouds shall part with a mighty crash of thunder, heralding your arrival!

name: Speeder
info: Perfect for zipping around an endless desert under the baleful glare of twin suns!

name: Sniper Rifle
info: Able to knock the wings off a fly at a thousand paces, this perfectly-calibrated rifle is an insect's greatest fear! Wait, you weren't planning on using it against anything else, were you??

name: Monster Truck
info: Full of fangs, fuel, and positraction, this beastly truck proves you don't need horsepower - not when you have MONSTERPOWER!

name: Healing Tome
info: A floating book filled with healthy tips and lost surgical arts! It'll follow you wherever you go, bringing good health to all. Well, except goats - it HATES goats (we think one tried to eat it).

name: Ghost Mobile
info: Haunted by the spirit of a legendary stunt driver, this car can go from zero to spectral in 0.6 seconds!

name: Ghost Rider Bike
info: Pulled from the underworld and wrapped in the flames of damnation, this bike is one scorchin' hot ride! Ow! Better wear some thicker pants!

name: Spring-Loaded Fists
info: Superb punching power - on springs! For those times when you REALLY want to punch someone and they're ALLL the way on the other side of the room!

name: Ring of Night
info: Binds its wielder to the darkness and makes them one with the night! You won't need the hated touch of light to illuminate the dark with this imposing artifact on your finger...

name: Fish Landing Platform
info: A proper place to fish! Now you don't need to worry about someone splashing around in your favorite fishing spot - just stick this on top and prepare for a relaxing day of casts!

name: Fishing Stool
info: The fish might be nibbling, but your dogs are barking! Take a load off while you reel in the next big catch!

name: Cooler Box
info: Perfectly insulated to keep your treats fresh! Fill it with goodies and get ready for a day of sun and fun!

name: Bountiful Seed Pack
info: Contains `$5`` randomly chosen bountiful seeds, including 1 rare bountiful seed! Use it on yourself to open it - who knows what you'll get?!

name: Steampunk Goggles
info: Fogged with the heat of your latest madcap mechanical monstrosity and lined in soot, these goggles have seen you through more than one unplanned explosion!

name: Colored Round Glasses
info: Viewing the past with colored glasses might not be a great idea, but the present? That just makes you look cool!

name: Ruined Bricks
info: These bricks may have seen better days, but they can still build something beautiful!

name: Barbed Wire Barrier
info: Keeping out zombies, insurance salesman, and angry cattle since the 1860s!

name: Sandbag Wall
info: It might not be a great place to hang your flatscreen television, but when it comes to making fortifications fast, you can't beat sand in bags!

name: Regal Stairs
info: Ascend toward your royal chambers or descend in full view of your adoring nobility for the night's gala event - these stairs make you look good coming AND going!

name: Regal Bannister
info: The perfect handhold to keep your regal butt from tumbling down!

name: Mahogany Frame
info: Really gives your art the smoky, all-natural vibe of coffeehouses and rustic farmhouses!

name: Chimney
info: Stop filling your house with smoke and give it somewhere else to go with this very tall and very classic fireplace accessory!

name: Grimstone Background
info: These grimy, imposing walls have seen some dark stuff!

name: Black Leather Couch
info: Very fancy and super-comfortable, but it squeaks like crazy if you even shift a millimeter!

name: Anubis Mask
info: The face of an AncieNt goD, forgottEn beneath tRackless desert sands, has fallEn into youR hands! Imagine what the eyes behind this strange mask Once saw...

name: Anubis Seal
info: Heavy plate to entomb the might of an Ancient god! How could This Have found its way across thE tRackless wastes to yOu? from what dark dangers did it protect its former owner...?

name: Anubis Mail
info: Overlapping plates and sunForged chain to proTect an ancient god! WHen did Anubis losE this? Or perhaps he Found something Even stronger...

name: Anubis Greaves
info: Scoured by the desert sands, like a Jewel, these greaves cUt through towering dunes in the Service of Their enIgmatiC ownEr!

name: Anubis Boots
info: Even strange And mystical godS of the ancient world Knew the benefit of good footwear. these boots can Help you defy the dEsert heat Without losing your cool!

name: Spirit of Anubis
info: Drawn back from the endless deserts of the afterlife, the power of Anubis flows through you! By combining his relics, you have summoned his spirit from across the gulf of time, and in thanks for freeing him from the embrace of the void, he has agreed to lend a portion of his might to you in your adventures!

name: Cursed Spirit Pendant - Red
info: Howling with repugnant red energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. THEN it was buried with its former owner (who died of mysterious causes) before being stolen by graverobbers. THEN it was sold to an evil general before being lost on a wartorn battlefield. AND THEN... it found its way to you. Quake in terror, mortal, for this is surely the most haunted object to be found in Growtopia... so far!

name: Cursed Spirit Pendant - Green
info: Howling with gruesome green energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. THEN it was buried with its former owner (who died of mysterious causes) before being stolen by graverobbers. THEN it was sold to an evil general before being lost on a wartorn battlefield. AND THEN... it found its way to you. Quake in terror, mortal, for this is surely the most haunted object to be found in Growtopia... so far!

info: Howling with pulsing purple energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. info: Howling with blasted blue energy and generally bad vibes, this pendant was found locked in an iron trunk in the basement of a dark castle. THEN it was buried with its former owner (who died of mysterious causes) before being stolen by graverobbers. THEN it was sold to an evil general before being lost on a wartorn battlefield. AND THEN... it found its way to you. Quake in terror, mortal, for this is surely the most haunted object to be found in Growtopia... so far!

name: Superfly Hat
info: The sweetest hat for the smoothest of Growtopians, this is what you should be slipping on when you want the coolest style possible! Chosen by FarmWizard, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for September, 2019!

name: Dark Ticket
info: Beware! Consuming this will send you off to the terrifying Tomb of Growganoth! While you're there, you will have only 20 minutes before the darkness dissipates and returns you to the real world. Banish your items in Growganoth's Sacrifical Wells to earn Corruption Points and get spooktacular rewards at the Corruption Altar! Note: You will need boots for climbing and a source of light to overcome the darkness!

name: Sacrificial Well
info: Pulsing with Growganoth's dark power! He's always hungry...

name: Ultimate Corruption Altar
info: Receive the just rewards of your dark sacrifices here!

name: Bone Fence
info: Surround your house with clattering bones! Just be careful - your local Homeowners Association may not find it very humerus...

name: Bone Checkpoint
info: Call the fallen back to reality with a bony checkpoint to remind them of their own mortality! Remember, if you die, you'll respawn at the last checkpoint you touched!

name: Bone Platform
info: Are your guests tired of standing on shaky ground? Well, they'll be shaking in their shoes when they step foot on these terrifying platforms!

name: Spooky Bunting
info: Celebrate the spookiest of seasons with this ghastly new decoration!

name: Scythe of the Underworld
info: Dripping with dark magic, the blade of this horrific scythe is capable of cutting through the veil of life and death itself! Wrenched into the mortal plane by dire sorcery, it's now free to wreak havoc among the living!

name: Tarantula Legs
info: Skitter, skitter, goes the spider. Long legs and longer shadows reach out from their monstrous owner... you.

name: Horns of Growganoth
info: The Dark One walks among us! You have been cursed (or blessed, depending on your level of evil) with the dire sign of Growganoth itself! These horns are a sure sign you've taken one step too far across the line between good and ghastly! `2Buff:`` Bonus 250 XP for consuming a Dark Ticket for the Tomb of Growganoth!

name: Supernaturally Speedy Black High Heels
info: Super-fast and super-stylish, these heels will get you where you need to be in a flash! Only problem is that they're really, REALLY uncomfortable, especially once you hit Mach 2...

name: Supernaturally Speedy Black High Heels Seed
Spooky Bed
info: Like a normal bed, only for creepy Victorian families with dark secrets!

name: Creepy Caged Doll
info: There's a reason this doll's in a cage. Don't let it out.

name: Demon Cow Cube
info: Phew! Good thing this beast's been trapped! If it weren't in a cube, it'd be trying to trample you with its unhallowed hooves!

name: Eldritch Flame Wall Torch
info: Sinister light that's so spooky, you almost wish it were completely dark. Of course, that's where the REAL monsters lurk...

name: Dark Fairy Pendant
info: This fairy used to be full of goodness, gumdrops, and light, but a few bad decisions, one too many hits of pixie dust, and hanging around with the wrong crowd led her down the path to darkness!

name: Totally Harmless Doll Head
info: What's scarier? A totally harmless doll that stays in one place until you look away... or a Growtopian wearing its head?!

name: Totally Harmless Doll Shirt
info: What's scarier? A totally harmless doll that stays in one place until you look away... or a Growtopian wearing its shirt?!

name: Totally Harmless Doll Pants
info: What's scarier? A totally harmless doll that stays in one place until you look away... or a Growtopian wearing its pants?!

name: Demon Night Stallion
info: Now THIS is a horse that'll make you say neigh! If you dare to ride it, make sure you have plenty of evil sugar cubes and cursed carrots to tempt it into not stomping you flat!

name: Cursed Katana
info: A once-honorable blade, this katana was renowned as a slayer of evil, but the void stares back, as they say, and centuries of carnage have twisted it to the ways of darkness! Beware this blade, for those who wield it... are forever cursed!

name: Hilarious Honker
info: Some people are scared of clowns, but who could be afraid of this cute little guy? Summoned by the whimsical toots of his magical horn, Binky is here to amuse and play!

name: Chimera's Call
info: A bizarre creature out of myth! The chimera may be a mash-up of many animals, but every last part is filled with an equal amount of friendship for you!

name: Rainbow Crystal Cloak
info: Rainbow cloth studded with shimmering crystals! The multicolored majesty of this cloak will carry you aloft, where all can gaze upon your prismatic wonder!

name: Claw Of Growganoth
info: A creeping being from the darkest depths of the void! Summoned by the fractured claw of its master, is this monstrous thing truly a creation of Growganoth... or something darker?

name: Nano Nurse Bot
info: Filled with helpful nanobots to improve your surgery successes (and maybe keep you from losing an item or two)!

name: Battle Boots
info: Stomp your foes... but not your wallet! These boots are made for victories, so put 'em on and get to winning!

name: Alpha's Shawl
info: For those who refuse to heed the call of the pack, this shawl will show everyone you'll never follow - only lead! AwooooOOOOOOoooo!

name: Mega-Hooky Vest
info: A big fish needs a bigger hook, and this vest has plenty to spare! Toss this on and cast off for a fishy victory!

name: Superb Chef's Super Spatula
info: Get your flip on! This spatula will flip any objects with a single slap! Use it on chairs, beds, and anything else you find facing the wrong way! Best of all, it's made of patented GrowTech spatulanium, guaranteed to stay firm even after a thousand slaps!

name: Slippery Chemical Coat
info: Coated in frictionless chemicals! This coat is utterly spattered with the most nonstick, inertia-preserving, super-lubricated slip-n'-slide mix, so if you're wearing it, make sure you're not near anything sharp!

name: Uranium Chair
info: Glowing with the radioactive power of the apocalypse! Take a seat, and even if you don't have any mutants to rule, you'll get a "healthy" green glow for your efforts!

name: Rocket-Powered Warhammer
info: Forget using your puny human muscles to swing this hammer! It's so big and bashy, it uses ROCKET POWER to crack the skies and shatter the earth! Look out!

name: Tainted Cheese
info: The rat summoned by this cheese is very friendly, but also very ill! Why would you want this plagued vermin for a pet? Well, getting a rare malady isn't always a bad thing, assuming you have a good doctor to help cure it!

name: Friendship Dragon Claw
info: There are many dragons out there - dragons of fire and disaster, dragons of home and hearth, and even dragons from beyond the stars - but NONE are so friendly as this one! Known as Hugalovensnugglor (Hugsy to his closest friends), this dragon is only too happy to shower the world (and you) with hearts!

name: Spectral Mantle
info: Writhing chains from the Other Side! These spirit-forged links are meant to capture the most terrible of ghosts, but since you're not, y'know, DEAD, they just look very cool (and maybe a little creepy).

name: Challenge Ledger
info: A monolith of knowledge for all aspiring challengers! This ledger will display Daily Guild Challenge point totals for all members of the guild to which you belong (if any). And hey, even if you don't have a guild (which would be weird, considering how you get this), it'll still show the leading guilds in the Daily Guild Challenge! Now that's value!

name: Captain's Log
info: A high-tech diary to record your latest findings! The incredible efficiency possible through careful record-keeping may even give you a chance of not using up a Star Tool during a Star Mission! Wow!

name: Dark Doctor's Cloak
info: Not all doctors are concerned with their patients! For some, like those who bear this dire cloak, they only live for the challenge of the most vicious of diseases, and wearing this cloak will increase their odds of getting them from Vile Vials! Yikes!

name: Loot Detector
info: Perfect for treasure-seekers! This detector will increase your odds of finding maps and map fragments in Treasure Blasts, which is weird, considering they're not made of metal. Hey, how does this thing work, anyway?!

name: Ghostking's Command
info: A rod of command stripped from the forces of the Other Side! This spectral scepter won't necessarily make ghosts any happier to see you, but it WILL decrease the odds that a Spirit Storage Unit will detonate at lower, less-lucrative levels in worlds you own!

name: Guild Challenge Crown
info: Congratulations! Your guild was #1 in a Guild Daily Challenge! Show off your accomplishment with a shiny crown. Ooh, so shiny!

name: Cooking Recipe - Putrid Gas Filled Blood Maggot Crepes
info: To cook this recipe you will need the following:<CR><CR>Ingredients:<CR>   - Milk<CR>   - Rotten Egg<CR>   - Burnt Slime<CR>   - Putrid Gas<CR><CR>Seasoning:<CR>   - A pinch of Salt<CR><CR>Process:<CR>Add Milk and Rotten Egg to an oven on Low heat. While the Milk is still cold, add Burnt Slime. Add the seasonings and wait until perfectly cooked all the way through. Then add Putrid Gas and remove from the oven straight away.<CR><CR>Timings may vary so you will need to experiment.

Nightmare Teeny Devil Wings
info: Now with extra nightmares to terrify you and everyone else! You wanna float?

name: Red Laser Scimitar
info: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing red blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

name: Green Laser Scimitar
info: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing green blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

name: Blue Laser Scimitar
info: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing blue blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

name: Purple Laser Scimitar
info: Carve the very air itself with energy-edged annihilation! Designed to exacting standards by GrowTech's Department of Slicing & Dicing, this blazing purple blade will show your foes that when it comes to bleeding-edge weaponry, you can't beat an edge made of LASERS!

name: Wolfy Tank Top
info: AwoooOOOOooo! Lovers of lupine layers, take note: your fashion icon has arrived! Chosen by RDK, this howlingly handsome tank top is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for October, 2019!

name: Dinner Bell
info: Let everyone know when dinner is ready! It's been proven by historians that all old-timey places had bells like these.

name: Hay Chair
info: Feel like kicking up your feet after a long day of farming? This hay bale will cushion your weary bones and make a tasty snack for your animals!

name: Thanksgiving Frame
info: Decorative and delightful, this certainly makes for a festive frame-job in the Thanksgiving spirit!

name: Turkey Hat
info: Very few turkeys make for good headgear, and even fewer are stronger enough to lift a full-grown Growtopian, so count yourself lucky you've found this mighty beast!

name: Riding Bell
info: We truly live in a future our ancestors could only have dreamed of, a vast land of possibility where bells aren't just for announcing dinner or generating ambience, but where they come with plush seats and 500 horsepower, capable of carrying us to and fro, all thanks to GrowTech!

name: Dueling Star Fighter - Rebel Raider
info: Splash your name across the stars in this high-flying, laser-firing, rebellion-building beauty of a star fighter! There's a cold and devious empire out there that needs toppling, and you're just the pilot to do it!

name: Dueling Star Fighter - Rebel Raider Seed
Dueling Star Fighter - Imperial Enforcer
info: Stand for the glory of the Emperor in this turbo-powered, rebel-crushing, empire-stabilizing stunner of a spacecraft! There's an ill-planned and dangerous rebellion out there that needs crushing, and you're just the pilot to do it!

name: Dueling Star Fighter - Imperial Enforcer Seed
Rebel Raider Droid
info: Beep beep! Here to help keep your Raider in tip-top condition, this droid will never leave the rebellion in the lurch!

name: Imperial Enforcer Droid
info: Boop boop! Here to help keep your Enforcer in optimally-mandated condition, this droid will never defy the will of the empire!

name: Defiant Jester's Mask
info: Not all jesters are funny! This mask is for a court entertainer with deadly serious skills! Maybe they were a bodyguard for the King...? Chosen by inflames19, this is the Monthly Subscriber's Item for November, 2019!

name: Transmutabooth
info: Behold this wondrous technological device from the innovative folks at GrowTech! The Transmutabooth allows you to transmute clothing items together to give them the visual look of another clothing item - so if you've ever wanted your Cyclopean Visor to look like Shades (while keeping its mod) now you can!

name: Armored WinterBot - Back
info: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. Turns out its great for relieving back pain.

name: Armored WinterBot - Feet
info: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. You can't tell if you are running incredibly fast, or constantly sliding. Either way, these shoes make you faster.

name: Armored WinterBot - Fists
info: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. Ice shards envelope your hand, punching with this might do some damage.

name: Armored WinterBot - Mail
info: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. I hope you're used to the cold, its only getting colder from here. Perhaps this isn't the best thing to wear without a jacket.

name: Armored WinterBot - Greaves
info: One of five legendary pieces of the great WinterBot, guardian of the Winter Fortress. Gives you an icy stance, not sure if it's the resolve of guarding the fortress for eternity or just that you've lost all feeling in your legs.

name: Frosty Wings
info: These Frosty Wings are made out of ice so they can't fly, but perhaps if you try hard enough... Nope, you can double jump.

name: Riding Eagle Owl
info: This strange little bird can't make up its mind if it's an eagle or an owl! Either way it can easily lift you into the air none the less.

name: Elf Hoodie
info: Just because you dress up like an elf doesn't mean you are one, but at least you shouldn't be getting any coal this year.

name: Cloak of Fire and Ice
info: We had to add ice to the cape, otherwise it would have back-fired.

name: Cloak of Fire and Ice Seed
Yeti Leash
info: This terrifying little beast of the arctic wastes, just wants a hug. Maybe it thinks you're its mommy with those big feet!

name: Hammer Of Winter
